papers.title: Policy-Induced Hand Priors in Humanoid Dual-Arm Manipulation: Diagnosing and Mitigating Initial-Pose Dependence
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies are expected to operate robustly across variations in the robot's initial configuration, yet aggregate task success can conceal pose-specific failures and inappropriate hand selection. This work investigates initial-pose dependence in VLA-based humanoid dual-arm manipulation. We characterize the initial-condition-dependent early hand preference as a policy-induced hand prior and quantify it using HandPriorScore, residual hand bias, and target responsiveness. Evaluations across multiple policies and 17 initial configurations reveal strong initial-pose--policy interactions: the same pose produces substantially different success rates across policies, while a single policy exhibits large performance variation across poses. Specific initial arm configurations can suppress or induce an asymmetric hand preference, with the resulting effect varying in direction and strength across policies. Wrist-camera observations also influence hand selection and task performance. Expanding initial-pose coverage in the training dataset substantially improves robustness, while targeted augmentation around a low-performing configuration increases its success rate. Comparisons across training configurations show that sufficient exposure to the target simulation task is beneficial, whereas the effect of real or auxiliary data depends on pose coverage, simulation ratio, and observation availability. These findings characterize a pose-conditioned hand prior, identify a localized initial arm configuration as a causal handle on hand-selection behavior, and demonstrate how data coverage and training composition affect initial-pose robustness.
core_contributions: 表征了姿态条件的手部先验（pose-conditioned hand prior）
提出了HandPriorScore、残余手部偏差和目标响应性等量化指标
识别了局部初始手臂配置作为手部选择行为的因果手柄
展示了数据覆盖和训练组成如何影响初始姿态鲁棒性
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略预期能够在机器人初始配置变化时鲁棒地运行，但聚合的任务成功可能掩盖特定姿态的失败和不恰当的手部选择。本文研究了基于VLA的人形双臂操作中的初始姿态依赖性。我们将初始条件依赖的早期手部偏好表征为策略诱导的手部先验，并使用HandPriorScore、残余手部偏差和目标响应性对其进行量化。在多个策略和17种初始配置上的评估揭示了强烈的初始姿态-策略交互：相同的姿态在不同策略间产生显著不同的成功率，而单个策略在不同姿态间表现出较大的性能变化。特定的初始手臂配置可以抑制或诱导不对称的手部偏好，其效果在不同策略间方向和强度各异。腕部相机观察也影响手部选择和任务性能。扩展训练数据集中的初始姿态覆盖范围显著提高了鲁棒性，而针对低性能配置的定向增强提高了其成功率。训练配置的比较表明，充分暴露于目标模拟任务是有益的，而真实或辅助数据的效果取决于姿态覆盖范围、模拟比例和观察可用性。这些发现表征了姿态条件的手部先验，确定了局部初始手臂配置作为手部选择行为的因果手柄，并展示了数据覆盖和训练组成如何影响初始姿态鲁棒性。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文研究了VLA策略在人形双臂操作中的初始姿态依赖性，发现并量化了策略诱导的手部先验，并展示了数据覆盖和训练组成对鲁棒性的影响。
papers.research_problem: VLA策略在初始配置变化下的鲁棒性问题，特别是人形双臂操作中初始姿态依赖导致的手部选择偏差。
papers.method_summary: 使用HandPriorScore、残余手部偏差和目标响应性量化手部先验，在多个策略和17种初始配置上进行评估，并通过扩展初始姿态覆盖和定向增强来改善鲁棒性。
papers.experimental_setup: 在多个VLA策略和17种初始手臂配置上评估，涉及腕部相机观察，训练数据集包括模拟和真实数据。
papers.key_results: 初始姿态与策略存在强烈交互；特定手臂配置可抑制或诱导不对称手部偏好；腕部相机影响手部选择；扩展初始姿态覆盖显著提高鲁棒性；定向增强提高低性能配置成功率；充分模拟暴露有益，真实/辅助数据效果取决于多种因素。
papers.why_it_matters: 揭示了VLA策略在初始姿态依赖方面的脆弱性，提供了诊断和缓解方法，有助于提高人形机器人在实际应用中的鲁棒性。
papers.relevance_reason: 该论文直接研究机器人操作中的初始姿态依赖性和手部选择问题，属于具身智能和机器人操作的核心问题，与VLA策略的鲁棒性密切相关。
papers.reproduction_value: Medium: 实验设置描述较清晰（多个策略、17种配置、量化指标），但未提供具体策略名称、配置参数和代码，复现需要额外细节。

papers.title: G0.5: One Autoregressive Stream for Robot Reasoning and Action
papers.abstract: The prevailing recipe for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models couples a pretrained VLM with a separately trained flow-matching action expert. This makes the VLM a context encoder rather than a decision-maker. We introduce G0.5, a pretrained autoregressive VLA in which a single transformer decoder emits reasoning and action tokens under a single objective. Three components make this tractable at foundation-model scale: a learnable cross-embodiment action tokenizer that maps heterogeneous robot actions into a shared vocabulary; a native chain-of-thought stream interleaving task decomposition, object grounding, and action hints with action tokens; and a visual memory module that injects multi-second history through the vision encoder. Because reasoning and action share a single set of weights, the pretrained VLM's capabilities carry over to physical behavior: the model follows instructions closely, and prompts directly steer action granularity, task horizon, and out-of-distribution scene handling without further training. Pretrained on a large collection of robot datasets together with VQA samples, G0.5 surpasses state-of-the-art models across 7 independent regimes: real-world fine-tuning on R1lite and R1pro robots (76.7\% vs.\ 53.3\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 24.4\% for GR00T-N1.7), the 2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge on 50 long-horizon household mobile manipulation tasks using a generalist policy (31.4\% vs.\ 26.3\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 26.1\% for the challenge winner), DROID post-training followed by zero-shot transfer to an unseen environment and objects (82.5\%), a language-following Pick-and-Place benchmark, LIBERO (98.9\%), RoboTwin 2.0 (93.3\%), and SimplerEnv-Bridge (87.3\%).
core_contributions: 提出G0.5，一个预训练的自回归VLA模型，使用单个transformer解码器在单一目标下生成推理和动作token。
设计可学习的跨具身动作分词器，将异构机器人动作映射到共享词汇。
引入原生思维链流，交织任务分解、对象接地、动作提示与动作token。
提出视觉记忆模块，通过视觉编码器注入多秒历史信息。
papers.abstract_zh: 当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的主流方法是将预训练的VLM与单独训练的流匹配动作专家耦合。这使得VLM成为上下文编码器而非决策者。我们提出G0.5，一个预训练的自回归VLA，其中单个transformer解码器在单一目标下发出推理和动作token。三个组件使其在基础模型规模上可行：一个可学习的跨具身动作分词器，将异构机器人动作映射到共享词汇；一个原生思维链流，交织任务分解、对象接地、动作提示与动作token；以及一个视觉记忆模块，通过视觉编码器注入多秒历史。因为推理和动作共享一组权重，预训练VLM的能力转移到物理行为：模型紧密遵循指令，提示直接控制动作粒度、任务范围和处理分布外场景，无需进一步训练。在大量机器人数据集和VQA样本上预训练，G0.5在7个独立领域超越最先进模型：在R1lite和R1pro机器人上的真实世界微调（76.7% vs π0.5的53.3%和GR00T-N1.7的24.4%）；2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge（50个长时家庭移动操作任务，使用通用策略，31.4% vs π0.5的26.3%和挑战获胜者的26.1%）；DROID后训练然后零样本迁移到未见环境和物体（82.5%）；语言跟随的Pick-and-Place基准LIBERO（98.9%）；RoboTwin 2.0（93.3%）；SimplerEnv-Bridge（87.3%）。
papers.summary_one_sentence: G0.5是一个预训练的自回归视觉-语言-动作模型，通过单个transformer解码器统一推理和动作生成，在多个机器人任务上达到最先进性能。
papers.research_problem: 当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）作为上下文编码器而非决策者，缺乏统一的推理和动作生成能力。
papers.method_summary: G0.5采用单个transformer解码器架构，统一处理推理和动作生成。三个关键组件包括：可学习的跨具身动作分词器将不同机器人动作编码为共享词汇；原生思维链流在生成动作token的同时交织任务分解、对象接地和动作提示；视觉记忆模块通过视觉编码器注入多秒历史视觉信息。模型在大量机器人数据集和VQA样本上预训练，推理和动作共享权重，使预训练VLM的能力直接迁移到物理行为。
papers.experimental_setup: 在包含机器人数据集和VQA样本的大规模数据上预训练后，在多个基准上评估：R1lite和R1pro机器人上的真实世界微调、2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge（50个长时家庭移动操作任务）、DROID后训练零样本迁移到未见环境和物体、LIBERO语言跟随Pick-and-Place基准、RoboTwin 2.0和SimplerEnv-Bridge。
papers.key_results: 在R1lite/R1pro机器人上微调达到76.7%成功率（对比π0.5的53.3%和GR00T-N1.7的24.4%）；BEHAVIOR Challenge上通用策略达到31.4%（对比π0.5的26.3%和挑战获胜者的26.1%）；DROID后训练零样本迁移82.5%；LIBERO 98.9%；RoboTwin 2.0 93.3%；SimplerEnv-Bridge 87.3%。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作展示了统一推理和动作的VLA模型的有效性，无需单独的动作专家模块，简化了训练流程并提升了性能，为机器人基础模型提供了新范式。
papers.relevance_reason: 该论文直接针对机器人操作与具身智能领域，提出统一的视觉-语言-动作模型，在多个真实世界和仿真基准上取得最先进结果，与领域核心问题高度相关。
papers.reproduction_value: 无法从摘要确认

papers.title: StellaVLA: In-Context Structured Demonstration for Generalizable Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can follow instructions and manipulate objects, but their performance often collapses out of distribution (OOD), when the scene, viewpoint, or object differs from training. Adapting to each new situation typically requires collecting more data and fine-tuning. We present StellaVLA, a framework that instead adapts at test time by conditioning on a single retrieved demonstration. The key idea is to move beyond imitating what an expert did and instead convey why: an automated offline pipeline converts each raw trajectory into a structured demonstration, e.g., a task plan, sub-goal descriptions, and verbalized 3D motion, at zero human-annotation cost. Provided as in-context guidance, this structured demonstration lets the policy reason about the task rather than mimic a pixel trajectory, which also makes it transferable across embodiments (real-robot, human-hand, or XR demonstrations). A parallel dual-training design internalizes this reasoning during training through a joint action-and-language objective, while inference uses the action expert alone, preserving real-time, high-frequency control with no added latency. On the VLA-Arena leaderboard(Aug 1, 2026), StellaVLA ranks first with an overall score of 0.63, versus 0.44 and 0.22 for the strong prior models ($π_{0.5}$ and LingBot-VLA), and it further leads on LIBERO with 98.8% average success rate and LIBERO-Plus with 85.1% success rate. Our real-robot benchmark demonstrates that StellaVLA can use both human/robot demos and human-to-robot (XR) demos as in-context structured demonstration to help VLA model adapt to OOD tasks.
core_contributions: 提出StellaVLA框架，通过结构化演示实现测试时自适应，无需额外数据收集和微调。
设计自动化离线管道，将原始轨迹转换为结构化演示（任务计划、子目标描述、语言化3D运动），零人工标注成本。
提出并行双训练设计，联合动作和语言目标，推理时仅使用动作专家，保持实时高频控制且无额外延迟。
结构化演示支持跨实体迁移（真实机器人、人手、XR演示）。
在VLA-Arena、LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和真实机器人基准上取得领先结果，VLA-Arena总分0.63，LIBERO成功率98.8%，LIBERO-Plus成功率85.1%。
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够遵循指令并操作物体，但当场景、视角或物体与训练不同时，其性能通常在分布外（OOD）情况下崩溃。适应每种新情况通常需要收集更多数据和微调。我们提出StellaVLA，一个通过在测试时基于单个检索到的演示进行条件化来适应的框架。关键思想是超越模仿专家所做的，而是传达原因：一个自动化的离线管道将每个原始轨迹转换为结构化演示，例如任务计划、子目标描述和语言化的3D运动，且零人工标注成本。作为上下文指导提供，这种结构化演示让策略推理任务而不是模仿像素轨迹，这也使其能够跨实体（真实机器人、人手或XR演示）迁移。一个并行双训练设计通过联合动作和语言目标在训练期间内化这种推理，而推理仅使用动作专家，保持实时高频控制且无额外延迟。在VLA-Arena排行榜（2026年8月1日）上，StellaVLA以0.63的总分排名第一，而强基线模型（π0.5和LingBot-VLA）分别为0.44和0.22；它还在LIBERO上以98.8%的平均成功率和LIBERO-Plus上以85.1%的成功率领先。我们的真实机器人基准表明，StellaVLA可以使用人类/机器人演示和人类到机器人（XR）演示作为上下文结构化演示来帮助VLA模型适应OOD任务。
papers.summary_one_sentence: StellaVLA通过自动将原始轨迹转换为结构化演示（任务计划、子目标描述和3D运动语言化），在测试时利用单个检索到的演示进行上下文学习，使VLA模型能够泛化到分布外场景，并在多个基准上取得领先性能。
papers.research_problem: 视觉-语言-动作模型在分布外场景（场景、视角或物体变化）下性能显著下降，需要额外数据收集和微调才能适应新情况。
papers.method_summary: StellaVLA包含一个离线管道，自动将原始轨迹转换为结构化演示，包括任务计划、子目标描述和语言化的3D运动。在测试时，检索一个相关演示作为上下文指导，使策略能够推理任务而非模仿像素轨迹。训练时采用并行双训练设计，联合动作和语言目标，使模型内化推理能力；推理时仅使用动作专家，不增加延迟。结构化演示还支持跨实体迁移。
papers.experimental_setup: 在VLA-Arena排行榜、LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和真实机器人基准上进行评估。使用人类/机器人演示和人类到机器人（XR）演示作为上下文结构化演示。具体实验配置（如数据集、模型架构、超参数）未在摘要中详细说明。
papers.key_results: 在VLA-Arena排行榜上，StellaVLA以0.63总分排名第一，优于π0.5（0.44）和LingBot-VLA（0.22）。在LIBERO上平均成功率为98.8%，在LIBERO-Plus上成功率为85.1%。真实机器人实验表明，StellaVLA能够使用人类/机器人演示和XR演示作为上下文结构化演示，帮助VLA模型适应分布外任务。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作解决了VLA模型在分布外场景下泛化能力差的关键问题，通过结构化演示实现测试时自适应，无需额外数据收集和微调，并且支持跨实体迁移，显著提升了VLA模型的实用性和泛化能力，对机器人操作和具身智能领域具有重要价值。
papers.relevance_reason: 该论文直接针对机器人操作中的视觉-语言-动作模型，提出了一种基于结构化演示的上下文学习方法，属于具身智能领域，与机器人操作与具身智能高度相关。

papers.title: Surgical WAM: A World-Action Model for Data-Efficient Surgical Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Learning reliable surgical manipulation policies is bottlenecked by the scarcity of action-labeled demonstrations: teleoperated surgical robot (e.g., dVRK) trajectories with synchronized kinematics are costly to collect, while surgical tasks demand precise contact handling, long-horizon reasoning, and bimanual coordination. Endoscopic video is comparatively inexpensive and abundant relative to synchronized video--kinematics trajectories, and a natural way to exploit it is to learn world models of surgical scenes. However, existing surgical world models use video primarily for simulation or policy evaluation, and rarely translate the learned dynamics into closed-loop control. This gap raises our central question: under a fixed budget of action-labeled demonstrations, does action-free video pretraining improve closed-loop surgical manipulation? To answer it, we introduce the Surgical World-Action Model (Surgical WAM), a unified generative model built on Cosmos Policy that jointly predicts future endoscopic observations and executable surgical robot action chunks. Surgical WAM first learns surgical visual dynamics from action-free video and is then fine-tuned on the fixed action-labeled budget; at deployment, it acts as a closed-loop, receding-horizon controller that executes a short prefix of each predicted action chunk and replans from the resulting observation. On a suite of four simulated surgical manipulation tasks, video pretraining improves the average success rate from 63.5% to 77.8%, including an absolute gain of 20 percentage points on PegTransfer, with the largest improvements on contact-rich and bimanual tasks. These results demonstrate that action-free video provides transferable visual dynamics priors for learning surgical robot control with limited action supervision, positioning data-efficient video pretraining as a practical path toward scaling up surgical robot learning.
core_contributions: 提出了Surgical WAM，一个统一生成模型，联合预测未来内窥镜观察和可执行动作块。
证明了无动作视频预训练可以为手术机器人控制提供可迁移的视觉动态先验，显著改善闭环操作性能。
在四个模拟手术任务上验证了视频预训练的有效性，平均成功率从63.5%提升到77.8%，接触密集和双手协调任务改进最大。
papers.abstract_zh: 学习可靠的手术操作策略受到动作标注演示稀缺的瓶颈：遥操作手术机器人（例如dVRK）轨迹与同步运动学数据收集成本高昂，而手术任务需要精确的接触处理、长程推理和双手协调。内窥镜视频相对于同步视频-运动学轨迹来说相对廉价且丰富，利用它的自然方式是学习手术场景的世界模型。然而，现有的手术世界模型主要将视频用于模拟或策略评估，很少将学习到的动态转化为闭环控制。这一差距引出了我们的核心问题：在固定预算的动作标注演示下，无动作视频预训练是否能改善闭环手术操作？为了回答这个问题，我们引入了手术世界-动作模型（Surgical WAM），这是一个基于Cosmos Policy构建的统一生成模型，联合预测未来的内窥镜观察结果和可执行的手术机器人动作块。Surgical WAM首先从无动作视频中学习手术视觉动态，然后在固定的动作标注预算上进行微调；在部署时，它作为一个闭环、滚动时域控制器，执行每个预测动作块的一个短前缀，并根据产生的观察结果重新规划。在一套四个模拟手术操作任务上，视频预训练将平均成功率从63.5%提高到77.8%，包括在PegTransfer上绝对提升20个百分点，在接触密集和双手协调任务上改进最大。这些结果表明，无动作视频为在有限动作监督下学习手术机器人控制提供了可迁移的视觉动态先验，将数据高效的视频预训练定位为扩展手术机器人学习的实用途径。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文提出Surgical WAM，通过无动作视频预训练和微调，实现数据高效的手术机器人闭环控制，在模拟任务上显著提升成功率。
papers.research_problem: 在动作标注数据稀缺的情况下，如何利用丰富的无动作视频预训练来提升闭环手术操作策略的学习？
papers.method_summary: Surgical WAM基于Cosmos Policy，首先从无动作视频中学习手术视觉动态，然后在固定数量的动作标注数据上微调。部署时作为闭环滚动时域控制器，预测动作块并执行短前缀，然后根据新观察重新规划。
papers.experimental_setup: 在四个模拟手术操作任务上评估，包括PegTransfer等，比较有和没有视频预训练的成功率。

papers.title: Neural Introspection Gating for Adaptive KV-Cache Reuse in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action(VLA) models map camera images and language instructions directly to motor commands through a single autoregressive transformer. In real-time control, they still spend substantial compute recomputing key-value(KV) representations for visual tokens that barely change across neighboring frames. Recent work such as VLA-Cache reduces that cost by reusing KV states for visually static patches, but its policy relies only on observation-space heuristics and does not account for the model's own uncertainty. We propose Gated VLA-Cache, a lightweight, training-free extension that augments visual-similarity caching with neural introspection. The method monitors the logit margin between the top two predicted action tokens, a zero-cost confidence signal available during decoding. When the margin drops below a threshold, the cache is invalidated and a full recompute is triggered. Evaluated on four LIBERO benchmark suites with both OpenVLA and OpenVLA-OFT, Gated VLA-Cache improves reliability when blind caching hurts. On LIBERO-Goal and LIBERO-Long, it recovers over 100% of the lost accuracy while retaining 80% of the compute savings.

利用解码过程中前两个预测动作token的logit间隔作为零成本的置信度信号来指导缓存失效
在LIBERO基准上验证了方法在恢复精度和保持计算节省方面的有效性
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过单一的自回归变换器将相机图像和语言指令直接映射到电机命令。在实时控制中，它们仍然花费大量计算来重新计算相邻帧之间几乎不变的视觉标记的键值（KV）表示。最近的工作如VLA-Cache通过重用视觉静态补丁的KV状态来降低该成本，但其策略仅依赖于观察空间启发式，并未考虑模型自身的不确定性。我们提出Gated VLA-Cache，一种轻量级、无需训练的扩展，通过神经内省增强视觉相似性缓存。该方法监测解码过程中前两个预测动作标记之间的logit间隔，这是一种零成本的置信度信号。当间隔低于阈值时，缓存失效并触发完全重新计算。在四个LIBERO基准套件上使用OpenVLA和OpenVLA-OFT进行评估，Gated VLA-Cache在盲目缓存造成损害时提高了可靠性。在LIBERO-Goal和LIBERO-Long上，它恢复了超过100%的损失精度，同时保留了80%的计算节省。

papers.title: SpeedTuning: Speeding Up Policy Execution with Lightweight Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: While learned robotic policies hold promise for advancing generalizable manipulation, their practical deployment is often hindered by suboptimal execution speeds. Imitation learning policies are inherently limited by hardware constraints and the speed of the operator during data collection. In addition, there are no established methods for accelerating policies learned via imitation, and the empirical relationship between execution speed and task success remains underexplored. To address these issues, we introduce SpeedTuning, a reinforcement learning framework specifically designed to enhance the speed of manipulation policies. SpeedTuning learns to predict the optimal execution speed for actions, thereby complementing a base policy without necessitating additional data collection. We provide empirical evidence that SpeedTuning achieves substantial improvements in execution speed, exceeding 2.4x speed-up, while preserving an adequate success rate compared to both the original task policy and straightforward speed-up methods such as linear interpolation at a fixed speed. We evaluate our approach across a diverse set of dynamic and precise tasks, including pouring, throwing, and picking, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness in enhancing real-world robotic manipulation. Videos and code are available at https://daivdyuan.github.io/speed-tuning/
core_contributions: 提出了SpeedTuning，一个专门用于加速操作策略的强化学习框架。
SpeedTuning学习预测动作的最优执行速度，无需额外数据收集即可补充基础策略。
实验证明SpeedTuning能实现超过2.4倍的速度提升，同时保持足够的成功率。
在多种动态和精确任务（倒水、投掷、拾取）上验证了方法的有效性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: Trajectory Divergence Horizon Decision for Reliable Dual-Arm Surgical Subtask Manipulation
papers.abstract: Surgical robotic systems are increasingly being adopted as clinical workload rises, motivating autonomous solutions for repetitive manipulation subtasks. Learning-based controllers improve generalization compared with rule-based and analytic approaches, but most are trained for individual tasks and remain difficult to reuse across procedures. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a unified framework that integrates visual perception, language grounding, and action generation, offering a promising path toward more composable surgical autonomy. However, existing VLA policies rely on fixed-length open-loop action sequences, where changing scene conditions can lead to accumulated errors and potential risks in surgical manipulation. To mitigate this issue, we formulate surgical VLA deployment as an adaptive execution-horizon decision problem and propose Trajectory Divergence Horizon Decision (TDHD), a test-time mechanism that estimates step-wise action reliability by measuring the divergence between two flow-matching-generated trajectories under small noise perturbations and truncates execution using a dual-threshold rule to trigger timely replanning. We further establish a real-world da Vinci-like dual-arm benchmark with synchronized multi-view perception and language instructions, and collect 600 teleoperated demonstrations across needle (reach, pick, regrasp) and tissue (reach, lift, resection) manipulation suites. On real hardware with 20 trials per task setting, TDHD consistently improves performance over the latest VLA baselines: success increases from 55\% to 60\% for needle manipulation and from 55\% to 80\% for tissue manipulation, with the largest gains observed in the final manipulation stages. These results highlight the importance of adaptive execution control for reliable deployment of VLA models in surgical robotic manipulation.
core_contributions: 将手术VLA部署形式化为自适应执行水平决策问题
提出TDHD机制，通过测量流匹配生成轨迹的发散度估计动作可靠性，并使用双阈值规则触发重新规划
建立真实世界的达芬奇式双人基准，包含多视角感知和语言指令，收集600个遥操作演示
在真实硬件上验证了TDHD在针和组织操作任务中显著提升成功率
papers.abstract_zh: 随着临床工作量的增加，手术机器人系统越来越被采用，这促使了针对重复性操作子任务的自主解决方案。与基于规则和分析的方法相比，基于学习的控制器提高了泛化能力，但大多数是为单个任务训练的，并且难以在不同程序之间重用。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型提供了一个统一框架，集成了视觉感知、语言基础和动作生成，为更可组合的手术自主性提供了一条有希望的路径。然而，现有的VLA策略依赖于固定长度的开环动作序列，场景变化可能导致累积误差和手术操作中的潜在风险。为了缓解这个问题，我们将手术VLA部署形式化为一个自适应执行水平决策问题，并提出了轨迹发散水平决策（TDHD），这是一种测试时机制，通过测量两个流匹配生成的轨迹在小噪声扰动下的发散度来估计逐步动作可靠性，并使用双阈值规则截断执行以触发及时的重新规划。我们进一步建立了一个真实世界的达芬奇式双人基准，具有同步多视角感知和语言指令，并收集了600个遥操作演示，涵盖针（到达、抓取、重抓）和组织（到达、提起、切除）操作套件。在真实硬件上，每个任务设置进行20次试验，TDHD持续提高了最新VLA基线的性能：针操作成功率从55%提高到60%，组织操作成功率从55%提高到80%，最大的提升在最终操作阶段。这些结果突出了自适应执行控制对于手术机器人操作中VLA模型可靠部署的重要性。

papers.title: Skills in Weights, Memory in Code: Hybrid Learning for Memory-Dependent Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Modern vision-language-action (VLA) policies have acquired broad manipulation skills, but typically generate each action chunk from the current observation or a short fixed-length history. However, real-world manipulation is often non-Markovian, requiring robots to retain and reason over task-relevant information from long-horizon interaction histories to determine the next action. To address this challenge, we propose HyMeS, a hybrid learning framework that leverages the reasoning and memory-management capabilities of coding agents to steer a Markovian VLA for memory-dependent manipulation. Specifically, HyMeS learns low-level motor skills through gradient-based imitation learning, while a coding agent acquires high-level memory-management strategies through heuristic learning by iteratively updating an executable heuristic system from rollout feedback. Furthermore, we close the loop between steering and execution through multimodal stage-completion verification, which updates memory using proprioceptive signals and multi-frame VLM judgments. Compared with end-to-end memory-augmented VLAs, HyMeS requires demonstrations only for reusable motor skills rather than for every history-dependent task configuration, enabling data-efficient compositional generalization. On RoboMemArena, HyMeS improves mean cumulative success from 52.5% to 66.2% and mean task success from 41.3% to 60.1% over pi0.5, while outperforming PrediMem by 4.5 points in cumulative success and 14.5 points in task success.
core_contributions: 提出了HyMeS混合学习框架，结合低级运动技能模仿学习和高级内存管理策略启发式学习。
利用编码代理的推理和内存管理能力引导马尔可夫VLA处理记忆依赖任务。
通过多模态阶段完成验证闭环引导和执行，更新内存。
只需要可重用运动技能的演示，实现数据高效的组合泛化。
在RoboMemArena上显著优于基线方法，累积成功率和任务成功率均有大幅提升。
papers.abstract_zh: 现代视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略已经获得了广泛的操作技能，但通常从当前观察或短固定长度历史生成每个动作块。然而，现实世界的操作通常是非马尔可夫的，需要机器人从长程交互历史中保留和推理任务相关信息以确定下一个动作。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了HyMeS，一种混合学习框架，利用编码代理的推理和内存管理能力来引导马尔可夫VLA进行记忆依赖的操作。具体来说，HyMeS通过基于梯度的模仿学习学习低级运动技能，而编码代理通过启发式学习从rollout反馈迭代更新可执行启发式系统来获取高级内存管理策略。此外，我们通过多模态阶段完成验证来闭环引导和执行，该验证使用本体感觉信号和多帧VLM判断更新内存。与端到端记忆增强VLA相比，HyMeS只需要可重用运动技能的演示，而不是每个历史依赖任务配置的演示，从而实现数据高效的组合泛化。在RoboMemArena上，HyMeS将平均累积成功率从52.5%提高到66.2%，平均任务成功率从41.3%提高到60.1%，优于pi0.5，同时在累积成功率上超过PrediMem 4.5个百分点，在任务成功率上超过14.5个百分点。

papers.title: SLIM-0.5B: Learning Action-Grounded Predictive Latents for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action policies rely on large multimodal backbones to jointly perform perception, language conditioning, and action generation at every control step. Much of this capacity supports open-domain semantics, whereas continuous robot manipulation primarily requires compact representations of observations, actions, and the transitions induced by actions. Pixel-level world models provide another route, but predicting visual details irrelevant to control can be unnecessarily expensive. We propose SLIM (Self-supervised Latent Interaction Model), a compact 0.5B-parameter latent interaction policy. SLIM learns action-grounded predictive latents that capture both action-conditioned future transitions and the actions that explain observed changes. SLIM learns these representations through self-supervised masked trajectory prediction, combining action reconstruction with future-latent prediction. A compact Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone models interactions between observation latents and action tokens. The resulting policy is trained with flow matching for language-conditioned action generation. Across simulation benchmarks and real-world evaluation, SLIM matches or exceeds representative large-scale VLA and world-action-model baselines with fewer parameters, no additional embodied pretraining, lower inference latency, and substantially lower GPU memory usage.
core_contributions: 提出了SLIM，一个0.5B参数的紧凑潜在交互策略，用于机器人操作。
学习基于动作的预测潜在表示，同时捕捉动作条件下的未来转换和解释观察变化的动作。
通过自监督掩码轨迹预测结合动作重建和未来潜在预测进行学习。
使用混合Transformer（MoT）骨干建模观察潜在和动作令牌的交互。
使用流匹配训练语言条件动作生成。
在模拟和真实评估中匹配或超越大型VLA和世界动作模型基线，参数更少，推理延迟更低，GPU内存更低。

papers.title: SAFE-CHEM: Uncertainty-Aware Policy Switching for Robust Robotic Chemistry
papers.abstract: The deployment of autonomous robotic systems in chemistry laboratories is accelerating experimental workflows and providing the foundational data for AI-driven scientific discovery. However, despite the success of data-driven methods in acquiring dexterous skills, safety remains a primary barrier to their deployment in high-risk domains, such as early-stage materials chemistry experiments. Specifically, learning-based policies frequently struggle to distinguish between safe and unsafe actions, leading to overconfident extrapolation and potentially catastrophic failures. To mitigate these safety risks, we propose SAFE-CHEM, an uncertainty-aware framework designed for robust, learning-based robotic chemists. Our approach leverages an ensemble of recurrent neural network-based imitation learning policies to quantify epistemic uncertainty online through the variance of action predictions. By characterising the success-conditioned density of this variance using kernel density estimation, we introduce a hybrid control architecture that autonomously switches from the learned policy to a deterministic, rule-based backup controller when uncertainty exceeds a calibrated safety threshold. We evaluate SAFE-CHEM across three fundamental laboratory manipulation tasks, where our empirical results demonstrate that this hybrid strategy improves overall task success rates and reduces critical safety violations compared to traditional single-policy baselines. Finally, we demonstrate the practical viability of the framework through zero-shot sim-to-real transfer onto a physical Franka Production 3 robot manipulator.
core_contributions: 提出了SAFE-CHEM，一个不确定性感知的框架，用于鲁棒的机器人化学家。
利用集成循环神经网络模仿学习策略在线量化认知不确定性。
通过核密度估计表征成功条件方差密度，设计混合控制架构，在不确定性高时切换到确定性备份控制器。
在三个基础实验室操作任务上验证了混合策略提高了成功率和安全性。
实现了零样本仿真到现实迁移到Franka Production 3机器人。
papers.abstract_zh: 自主机器人系统在化学实验室中的部署正在加速实验工作流程，并为人工智能驱动的科学发现提供基础数据。然而，尽管数据驱动方法在获取灵巧技能方面取得了成功，安全性仍然是其在高风险领域（如早期材料化学实验）部署的主要障碍。具体来说，基于学习的策略经常难以区分安全和不安全的动作，导致过度自信的外推和潜在的灾难性失败。为了减轻这些安全风险，我们提出了SAFE-CHEM，一个为鲁棒的、基于学习的机器人化学家设计的不确定性感知框架。我们的方法利用循环神经网络集成模仿学习策略，通过动作预测的方差在线量化认知不确定性。通过使用核密度估计表征成功条件下的方差密度，我们引入了一种混合控制架构，当不确定性超过校准的安全阈值时，自动从学习策略切换到确定性的、基于规则的备份控制器。我们在三个基础实验室操作任务上评估了SAFE-CHEM，我们的实证结果表明，与传统的单策略基线相比，这种混合策略提高了整体任务成功率并减少了关键安全违规。最后，我们通过零样本仿真到现实迁移到物理Franka Production 3机器人操作器上，展示了该框架的实际可行性。

papers.title: C2Dex: Contact-Consistent Reconstruction and Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Video
papers.abstract: High-quality demonstrations for dexterous robot manipulation are costly and difficult to collect, whereas monocular human videos provide a scalable source of diverse manipulation behaviors. However, transferring such demonstrations to dexterous robots remains challenging: monocular hand-object interaction (HOI) reconstruction often produces temporally unstable contacts and physically implausible interactions, while conventional retargeting methods struggle to preserve task-relevant contacts and local interaction geometry across different hand embodiments. We present C2Dex, a video-to-dexterous-manipulation framework built around a shared interaction representation: stable object-side contacts recovered by aggregating noisy frame-wise observations in the canonical object space. These stable contacts serve a dual role: as trajectory-level constraints that guide reconstruction toward temporally coherent and physically plausible human HOI trajectories, and as explicit transfer targets for the dexterous hand, where Laplacian interaction optimization preserves the local hand-object geometry across embodiments and residual reinforcement learning refines the trajectory in simulation. Experiments on DexYCB and TACO show that C2Dex achieves end-to-end trajectory success rates of 57.78% and 26.67%, respectively, substantially outperforming the strongest baselines (17.78% and 10.00%) under identical evaluation criteria. Real-robot replay experiments further demonstrate physical feasibility across diverse contact-rich manipulation tasks. Project page: https://k-jie.github.io/C2Dex/
core_contributions: 提出C2Dex框架，围绕共享交互表示（稳定物体侧接触）实现视频到灵巧操作的转换。
稳定接触作为轨迹级约束，指导时间连贯且物理合理的人类手-物体交互轨迹重建。
稳定接触作为显式转移目标，结合拉普拉斯交互优化和残差强化学习，实现跨手部形态的接触保持和轨迹精炼。
在DexYCB和TACO数据集上显著优于基线（57.78% vs 17.78%，26.67% vs 10.00%），并在真实机器人上验证了物理可行性。
papers.abstract_zh: 灵巧机器人操作的高质量演示成本高昂且难以收集，而单目人类视频提供了多样化操作行为的可扩展来源。然而，将这些演示转移到灵巧机器人仍然具有挑战性：单目手-物体交互（HOI）重建通常产生时间上不稳定的接触和物理上不合理的交互，而传统的重定向方法难以在不同手部形态之间保留任务相关的接触和局部交互几何。我们提出C2Dex，一个视频到灵巧操作的框架，围绕一个共享的交互表示：通过在规范物体空间中聚合带噪声的逐帧观测恢复的稳定物体侧接触。这些稳定接触具有双重作用：作为轨迹级约束，指导重建朝向时间连贯且物理合理的人类HOI轨迹；以及作为灵巧手的显式转移目标，其中拉普拉斯交互优化跨形态保留局部手-物体几何，残差强化学习在仿真中精炼轨迹。在DexYCB和TACO上的实验表明，C2Dex实现了57.78%和26.67%的端到端轨迹成功率，在相同评估标准下显著优于最强基线（17.78%和10.00%）。真实机器人回放实验进一步证明了在多种接触密集型操作任务中的物理可行性。项目页面：https://k-jie.github.io/C2Dex/

papers.title: Detection and Ranging of Transient Extrinsic Contacts Based on 6D Dynamic Tactile Sensing
papers.abstract: Delicate manipulation often involves transient and subtle collisions between a grasped object and the environment. While the human hand localizes these contacts effortlessly thanks to superior tactile sensitivity, robotic systems often lack the requisite resolution to acquire the information necessary for motion planning, resulting in clumsy manipulation or even task failure. Here, we propose transient extrinsic contact detection and ranging (TECDAR), a simple yet fast and efficient method for detecting and ranging extrinsic contact of grasped objects. Our design of gripper tips employs dynamic tactile sensing leveraging a single 2.5$\times$3 mm 6D inertial measurement unit. The sensor captures sub-millisecond tip deformations at a 7 kHz sampling rate, but operating on a data stream of only 84 KB/s. High bandwidth and compact data size enable the system to rapidly detect and localize contact between grasped objects and their surroundings. Specifically, fusing tactile data with robot pose via an extended Kalman filter enables fast and precise localization of extrinsic contact, reaching millimeter-level accuracy within 180 ms. Experimental results demonstrate that the system achieves an average localization accuracy of approximately 7\,mm in both line-contact and point-contact localization tasks. Furthermore, this near-instantaneous localization enables the robot to rectify its trajectory on a millisecond scale, facilitating precise tool manipulation and enhanced perception of complex environments purely through tactile exploration and mapping. We envision such techniques advancing the future of robotics across domains requiring delicate manipulation, including precision assembly, surgical assistance, and autonomous exploration in touch-dominant environments. Project page: humitlab.github.io/TECDAR/
core_contributions: 提出瞬态外部接触检测与测距（TECDAR）方法，简单快速高效。
设计基于单个2.5×3 mm 6D惯性测量单元的动态触觉传感夹爪尖端，实现7 kHz采样率和84 KB/s低数据流。
通过扩展卡尔曼滤波器融合触觉数据与机器人姿态，实现180 ms内毫米级精度的外部接触定位。
实验证明在线接触和点接触任务中平均定位精度约7 mm。
实现毫秒级轨迹纠正，促进精确工具操作和纯触觉环境感知。
papers.abstract_zh: 精细操作通常涉及抓取物体与环境之间的短暂和微妙碰撞。人类手部由于优越的触觉敏感性可以轻松定位这些接触，而机器人系统往往缺乏必要的分辨率来获取运动规划所需的信息，导致操作笨拙甚至任务失败。这里，我们提出瞬态外部接触检测和测距（TECDAR），一种简单快速高效的方法，用于检测和测距抓取物体的外部接触。我们的夹爪尖端设计采用动态触觉传感，利用单个2.5×3 mm 6D惯性测量单元。传感器以7 kHz采样率捕获亚毫秒级尖端变形，但仅运行在84 KB/s的数据流上。高带宽和紧凑的数据大小使系统能够快速检测和定位抓取物体与其周围环境之间的接触。具体来说，通过扩展卡尔曼滤波器将触觉数据与机器人姿态融合，能够快速精确地定位外部接触，在180 ms内达到毫米级精度。实验结果表明，系统在线接触和点接触定位任务中平均定位精度约为7 mm。此外，这种近乎瞬时的定位使机器人能够在毫秒级纠正其轨迹，促进精确工具操作和通过纯触觉探索和映射增强对复杂环境的感知。我们设想这种技术将推动未来机器人领域需要精细操作的应用，包括精密装配、手术辅助和触觉主导环境中的自主探索。项目页面：humitlab.github.io/TECDAR/

papers.title: VIDP: Variable Impedance Diffusion Policy for Compliant Robot Manipulation from Diverse Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires precise tracking and mechanical compliance, where variable impedance control can improve robustness in task success, whereas static compliance cannot adapt to varying contact constraints. Variable impedance skills can be learned from demonstrations, avoiding complex modeling, but compliance is a hidden variable in force-agnostic kinematic data. While existing methods infer compliance from trajectory variations, these variations may reflect geometric adaptation and not intentional compliance when subject to changing spatial layouts. Therefore, this letter introduces Variable Impedance Diffusion Policy (VIDP), an imitation learning-based variable impedance control framework leveraging a Task-Parameterized Directionality-Aware Mixture Model (TP-DAMM) to extract physically consistent trajectory distributions from diverse demonstrations. By mapping distributions to stiffness profiles, VIDP jointly predicts pose actions and task compliance without force sensors. Real-world experiments show that VIDP significantly outperforms fixed-impedance baselines in task success rate while reducing interaction forces with respect to high stiffness controllers and tracking errors with respect to low stiffness baselines.
core_contributions: 提出VIDP框架，结合扩散策略和TP-DAMM，从多样化演示中学习可变阻抗控制。
设计TP-DAMM提取物理一致的轨迹分布，并映射到刚度轮廓，实现无需力传感器的柔顺性预测。
在真实世界实验中验证VIDP在任务成功率和交互力/跟踪误差方面优于固定阻抗基线。
papers.abstract_zh: 接触丰富的操作需要精确跟踪和机械柔顺性，其中可变阻抗控制可以提高任务成功的鲁棒性，而静态阻抗无法适应变化的接触约束。可变阻抗技能可以从演示中学习，避免复杂建模，但柔顺性在无力学信息的运动学数据中是一个隐藏变量。现有方法从轨迹变化推断柔顺性，但这些变化可能反映几何适应而非有意柔顺，当面对变化的空间布局时。因此，本文介绍了可变阻抗扩散策略（VIDP），一种基于模仿学习的可变阻抗控制框架，利用任务参数化方向感知混合模型（TP-DAMM）从多样化演示中提取物理一致的轨迹分布。通过将分布映射到刚度轮廓，VIDP无需力传感器即可联合预测位姿动作和任务柔顺性。真实世界实验表明，VIDP在任务成功率上显著优于固定阻抗基线，同时相对于高刚度控制器减少了交互力，相对于低刚度基线减少了跟踪误差。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出一种基于扩散策略和任务参数化方向感知混合模型的可变阻抗控制方法，从多样化演示中学习柔顺操作，无需力传感器即可联合预测位姿和任务柔顺性。
papers.research_problem: 如何从多样化演示中学习可变阻抗技能，以在接触丰富的操作中实现自适应柔顺性，同时避免对力传感器的依赖，并区分轨迹变化中的几何适应与有意柔顺。
papers.method_summary: VIDP采用模仿学习框架，利用任务参数化方向感知混合模型（TP-DAMM）对多样化演示进行建模，提取物理一致的轨迹分布并转换为刚度轮廓，然后通过扩散策略联合预测位姿动作和任务柔顺性。
papers.experimental_setup: 真实世界实验，与固定阻抗基线（高刚度和低刚度控制器）进行比较；具体实验平台和任务细节无法从摘要确认。
papers.key_results: VIDP在任务成功率上显著优于固定阻抗基线；与高刚度控制器相比减少了交互力，与低刚度基线相比减少了跟踪误差。
papers.why_it_matters: 该方法无需力传感器即可从演示中学习可变阻抗控制，提高了接触丰富操作的鲁棒性和适应性，为机器人柔顺操作提供了一种实用的模仿学习方案。

papers.title: Near-sensor Computing for Rapid Visuotactile Perception
papers.abstract: Visuotactile sensors reconstruct dense contact geometry from measured surface gradients, but host-based processing increases power consumption and introduces data-transfer delays and variable scheduling latency, limiting the sensing and response speed of robotic systems. To address these limitations, we implement a near-sensor computing framework that includes a spectral Poisson solver as a fully streaming hardware pipeline. The computational core logic has an estimated power consumption of 347 mW and achieves high throughput without data-dependent branching or iterative convergence, thereby providing deterministic latency. Operating at 166 MHz, the pipeline produces the first depth value of each 128x128 frame 35,107 cycles after receiving the first input pixel, corresponding to a fixed latency of 0.211 ms. Across 15 contact geometries, the reconstructed depths differ from a double-precision reference by 0.17 % of the peak contact depth. On-chip decisions based on these reconstructions close a robot protective reflex loop in 28.3 +/- 4.9 ms, compared with 169.9 +/- 27.8 ms for an equivalent host-based loop using the same actuator. These results demonstrate that near-sensor reconstruction can provide accurate, energy-efficient, and deterministic tactile geometry on timescales suitable for rapid robotic contact responses.
core_contributions: 实现了一个近传感器计算框架，包括全流式硬件管线的谱泊松求解器。
实现了低功耗（347 mW）、高吞吐量、确定性延迟（0.211 ms）的触觉重建。
在15种接触几何形状上实现了高精度重建（误差为峰值深度的0.17%）。
在机器人保护反射回路中实现了28.3 ± 4.9 ms的闭环响应，而基于主机的回路需要169.9 ± 27.8 ms。
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉触觉传感器从测量的表面梯度重建密集的接触几何形状，但基于主机的处理增加了功耗，并引入了数据传输延迟和可变调度延迟，限制了机器人系统的感知和响应速度。为了解决这些限制，我们实现了一个近传感器计算框架，其中包括一个作为全流式硬件管线的谱泊松求解器。计算核心逻辑的估计功耗为347 mW，并且在没有数据相关分支或迭代收敛的情况下实现高吞吐量，从而提供确定性延迟。在166 MHz下运行时，该管线在接收到第一个输入像素后35,107个周期产生每个128x128帧的第一个深度值，对应固定延迟0.211 ms。在15种接触几何形状上，重建深度与双精度参考的差异为峰值接触深度的0.17%。基于这些重建的片上决策在28.3 ± 4.9 ms内闭合机器人保护反射回路，而使用相同执行器的等效基于主机的回路需要169.9 ± 27.8 ms。这些结果表明，近传感器重建可以在适合快速机器人接触响应的时间尺度上提供准确、节能和确定性的触觉几何。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文提出了一种近传感器计算框架，通过全流式硬件管线实现谱泊松求解器，在低功耗和确定性延迟下快速重建触觉几何，并显著加速机器人保护反射响应。
papers.research_problem: 基于主机的视觉触觉传感器处理存在高功耗、数据传输延迟和可变调度延迟，限制了机器人系统的感知和响应速度。
papers.method_summary: 采用近传感器计算框架，将谱泊松求解器实现为全流式硬件管线，在传感器附近直接处理数据，避免数据传输和主机调度延迟。
papers.experimental_setup: 在15种接触几何形状上评估重建精度，与双精度参考比较；在机器人保护反射回路中测试闭环响应时间，与基于主机的回路进行比较。
papers.key_results: 计算核心逻辑功耗347 mW，在166 MHz下固定延迟0.211 ms，重建误差为峰值深度的0.17%，机器人保护反射回路闭环响应时间28.3 ± 4.9 ms（主机为169.9 ± 27.8 ms）。

papers.title: In-Context VLA: Endowing Vision-Language-Action Models with Language via In-Context Post-Training and Agentic Tool Use
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become the dominant recipe for generalist manipulation, yet they are almost universally trained by behavior cloning: a policy imitates expert action chunks conditioned on a static image and a fixed instruction. A natural remedy is to inject explicit reasoning through textual chain-of-thought (CoT). We show, both empirically and analytically, that free-form textual CoT degrades low-level control: the reasoning it produces is ungrounded, its latency breaks closed-loop timing, and, crucially, the reasoning and action tokens are optimized against conflicting objectives so that the policy learns to narrate rather than to act. We argue that what a VLA needs is not the ability to generate language, but the ability to consume grounded language. To this end we introduce \textbf{\ourmethod{}}, a framework that endows a VLA with language competence through (i) in-context post-training, in which perceptual evidence is injected as structured context and the model is supervised only on actions, and (ii) an agentic tool-use interface, in which the policy queries open-vocabulary detectors, monocular depth, and a vision--language model to actively acquire task-relevant information. Rather than emitting a single templated caption, our data engine produces diverse, paraphrased, and evidence-conditioned spatial descriptions, so that the policy learns to interpret language it has never seen verbatim. Across the RoboCasa-GR1, SimplerEnv, and LIBERO simulation benchmarks, together with 8 real-world robot manipulation tasks, our method consistently achieves SOTA results in both performance and efficiency when compared with CoT-based approaches under matched configurations.
core_contributions: 证明自由形式文本CoT会降低VLA的低级控制性能，并分析其原因。
提出In-Context VLA框架，包括上下文后训练和智能体工具使用接口，使VLA能够消费有基础的语言。
设计数据引擎产生多样化、释义化且基于证据的空间描述，增强策略对未见语言的解释能力。
在多个模拟和真实基准上取得SOTA结果，验证了方法的有效性和效率。
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为通用操作任务的主导范式，但它们几乎普遍通过行为克隆进行训练：策略在静态图像和固定指令条件下模仿专家动作片段。一个自然的补救措施是通过文本思维链（CoT）注入显式推理。我们通过实验和分析表明，自由形式的文本CoT会降低低级控制性能：它产生的推理缺乏基础，其延迟破坏了闭环时序，而且关键的是，推理和动作标记在优化时存在冲突目标，导致策略学会叙述而非行动。我们认为，VLA需要的不是生成语言的能力，而是消费有基础的语言的能力。为此，我们引入了In-Context VLA框架，该框架通过以下方式赋予VLA语言能力：（i）上下文后训练，其中感知证据作为结构化上下文注入，模型仅在动作上进行监督；（ii）智能体工具使用接口，其中策略查询开放词汇检测器、单目深度和视觉语言模型以主动获取任务相关信息。我们的数据引擎不是生成单个模板化描述，而是产生多样化、释义化且基于证据的空间描述，使策略能够解释从未逐字见过的语言。在RoboCasa-GR1、SimplerEnv和LIBERO模拟基准测试以及8个真实世界机器人操作任务中，我们的方法在匹配配置下与基于CoT的方法相比，在性能和效率上 consistently 实现了最先进的结果。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文提出In-Context VLA框架，通过上下文后训练和智能体工具使用，使VLA模型能够消费有基础的语言而非生成语言，从而避免自由形式CoT带来的控制退化，在多个模拟和真实操作任务上取得最先进性能。
papers.research_problem: VLA模型普遍使用行为克隆，注入自由形式文本CoT会降低低级控制性能，因为推理无基础、延迟破坏闭环时序、推理和动作目标冲突。如何在不牺牲控制性能的情况下赋予VLA语言能力？
papers.method_summary: In-Context VLA框架包含两个关键部分：(i) 上下文后训练，将感知证据作为结构化上下文注入，模型仅在动作上进行监督；(ii) 智能体工具使用接口，策略可以主动查询开放词汇检测器、单目深度和视觉语言模型以获取任务相关信息。数据引擎生成多样化、释义化的空间描述，使策略能够解释从未见过的语言。
papers.experimental_setup: 在RoboCasa-GR1、SimplerEnv和LIBERO模拟基准测试以及8个真实世界机器人操作任务上进行评估，与基于CoT的方法在匹配配置下比较。
papers.key_results: 在性能和效率上 consistently 优于基于CoT的方法，达到最先进结果。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作解决了VLA模型中语言生成与控制性能之间的冲突，提供了一种有效利用语言而不生成语言的方法，提升了机器人操作任务的性能和效率，对具身智能领域有重要意义。

papers.title: SkillMemo: Expert-guided Skill Memory Framework for Compositional Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract: Embodied visuomotor models, including Diffusion Policy (DP) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, have demonstrated promising performance on robotic manipulation benchmarks. However, their potential remains fundamentally constrained by the scarcity of large-scale embodied trajectory datasets, leading to insufficient compositional generalization in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios with limited capability to capture reusable skill structures. To address this limitation, we propose Skill-Based Memory (SkillMemo) framework that implicitly decomposes long-horizon demonstrations into latent atomic skills and integrates skill-level features into a dynamic episodic memory bank for solving compositional tasks. Specifically, we first introduce an expert-guided trajectory segmentation module built upon a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, which implicitly partitions trajectories into distinct skill primitives represented by learned gating coefficients. We further design a skill-level episodic memory architecture that stores compact skill representations as retrievable key-value pairs. During inference, the memory bank retrieves the most relevant skill primitives which are subsequently fused with the model's current gating distribution, providing a robust contextual prior to refine action predictions. Extensive experiments on the simulation benchmark and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that SkillMemo consistently enhances both DP and VLA backbones, achieving state-of-the-art performance and outperforming $π_{0.5}$, while exhibiting strong compositional generalization to unseen task configurations.
core_contributions: 提出SkillMemo框架，隐式分解长程演示为潜在原子技能并整合到动态情景记忆库中
设计基于MoE的专家引导轨迹分割模块，隐式划分轨迹为技能原语
设计技能级情景记忆架构，存储紧凑技能表示为可检索键值对
在仿真和真实任务上一致提升DP和VLA骨干，达到SOTA并超越π0.5，展现强组合泛化
papers.abstract_zh: 具身视觉运动模型，包括扩散策略（DP）和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，在机器人操作基准上展示了有前景的性能。然而，它们的潜力仍然受到大规模具身轨迹数据集稀缺的根本限制，导致在分布外（OOD）场景中组合泛化不足，且捕获可复用技能结构的能力有限。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了基于技能的记忆（SkillMemo）框架，该框架隐式地将长程演示分解为潜在原子技能，并将技能级特征整合到动态情景记忆库中，以解决组合任务。具体来说，我们首先引入了一个基于混合专家（MoE）架构的专家引导轨迹分割模块，该模块隐式地将轨迹划分为由学习到的门控系数表示的独特技能原语。我们进一步设计了一个技能级情景记忆架构，将紧凑的技能表示存储为可检索的键值对。在推理过程中，记忆库检索最相关的技能原语，随后与模型的当前门控分布融合，提供稳健的上下文先验以优化动作预测。在仿真基准和真实世界操作任务上的大量实验表明，SkillMemo持续增强DP和VLA骨干，实现了最先进的性能，并优于π0.5，同时展现出对未见任务配置的强组合泛化能力。
papers.summary_one_sentence: SkillMemo通过隐式技能分解和动态情景记忆库，提升了具身模型在组合操作任务中的泛化能力。
papers.research_problem: 具身视觉运动模型因大规模轨迹数据稀缺，导致在分布外场景中组合泛化不足，且难以捕获可复用的技能结构。
papers.method_summary: SkillMemo框架包含两个主要组件：1) 基于MoE的专家引导轨迹分割模块，通过门控系数隐式将轨迹分割为技能原语；2) 技能级情景记忆架构，将技能表示存储为键值对。推理时，记忆库检索相关技能原语并与当前门控分布融合，提供上下文先验以优化动作预测。
papers.experimental_setup: 在仿真基准和真实世界操作任务上进行实验，具体环境未在摘要中说明。
papers.key_results: SkillMemo一致提升DP和VLA骨干的性能，达到SOTA，超越π0.5，并在未见任务配置上展现强组合泛化。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作通过隐式技能分解和记忆机制，有效缓解了具身模型数据稀缺导致的组合泛化问题，为机器人操作领域提供了新思路。

papers.title: EvoHIL: Self-Evolving Reward and Flow-Matched Policy Optimization for Robust Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (HIL-RL) enables robots to learn contact-rich manipulation from limited real-world interaction, but deployment exposes three coupled limitations: static visual reward models fail under scene changes; independently sampled actions cause temporally inconsistent motion; and vision-based policies remain sensitive to appearance shifts. We present EvoHIL, a unified framework that adapts the reward model, action generator, and visual do main within a staged human-in-the-loop learning process. First, self-evolving reward (SER) adapts the success classifier from human-confirmed positives and provisional weak negatives. Second, Action Flow Stabilization (AFS) generates temporally coherent action chunks through flow matching, grounding policy updates in executed action prefixes and demonstrated behavior. Third, retention-aware offline fine-tuning replays relit interaction data while anchoring the AFS actor-critic to prior behavior, adapting the visual domain without additional robot interaction. Across six manipulation tasks on Franka FR3 and SO-101 arms under a controlled lighting shift, EvoHIL improves task success, agreement with human-confirmation labels, motion smoothness, and completion time relative to human-in-the-loop and imitation baselines.Project page: https://anonymous4366.github.io/EvoHIL/
core_contributions: 提出自进化奖励（SER）机制，利用人类确认的正样本和临时弱负样本自适应更新成功分类器。
提出动作流稳定（AFS）方法，通过流匹配生成时间一致的动作块，将策略更新锚定在执行动作前缀和演示行为上。
提出保留感知的离线微调策略，通过重放重新光照的交互数据并锚定actor-critic到先前行为，实现视觉域适应无需额外机器人交互。
在Franka FR3和SO-101机械臂的六个操作任务上验证了EvoHIL在任务成功率、一致性、平滑度和完成时间上的优越性。
papers.abstract_zh: 人在回路强化学习（HIL-RL）使机器人能够从有限的真实世界交互中学习接触丰富的操作，但部署暴露了三个耦合的限制：静态视觉奖励模型在场景变化下失败；独立采样的动作导致时间不一致的运动；基于视觉的策略仍然对外观变化敏感。我们提出EvoHIL，一个统一的框架，在分阶段的人机交互学习过程中适应奖励模型、动作生成器和视觉领域。首先，自进化奖励（SER）从人类确认的正样本和临时弱负样本中适应成功分类器。其次，动作流稳定（AFS）通过流匹配生成时间一致的动作块，将策略更新锚定在执行的动作前缀和演示行为上。第三，保留感知的离线微调重放重新光照的交互数据，同时将AFS actor-critic锚定到先前行为，无需额外的机器人交互即可适应视觉领域。在Franka FR3和SO-101机械臂上的六个操作任务中，在受控光照变化下，EvoHIL相对于人在回路和模仿基线提高了任务成功率、与人类确认标签的一致性、运动平滑度和完成时间。
papers.summary_one_sentence: EvoHIL通过自进化奖励、动作流稳定和保留感知离线微调的统一框架，解决了人在回路强化学习中视觉奖励模型、动作一致性和视觉域适应问题，在多个操作任务上显著提升性能。
papers.research_problem: 人在回路强化学习在接触丰富操作部署中面临三个耦合限制：静态视觉奖励模型无法应对场景变化、独立采样动作导致时间不一致运动、基于视觉的策略对外观变化敏感。
papers.method_summary: EvoHIL是一个统一框架，包含三个关键组件：1) 自进化奖励（SER）通过人类确认的正样本和临时弱负样本自适应更新成功分类器，使奖励模型适应场景变化；2) 动作流稳定（AFS）利用流匹配生成时间一致的动作块，并将策略更新锚定在执行的动作前缀和演示行为上，确保动作时间一致性；3) 保留感知的离线微调通过重放重新光照的交互数据，同时将AFS actor-critic锚定到先前行为，实现视觉域适应而无需额外机器人交互。这三个组件在分阶段的人机交互学习过程中协同工作，逐步适应奖励模型、动作生成器和视觉领域。
papers.experimental_setup: 实验在Franka FR3和SO-101机械臂上进行，涵盖六个接触丰富的操作任务。在受控光照变化条件下，将EvoHIL与人在回路强化学习基线和模仿学习基线进行比较。评估指标包括任务成功率、与人类确认标签的一致性、运动平滑度和完成时间。
papers.key_results: 在六个操作任务上，EvoHIL在任务成功率、与人类确认标签的一致性、运动平滑度和完成时间方面均优于人在回路和模仿基线，证明了其在应对场景变化和视觉域偏移时的鲁棒性。
papers.why_it_matters: EvoHIL针对人在回路强化学习在实际部署中的关键挑战提出了统一解决方案，通过自适应奖励模型、动作流稳定和视觉域适应，使机器人能够从有限的真实世界交互中学习鲁棒的接触丰富操作，显著提升了在场景变化和外观偏移下的任务性能和可靠性，推动了具身智能在真实环境中的应用。

papers.title: Continue or Replan? Bernoulli-Continuation Policy Learning for Adaptive Horizon Execution
papers.abstract: Existing chunk-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models execute a fixed number of actions (i.e., execution horizon) before replanning, turning replanning into a task-agnostic periodic schedule that is independent of task progress. As a result, when no replanning boundary falls before a critical manipulation stage, it is executed from a stale chunk rather than a freshly replanned one. To address this limitation, we propose Bernoulli-Continuation Policy (BCP), a lightweight, plug-and-play framework for adaptive horizon execution that keeps the base VLA frozen. Given a fixed-length action chunk, its continuation head decomposes execution-horizon selection into a sequence of continue-or-replan decisions, which imposes an ordinal, prefix-sharing inductive bias over candidate horizons rather than treating them as independent classes. Since the optimal horizon for each chunk is not observable, we train this head with reinforcement learning from trajectory-level outcomes and introduce a Replanning-Efficiency Reward that jointly rewards task success and efficient VLA usage, discouraging the policy from collapsing to unnecessarily short horizons. On RoboTwin 2.0 with LingBot-VLA as the base policy, BCP improves the average success rate by +11.08% on 13 low-success tasks and from 89.88% to 93.94% (+4.06%) across all 50 tasks. Although trained only under the Clean setting, BCP generalizes to the Randomized setting, raising the average success rate by +4.06%. It also transfers to a different base policy $π_{0.5}$, achieving a better result on LIBERO (+1.7%) and, notably, on the harder LIBERO-PRO (+6.8%). On a real robot, BCP lifts success from 74% to 92% and from 44% to 84% on two manipulation tasks. Meanwhile, its negligible overhead, combined with higher success, makes BCP's overall runtime even lower than the fixed-horizon baselines.
core_contributions: 提出伯努利延续策略（BCP），一种轻量级、即插即用的自适应视界执行框架，保持基础VLA冻结。
将执行视界选择分解为一系列继续或重规划的决策，施加有序的、前缀共享的归纳偏置。
使用强化学习从轨迹级结果训练延续头，并引入重规划效率奖励，同时优化任务成功和VLA使用效率。
在多个仿真和真实机器人任务上取得显著成功率提升，且开销可忽略。
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的基于块的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在执行固定数量的动作（即执行视界）后才进行重规划，将重规划变成了与任务进度无关的周期性调度。结果，当关键操作阶段之前没有重规划边界时，该阶段将使用过时的块而不是新规划的块来执行。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了伯努利延续策略（BCP），一个轻量级、即插即用的自适应视界执行框架，保持基础VLA冻结。给定一个固定长度的动作块，其延续头将执行视界选择分解为一系列继续或重规划的决策，这为候选视界施加了有序的、前缀共享的归纳偏置，而不是将它们视为独立的类别。由于每个块的最优视界不可观测，我们使用轨迹级结果的强化学习来训练这个头，并引入了一个重规划效率奖励，同时奖励任务成功和高效的VLA使用，阻止策略崩溃到不必要短的视界。在基于LingBot-VLA的RoboTwin 2.0上，BCP在13个低成功任务上平均成功率提升了+11.08%，在所有50个任务上从89.88%提升到93.94%（+4.06%）。尽管仅在Clean设置下训练，BCP泛化到Randomized设置，平均成功率提升了+4.06%。它还迁移到不同的基础策略π0.5，在LIBERO上取得了更好的结果（+1.7%），并且在更难的LIBERO-PRO上取得了显著提升（+6.8%）。在真实机器人上，BCP在两个操作任务上将成功率从74%提升到92%和从44%提升到84%。同时，其可忽略的开销加上更高的成功率，使得BCP的整体运行时间甚至低于固定视界基线。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出伯努利延续策略（BCP），一种轻量级自适应视界执行框架，通过强化学习训练延续头来决定继续或重规划，显著提升VLA模型在机器人操作任务中的成功率和效率。
papers.research_problem: 现有的基于块的VLA模型使用固定执行视界进行重规划，导致关键操作阶段可能使用过时的动作块，影响任务成功率。
papers.method_summary: BCP在固定长度的动作块上附加一个延续头，该头将执行视界选择建模为一系列伯努利决策（继续或重规划），通过强化学习训练，奖励函数结合任务成功和重规划效率，从而自适应地决定何时重规划，避免使用过时动作块。
papers.experimental_setup: 实验在RoboTwin 2.0（使用LingBot-VLA作为基础策略）上进行，包括13个低成功任务和全部50个任务；在LIBERO和LIBERO-PRO上使用不同的基础策略π0.5进行迁移测试；在真实机器人上进行了两个操作任务。训练仅在Clean设置下进行，测试包括Clean和Randomized设置。
papers.key_results: 在RoboTwin 2.0上，BCP在13个低成功任务上平均成功率提升+11.08%，所有50个任务从89.88%提升到93.94%（+4.06%）。泛化到Randomized设置，平均成功率提升+4.06%。迁移到π0.5，在LIBERO上提升+1.7%，在LIBERO-PRO上提升+6.8%。真实机器人上，两个任务成功率分别从74%提升到92%和从44%提升到84%。整体运行时间低于固定视界基线。
papers.why_it_matters: 这项工作解决了固定视界重规划的关键局限性，提出了一种轻量级自适应方法，可以即插即用地提升现有VLA模型的性能，在多个基准和真实机器人上展示了显著改进，且几乎不增加计算开销，对于机器人操作与具身智能领域具有重要实用价值。

papers.title: A Hierarchical Approach to Imitation Learning for Manipulation Tasks Requiring Time Varying Forces
papers.abstract: Diffusion policies have shown strong performance in learning complex, multi-modal behaviors for robotic manipulation. However, their application to contact-rich disassembly tasks remains limited by a key trade-off: the iterative denoising process introduces inference latencies that makes high frequency control difficult, which is essential for realizing dynamic interactions such as chiseling and prying. Recent action-chunking techniques mitigate latency but use an open-loop execution window, rendering the system blind to rapid force transients caused by fracture events. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Diffusion Policy Augmented by Fast Trajectory Generation (DPA-FTG). Compared to recent visual-tactile approaches that focus on positional correction, DPA-FTG decouples low-frequency planning from high-frequency force regulation. At the high level ($5$ Hz), a conditional diffusion model predicts a sequence of latent parameters for selecting a strategy from a learned vocabulary of task primitives. At the low level ($60$ Hz), a lightweight, force-conditioned policy acts as a neural impedance controller, modulating execution in real-time to maintain contact stability. We validate our approach on a bimanual battery disassembly task involving the separation of a compliant sheet. Experimental evaluation demonstrates that DPA-FTG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, including Reactive Diffusion Policy (RDP).
core_contributions: 提出DPA-FTG框架，将低频规划与高频力调节解耦
高层使用条件扩散模型预测潜在参数，从学习到的任务原语词汇中选择策略
低层使用轻量级力条件策略作为神经阻抗控制器，实时调节执行
在双臂电池拆卸任务上验证了方法的有效性
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散策略在学习机器人操作的复杂多模态行为方面表现出色。然而，它们在接触丰富的拆卸任务中的应用仍然受到一个关键权衡的限制：迭代去噪过程引入了推理延迟，使得高频控制变得困难，而这对于实现诸如凿削和撬动等动态交互至关重要。最近的动作分块技术减轻了延迟，但使用开环执行窗口，使得系统对断裂事件引起的快速力瞬变视而不见。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了扩散策略增强快速轨迹生成（DPA-FTG）。与最近关注位置校正的视觉-触觉方法相比，DPA-FTG将低频规划与高频力调节解耦。在高层次（5 Hz），条件扩散模型预测一系列潜在参数，用于从学习到的任务原语词汇中选择策略。在低层次（60 Hz），轻量级的力条件策略充当神经阻抗控制器，实时调节执行以保持接触稳定性。我们在一个涉及分离柔性片的双臂电池拆卸任务上验证了我们的方法。实验评估表明，DPA-FTG优于最先进的基线，包括反应式扩散策略（RDP）。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出DPA-FTG分层模仿学习方法，将低频规划与高频力调节解耦，用于需要时变力的操作任务，在双臂电池拆卸任务上优于基线。
papers.research_problem: 扩散策略在接触丰富的拆卸任务中因迭代去噪导致推理延迟，难以实现高频控制；动作分块技术虽减轻延迟但使用开环执行，无法应对快速力瞬变。
papers.method_summary: DPA-FTG包含两层：高层（5 Hz）条件扩散模型预测潜在参数，从学习到的任务原语词汇中选择策略；低层（60 Hz）力条件策略作为神经阻抗控制器，实时调节执行以保持接触稳定性。
papers.experimental_setup: 在双臂电池拆卸任务上验证，涉及分离柔性片，与包括Reactive Diffusion Policy (RDP)在内的基线比较。
papers.key_results: DPA-FTG优于最先进的基线，包括Reactive Diffusion Policy (RDP)。
papers.why_it_matters: 该方法解决了扩散策略在接触丰富任务中高频控制与闭环力调节的权衡，对于需要时变力的操作任务（如拆卸）具有重要意义。

papers.title: Bimanual Manipulation Within an 8 GB Budget: Zero-Copy Sensing and Quantized ACT on an Entry-Level Jetson
papers.abstract: Bimanual manipulation policies trained with imitation learning are typically evaluated on workstation or datacenter-class GPUs, leaving the cost of deploying them on embedded hardware largely uncharacterized. We present a bimanual SO-101 system running entirely on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super (8 GB), the entry-level tier of NVIDIA's embedded line, using a desktop GPU (RTX 3070) only for offline training, evaluated on pick-and-place of a deformable beanbag. First, we build a GStreamer capture pipeline backed by NVMM buffers that removes redundant host-device copies from three-camera sensing. Contrary to expectation, the conventional path fit the memory budget and dropped no frames; what zero-copy sensing recovers is CPU headroom (peak single-core utilization 98.0% to 77.0%) and worst-case latency (117.31 ms to 101.52 ms). Second, we train ACT and Diffusion Policy on identical demonstrations, each at its own reference budget (100k gradient steps for ACT, 200k for Diffusion Policy). ACT converges to a task-competent policy (19/20 trials) while Diffusion Policy does not converge to a usable one (0/10) even at twice the step count, which we attribute to differing convergence costs rather than an accuracy ceiling. Third, we convert ACT to TensorRT. FP16 reduces mean inference latency from 114.02 ms to 17.93 ms (6.4x) and INT8 to 12.65 ms (9.0x), with task success preserved at all three precisions (19/20, 18/20, 19/20). We report two findings not previously documented for ACT: TensorRT's general-purpose INT8 calibration quantizes the ResNet18 backbone but accepts zero of 145 transformer layers, explaining INT8's negligible size reduction over FP16 (0.9%) despite a further 28% latency gain; and the need for quantization is conditional on ACT's action-chunking configuration, feasible in full precision at n_action_steps = 100 but not at the per-step re-prediction temporal ensembling requires.
core_contributions: 构建了基于NVMM缓冲区的零拷贝感知管道，降低了CPU利用率和最坏情况延迟。
比较了ACT和扩散策略在嵌入式硬件上的训练收敛性，发现ACT收敛而扩散策略不收敛。
将ACT转换为TensorRT FP16和INT8，显著降低推理延迟且保持任务成功率。
揭示了ACT在TensorRT INT8量化中的新发现：Transformer层未被量化，量化需求取决于动作分块配置。
papers.abstract_zh: 通过模仿学习训练的双臂操作策略通常在工作站或数据中心级GPU上评估，导致在嵌入式硬件上部署的成本在很大程度上未被表征。我们提出了一个完全在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super（8 GB）上运行的双臂SO-101系统，仅使用桌面GPU（RTX 3070）进行离线训练，并在可变形豆袋的拾取和放置任务上进行了评估。首先，我们构建了一个由NVMM缓冲区支持的GStreamer捕获管道，消除了三摄像头感知中冗余的主机-设备拷贝。与预期相反，传统路径适合内存预算且没有丢帧；零拷贝感知恢复的是CPU余量（峰值单核利用率从98.0%降至77.0%）和最坏情况延迟（从117.31 ms降至101.52 ms）。其次，我们在相同的演示上训练ACT和扩散策略，每个策略使用各自的参考预算（ACT 100k梯度步，扩散策略200k梯度步）。ACT收敛到一个任务胜任的策略（19/20次试验），而扩散策略即使步数加倍也未收敛到可用策略（0/10），我们将其归因于不同的收敛成本而非准确率上限。第三，我们将ACT转换为TensorRT。FP16将平均推理延迟从114.02 ms降至17.93 ms（6.4倍），INT8降至12.65 ms（9.0倍），且所有三种精度下任务成功率保持不变（19/20、18/20、19/20）。我们报告了ACT之前未记录的两个发现：TensorRT的通用INT8校准量化了ResNet18骨干网络，但145个Transformer层均未被量化，解释了INT8相对于FP16的尺寸减小微不足道（0.9%），尽管延迟进一步降低了28%；以及量化的需求取决于ACT的动作分块配置，在n_action_steps=100时全精度可行，但在每步重新预测的时间集成所需时则不可行。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文在低成本嵌入式平台Jetson Orin Nano Super上实现了双臂操作，通过零拷贝感知和TensorRT量化ACT策略，在8GB内存预算下实现了高效推理和任务成功。
papers.research_problem: 在内存预算有限的嵌入式硬件上部署双臂操作策略的可行性和优化。
papers.method_summary: 使用GStreamer和NVMM缓冲区实现零拷贝三摄像头感知；训练ACT和扩散策略进行模仿学习；使用TensorRT对ACT进行FP16和INT8量化部署。
papers.experimental_setup: 硬件：NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super (8 GB)用于推理，RTX 3070用于离线训练；任务：可变形豆袋的拾取和放置；传感器：三摄像头；训练预算：ACT 100k梯度步，扩散策略200k梯度步；试验次数：ACT 20次，扩散策略10次。
papers.key_results: 零拷贝感知将峰值单核CPU利用率从98.0%降至77.0%，最坏情况延迟从117.31 ms降至101.52 ms；ACT在19/20次试验中成功，扩散策略在0/10次中成功；FP16推理延迟降低6.4倍，INT8降低9.0倍，成功率保持；INT8量化仅量化ResNet18，Transformer层未被量化，尺寸仅减小0.9%；量化需求取决于动作分块配置。

papers.title: Look Where It Matters: Adaptive Visual Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Visual representations of VLA models remain unreliable for spatially precise robotic manipulation. We uncover that vision encoders in VLAs also exhibit attention artifacts previously documented in generic Vision Transformers, and further show that, in embodied policies, these artifacts are closely associated with spatial perception capabilities acquired during post-training. As the encoder learns task-relevant information such as object location, depth ordering, and local geometry, limited global-token capacity causes part of this information to spill into low-information patch tokens. We introduce AtVLA, a framework that inserts learnable register tokens into the visual encoder. Trained end-to-end using only embodied data and the original action objective, these registers emerge as dedicated carriers of embodied spatial information, while the remaining patch tokens recover clean and spatially faithful attention distributions crucial for precise target localization and fine-grained contact. Clean attention restores reliable localization, but cannot recover geometric details lost in low-resolution observations. AtVLA therefore couples attention rectification with uncertainty-gated local refinement. The action expert samples multiple action chunks and estimates uncertainty from their disagreement; only for uncertain predictions, action-conditioned attention rollout identifies the task-relevant region, which is cropped, re-encoded at high resolution, and appended to the cached prefix for refined action generation. Across LIBERO, SimplerEnv, and a challenging single-view real-world benchmark, AtVLA improves the average LIBERO success rate from 94.2% to 98.4% and real-world success from 46.5% to 69.0%. The cropping is triggered on approximately 30% of replanning steps, resulting in only 1.4-1.6x the total computation of the base model under the representative deployment setting.
core_contributions: 发现VLA视觉编码器中的注意力伪影与后训练获得的空间感知能力相关。
提出AtVLA框架，通过插入可学习注册令牌来恢复干净的注意力分布。
结合注意力修正和不确定性门控局部细化，在低分辨率观测中恢复几何细节。
在多个基准上取得显著改进，计算开销小。
papers.abstract_zh: VLA模型的视觉表示对于空间精确的机器人操作仍然不可靠。我们发现VLA中的视觉编码器也表现出先前在通用视觉Transformer中记录的注意力伪影，并进一步表明，在具身策略中，这些伪影与后训练期间获得的空间感知能力密切相关。当编码器学习任务相关信息（如物体位置、深度顺序和局部几何形状）时，有限的全局令牌容量导致部分信息溢出到低信息补丁令牌中。我们引入了AtVLA，一个将可学习注册令牌插入视觉编码器的框架。仅使用具身数据和原始动作目标进行端到端训练，这些注册令牌成为具身空间信息的专用载体，而剩余的补丁令牌恢复干净且空间上忠实的注意力分布，这对于精确的目标定位和细粒度接触至关重要。干净的注意力恢复了可靠的定位，但无法恢复低分辨率观测中丢失的几何细节。因此，AtVLA将注意力修正与不确定性门控的局部细化相结合。动作专家采样多个动作块并从它们的分歧中估计不确定性；仅对于不确定的预测，动作条件注意力展开识别任务相关区域，该区域被裁剪、以高分辨率重新编码，并附加到缓存前缀以进行细化的动作生成。在LIBERO、SimplerEnv和一个具有挑战性的单视图真实世界基准上，AtVLA将平均LIBERO成功率从94.2%提高到98.4%，真实世界成功率从46.5%提高到69.0%。裁剪在约30%的重新规划步骤中触发，导致在代表性部署设置下总计算量仅为基础模型的1.4-1.6倍。
papers.summary_one_sentence: AtVLA通过插入可学习注册令牌和不确定性门控局部细化，改进了VLA模型在机器人操作中的视觉表示和空间精确性。

papers.title: TWINS: A Tactile Wearable Isomorphic Arm Networked System for Contact-Rich Manipulation Learning
papers.abstract: Recent advances in robot learning for manipulation have increased the importance of collecting real-world demonstration data. However, existing robotic systems primarily focus on end-effector manipulation, making it difficult to teach and execute manipulation tasks involving body-surface contact with the arms and chest. This paper presents TWINS (Tactile Wearable Isomorphic Arm Networked System), a robotic system for manipulation involving body-surface contact. TWINS consists of a Wearable Dual-Arm Device, which is worn by the operator, and an Isomorphic Robot with the same joint configuration and external dimensions. Distributed tactile sensors embedded in the chest and arms enable the measurement of body-surface contact synchronized with joint motion. Using the Wearable Dual-Arm Device, we collected demonstrations for four manipulation tasks involving body-surface contact. We then trained imitation learning policies using the collected demonstrations and deployed them on the Isomorphic Robot, enabling manipulation guided by body-surface tactile observations. Experimental results demonstrate that TWINS provides a unified robotic system for demonstration, learning, and execution of manipulation involving body-surface contact. https://mmurooka.github.io/twins-project-page/

papers.title: ChainVLA: Chaining Vision-Language-Action Queries through a Unified Execution State for Long-Horizon Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humans perform long-horizon manipulation by retaining knowledge of what earlier actions have established while continuously adapting the motion underway. By contrast, action-chunked vision-language-action (VLA) policies repeatedly replan from the current input at each query. Existing methods preserve either long-term task evidence through memory or short-term motion through action reuse and ensembling, leaving the cross-query handoff incomplete. We introduce ChainVLA, a 1.2B-parameter VLA policy that chains successive queries through a joint and revisable execution state. Progress Context combines a recurrent Working State with sparse event memory to carry observation-derived task progress, while Motion Tail feeds the preceding prediction's unexecuted continuation into state construction and action generation. Together, the two components condition a decoder that regenerates each action horizon under the latest observation, allowing the carried state to guide the next prediction without fixing it. ChainVLA reaches 62.8% average success on RMBench and 98.8% across four LIBERO suites, while removing Motion Tail or Progress Context reduces RMBench success to 11.2% and 3.0%, respectively. These asymmetric ablations are consistent with motion continuity helping preserve the observation stream from which task progress is inferred.
core_contributions: 提出ChainVLA，一个1.2B参数的VLA策略，通过联合且可修订的执行状态链接连续查询。
提出进度上下文（Progress Context）组件，结合循环工作状态和稀疏事件记忆，携带观察衍生的任务进度。
提出运动尾部（Motion Tail）组件，将先前预测的未执行延续输入状态构建和动作生成。
在RMBench和四个LIBERO套件上取得高成功率，消融实验证明各组件的必要性。
papers.abstract_zh: 人类通过保留先前动作建立的知识，同时不断调整进行中的运动，来执行长期操作。相比之下，动作分块的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略每次查询时从当前输入重复重新规划。现有方法通过记忆保留长期任务证据，或通过动作重用和集成保留短期运动，但跨查询的交接不完整。我们介绍ChainVLA，一个1.2B参数的VLA策略，通过联合且可修订的执行状态链接连续查询。进度上下文（Progress Context）结合循环工作状态（Working State）和稀疏事件记忆，携带观察衍生的任务进度，而运动尾部（Motion Tail）将先前预测的未执行延续输入状态构建和动作生成。两者共同条件化一个解码器，该解码器在最新观察下重新生成每个动作范围，允许携带的状态指导下一个预测而不固定它。ChainVLA在RMBench上达到62.8%的平均成功率，在四个LIBERO套件上达到98.8%，而移除运动尾部或进度上下文分别将RMBench成功率降至11.2%和3.0%。这些不对称消融与运动连续性有助于保留推断任务进度的观察流一致。

papers.title: ReTouch: Empowering Contact-Rich Dexterous Manipulation with Online-Refined Tactile Prediction
papers.abstract: Fusing tactile signals has proven effective for contact-rich manipulation, enabling robots to perceive contact states and adapt to rapidly changing physical interactions. Yet effectively integrating tactile feedback into dexterous manipulation remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce ReTouch, a vision-language-action model (VLA) that supports contact-rich dexterous manipulation through tactile predictions continually refined online using execution-time feedback. ReTouch builds on two main innovations for tactile representation and closed-loop action generation. First, its Tactile-Patch Encoder represents tactile observations as structured tactile patch features that preserve finger identity and local contact structure, providing contact cues for fine-grained dexterous control. Second, its high-frequency action module jointly predicts future tactile states and action chunks and refines both using incoming tactile feedback during execution. This closed-loop refinement keeps tactile predictions aligned with evolving physical interactions, enabling responsive action correction and improving robustness to contact changes and execution errors. We further introduce XHT-Dataset, comprising 900 real-world demonstrations across seven contact-rich tasks collected on an XHand--UR7e platform, and evaluate ReTouch through closed-loop real-robot experiments. ReTouch surpasses the strongest baseline by 18.4 and 23.8 percentage points in average success rate under standard and challenging conditions, respectively, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness.
core_contributions: 提出了Tactile-Patch Encoder，将触觉观察表示为结构化触觉补丁特征，保留手指身份和局部接触结构
提出了高频动作模块，联合预测未来触觉状态和动作块，并使用执行时触觉反馈进行闭环细化
引入了XHT-Dataset，包含900个真实世界演示和七个接触丰富任务
papers.abstract_zh: 融合触觉信号已被证明对接触丰富的操作有效，使机器人能够感知接触状态并适应快速变化的物理交互。然而，将触觉反馈有效整合到灵巧操作中仍未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们介绍了ReTouch，一种视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA），通过使用执行时反馈在线持续细化的触觉预测来支持接触丰富的灵巧操作。ReTouch建立在触觉表示和闭环动作生成的两个主要创新之上。首先，其触觉补丁编码器将触觉观察表示为结构化的触觉补丁特征，保留手指身份和局部接触结构，为细粒度灵巧控制提供接触线索。其次，其高频动作模块联合预测未来触觉状态和动作块，并在执行过程中使用传入的触觉反馈细化两者。这种闭环细化使触觉预测与演变的物理交互保持一致，实现响应式动作校正，并提高对接触变化和执行错误的鲁棒性。我们进一步引入了XHT-Dataset，包含在XHand-UR7e平台上收集的七个接触丰富任务的900个真实世界演示，并通过闭环真实机器人实验评估了ReTouch。在标准条件和挑战条件下，ReTouch的平均成功率分别超过最强基线18.4和23.8个百分点，展示了其有效性和鲁棒性。
papers.summary_one_sentence: ReTouch是一种视觉-语言-动作模型，通过在线细化的触觉预测实现接触丰富的灵巧操作，在真实机器人实验中显著优于基线。

papers.title: Learning Physical Interaction: A Survey of Tactile- and Force-aware Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Physically grounded robot intelligence requires robots to perceive, reason about, and regulate their interactions with the physical world. This capability is particularly critical in contact-sensitive manipulation, where successful task execution depends not only on visual perception and motion generation, but also on force regulation and adaptive control. In this context, recent robot learning methods have made substantial progress by integrating force, tactile, vision, language, and proprioceptive sensing into learned manipulation policies. In parallel, many systems adopt multi-phase architectures that combine high-level policies, action-refinement modules, and low-level controllers to bridge semantic task understanding with reactive physical execution. Despite these advances, existing surveys have not explicitly reviewed force- and tactile-aware robot learning from a unified perspective that jointly captures multimodal sensing and multi-phase system design. This survey addresses this gap by proposing TF-ART, a Tactile/Force-Aware Robot learning Taxonomy for multimodal and multi-phase frameworks, which maps individual methods into a unified hierarchical structure. The framework characterizes how recent works organize observation modalities, encode and fuse heterogeneous sensory inputs, generate and refine actions across multiple phases, and connect learned policies to reactive robot-end control. Building on this methodological view, we further examine the task settings and infrastructure requirements of physical interaction, thereby integrating both algorithmic and practical perspectives on force- and tactile-aware robot learning.
core_contributions: 提出了TF-ART分类法，用于系统地分类和描述力和触觉感知的机器人学习方法。
构建了统一的多模态多阶段框架，将各个方法映射到层次结构中。
整合了算法和实践视角，考察了物理交互的任务设置和基础设施需求。
papers.abstract_zh: 物理基础的机器人智能要求机器人感知、推理和调节它们与物理世界的交互。这种能力在接触敏感的操作中尤其关键，其中成功的任务执行不仅依赖于视觉感知和运动生成，还依赖于力调节和自适应控制。在此背景下，最近的机器人学习方法通过将力、触觉、视觉、语言和本体感觉集成到学习到的操作策略中取得了实质性进展。同时，许多系统采用多阶段架构，结合高层策略、动作细化模块和低层控制器，以桥接语义任务理解与反应性物理执行。尽管有这些进展，现有的综述尚未从统一的角度明确回顾力和触觉感知的机器人学习，该角度同时涵盖多模态感知和多阶段系统设计。本综述通过提出TF-ART（触觉/力感知机器人学习分类法）来填补这一空白，该分类法针对多模态和多阶段框架，将各个方法映射到一个统一的层次结构中。该框架描述了最近的工作如何组织观察模态、编码和融合异构感官输入、跨多个阶段生成和细化动作，以及将学习到的策略连接到反应性机器人末端控制。基于这种方法论视角，我们进一步考察了物理交互的任务设置和基础设施需求，从而整合了力和触觉感知机器人学习的算法和实践视角。

papers.title: RLMM-Flow: A Flow-based Mobile Manipulation Framework with Latent-Space Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Mobile manipulation requires generating whole-body action chunks that jointly satisfy goal reaching, collision avoidance, base kinematic constraints, manipulator joint limits, and trajectory smoothness. Flow-based generative policies provide an efficient paradigm for learning multimodal and temporally consistent motion priors from expert demonstrations, but imitation-only training cannot improve policy quality beyond the demonstration distribution. We propose RLMM-Flow, a flow-based mobile manipulation framework that combines expert flow-policy pretraining with latent-space reinforcement learning post-training. The framework first learns a flow policy that captures a multimodal whole-body motion prior from expert demonstrations. The pretrained flow policy is then frozen, while a latent steering network steers its initial noise toward higher-value action chunks. To stabilize high-dimensional latent optimization, we warm up an action-space critic before jointly training the latent critic and latent actor, and introduce coarse-to-fine latent steering that progressively expands control from a horizon-shared latent representation to a full-dimensional residual representation. Experiments on mobile manipulation motion-planning benchmarks show that RLMM-Flow substantially improves task success, collision avoidance, and trajectory quality over imitation-only flow policies and existing reinforcement learning post-training baselines, while preserving fast flow-based inference.
core_contributions: 提出RLMM-Flow框架，结合专家流策略预训练和潜在空间强化学习后训练。
引入潜在引导网络，在冻结预训练流策略后引导初始噪声向高价值动作。

引入动作空间评论家预热策略，稳定高维潜在优化。
在移动操作基准上显著提升任务成功、碰撞避免和轨迹质量，保持快速推理。
papers.abstract_zh: 移动操作需要生成全身动作块，这些动作块同时满足目标到达、碰撞避免、基座运动学约束、机械臂关节限制和轨迹平滑性。基于流的生成策略为从专家演示中学习多模态和时间一致的运动先验提供了一种高效范式，但仅模仿训练无法将策略质量提升到演示分布之外。我们提出RLMM-Flow，一种基于流的移动操作框架，结合了专家流策略预训练和潜在空间强化学习后训练。该框架首先学习一个流策略，从专家演示中捕获多模态全身运动先验。然后冻结预训练的流策略，同时一个潜在引导网络将其初始噪声引导向更高价值的动作块。为了稳定高维潜在优化，我们在联合训练潜在评论家和潜在演员之前预热一个动作空间评论家，并引入粗到细潜在引导，逐步将控制从共享潜在表示扩展到全维度残差表示。在移动操作运动规划基准上的实验表明，RLMM-Flow在任务成功、碰撞避免和轨迹质量上显著优于仅模仿的流策略和现有的强化学习后训练基线，同时保持快速的流推理。

papers.title: $N_0$-VTLA: Scaling Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Model with Latent Tactile Tokens
papers.abstract: We present $N_0$-VTLA, a vision-tactile-language-action (VTLA) foundation model capable of (1) fine-grained contact-rich manipulation with tactile perception and tactile-feedback control, and (2) offline policy improvement from stored deployment data. Building on current vision-based backbones, we propose a training recipe for tactile integration consisting of visuo-tactile pre-training, staged tactile-pathway integration, and advantage-conditioned offline policy improvement. During pre-training, the policy learns broad contact priors from NeoData, our large-scale visuo-tactile robot dataset; to our knowledge, $N_0$-VTLA is the first VTLA model pretrained on tactile data at scale. During post-training, we augment the policy with a predictive tactile pathway that distills the contact patterns learned at scale into the fine motion adjustments required by downstream tactile-centric manipulation. For offline policy improvement, we introduce ALTER, an advantage-conditioned offline reinforcement learning method that converts relative progress and trajectory-event comparisons into binary advantage labels for policy training on a fixed deployment corpus, further improving task-specific learning on contact-rich skills such as deformable object manipulation. Across contact-rich benchmarks, $N_0$-VTLA outperforms strong baselines by wide margins: it wins all nine real-robot NeoReal tasks and reaches 63.8% mean success on a twenty-task simulation suite, against 44.0% for the strongest baseline. $N_0$-VTLA policies trained with ALTER reach 75-95% success on three long-horizon real-robot tasks. These results lay a foundation for versatile tactile-driven manipulation policies.
core_contributions: 提出N0-VTLA，第一个在大规模触觉数据上预训练的视觉-触觉-语言-动作基础模型。
提出触觉集成训练配方，包括视觉-触觉预训练、分阶段触觉通路集成和优势条件离线策略改进。
构建大规模视觉-触觉机器人数据集NeoData，用于学习接触先验。
提出ALTER，一种优势条件离线强化学习方法，将相对进度和轨迹事件比较转换为二元优势标签进行策略训练。
在多个接触丰富基准测试上取得优异结果，包括9个真实机器人任务全胜和模拟套件63.8%平均成功率。
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了N0-VTLA，一个视觉-触觉-语言-动作（VTLA）基础模型，能够实现（1）具有触觉感知和触觉反馈控制的细粒度接触丰富操作，以及（2）从存储的部署数据中进行离线策略改进。基于当前的视觉骨干网络，我们提出了一种触觉集成的训练配方，包括视觉-触觉预训练、分阶段触觉通路集成和优势条件离线策略改进。在预训练期间，策略从我们的规模视觉-触觉机器人数据集NeoData中学习广泛的接触先验；据我们所知，N0-VTLA是第一个在大规模触觉数据上预训练的VTLA模型。在后训练期间，我们通过一个预测性触觉通路增强策略，将大规模学习的接触模式提炼为下游触觉中心操作所需的精细运动调整。对于离线策略改进，我们引入了ALTER，一种优势条件离线强化学习方法，将相对进度和轨迹事件比较转换为二元优势标签，用于在固定部署语料库上进行策略训练，进一步改进接触丰富技能（如可变形物体操作）上的任务特定学习。在接触丰富的基准测试中，N0-VTLA以较大优势超越了强基线：它赢得了所有九个真实机器人NeoReal任务，并在二十任务模拟套件上达到了63.8%的平均成功率，而最强基线为44.0%。使用ALTER训练的N0-VTLA策略在三个长时域真实机器人任务上达到了75-95%的成功率。这些结果为多功能触觉驱动操作策略奠定了基础。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出N0-VTLA，一个视觉-触觉-语言-动作基础模型，通过触觉集成训练配方和离线强化学习方法ALTER，在接触丰富操作任务上取得显著性能提升。

papers.title: Asynchronous Multimodal Diffusion Policy Composition via Latency-Aware Guidance Fusion
papers.abstract: Diffusion policies have shown strong potential for robotic imitation learning, and recent extensions incorporate additional modalities to improve manipulation performance. However, these modalities often differ not only in information content but also in sensing rates and inference latencies. Existing multimodal diffusion policies typically rely on synchronous fusion or manually designed multi-frequency architectures, which either slow down high-frequency feedback or limit extensibility to new modality combinations. We propose LAG-Fusion, a latency-aware guidance fusion framework for asynchronous multimodal diffusion policy composition. LAG-Fusion allows modality-specific policies to operate at their native inference rates and contribute denoising guidance whenever available. To make asynchronous composition consistent, we derive a reference-frame rebasing rule for diffusion variables under relative action representations, enabling delayed guidance to be aligned before fusion. We instantiate LAG-Fusion in contact-rich manipulation by composing a low-frequency vision policy with a high-frequency force policy. Experiments under heterogeneous modality latencies show that LAG-Fusion improves policy responsiveness and task performance over synchronous fusion and specially designed force-aware baselines.
core_contributions: 提出LAG-Fusion，一个延迟感知的引导融合框架，允许模态特定策略以原生推理速率异步运行并提供去噪引导。
推导了相对动作表示下扩散变量的参考帧重基规则，使延迟引导在融合前对齐，保证异步组合的一致性。
在接触丰富操作任务中实例化LAG-Fusion，组合低频视觉策略和高频力策略，实验验证其有效性。
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散策略在机器人模仿学习中显示出强大潜力，最近的扩展加入了额外模态以提升操作性能。然而，这些模态不仅在信息内容上不同，在感知速率和推理延迟上也往往不同。现有的多模态扩散策略通常依赖同步融合或手动设计的多频率架构，这要么减慢高频反馈，要么限制对新模态组合的可扩展性。我们提出LAG-Fusion，一个延迟感知的引导融合框架，用于异步多模态扩散策略组合。LAG-Fusion允许模态特定策略以其原生推理速率运行，并在可用时提供去噪引导。为了使异步组合一致，我们推导了相对动作表示下扩散变量的参考帧重基规则，使延迟引导在融合前对齐。我们在接触丰富的操作中实例化LAG-Fusion，通过组合低频视觉策略和高频力策略。在异构模态延迟下的实验表明，LAG-Fusion相比同步融合和专门设计的力感知基线，提高了策略响应性和任务性能。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出LAG-Fusion框架，通过延迟感知的引导融合实现异步多模态扩散策略组合，在接触丰富操作中提升响应性和性能。

papers.title: BayesContact: Uncertain Pose Estimation via Visuo-Tactile Proposals and Simulation-based Inference
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires pose estimates that are often more accurate than what depth-only sensing provides. Existing methods, relying on vision and contact, employ costly offline training procedures that need to be retrained for new environments and geometries. We propose BayesContact, a Simulation-Based Inference framework for visuo-tactile pose estimation in peg-in-hole insertion. BayesContact maintains a particle belief over object pose and fuses depth observations with force/torque-derived contact evidence. We employ simulation based forward models to approximate these observation likelihoods. For each pose hypothesis, a renderer predicts depth measurements and a physics simulator predicts contact outcomes under guarded probing actions; both are scored against real observations to update the belief. The resulting multimodal belief also enables information-gain-based probing for active disambiguation. Across simulated geometries and real-robot experiments, BayesContact improves pose observability and insertion success over vision-only inference by 30%
core_contributions: 提出BayesContact，一种基于模拟推理的视觉-触觉姿态估计框架，无需离线训练即可适应新环境。
采用粒子信念维护姿态，融合深度观测和力/力矩接触证据。
使用基于模拟的前向模型（渲染器和物理模拟器）近似观测似然，实现无模型似然估计。
实现基于信息增益的主动探测策略，利用多模态信念进行主动消歧。
在模拟和真实机器人实验中，姿态可观测性和插入成功率比纯视觉推理提高30%。
papers.abstract_zh: 接触丰富的操作需要通常比仅深度传感提供的更准确的姿态估计。现有方法依赖视觉和接触，采用昂贵的离线训练程序，需要针对新环境和几何形状重新训练。我们提出BayesContact，一种基于模拟推理的框架，用于插销入孔中的视觉-触觉姿态估计。BayesContact维护关于物体姿态的粒子信念，并将深度观测与力/力矩导出的接触证据融合。我们采用基于模拟的前向模型来近似这些观测似然。对于每个姿态假设，渲染器预测深度测量，物理模拟器在受保护的探测动作下预测接触结果；两者都与真实观测进行评分以更新信念。得到的多模态信念还支持基于信息增益的探测以进行主动消歧。在模拟几何形状和真实机器人实验中，BayesContact将姿态可观测性和插入成功率比仅视觉推理提高了30%。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出BayesContact，一种基于模拟推理的视觉-触觉姿态估计框架，通过粒子滤波融合深度和接触信息，在插销入孔任务中比纯视觉方法提高30%的成功率和可观测性。

papers.method_summary: BayesContact使用粒子滤波维护姿态信念。对于每个粒子（姿态假设），通过渲染器预测深度图像，通过物理模拟器预测在探测动作下的接触结果。然后将预测与真实深度观测和接触观测进行比较，计算似然并更新粒子权重。此外，利用信念的多模态性计算信息增益，选择最优探测动作以主动消歧。

papers.title: Scalable Open-Source Visuotactile Sensor for 6-Axis Contact Wrench Estimation in Tensegrity Robots
papers.abstract: This paper presents a scalable, open-source visuotactile sensing system for tensegrity robots that enables six-axis wrench estimation and contact detection. The proposed endcap sensor integrates an elastomeric shell, a 3D-printed thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) interface, and a rigid base housing an embedded camera and LED illumination ring. A novel gyroid-infill bonding technique is introduced to form a durable elastomer-TPU interface without adhesives, yielding a lightweight and modular design compatible with large-scale tensegrity structures. A tactile-to-wrench neural network maps shear vector fields to six-dimensional force and torque measurements. Experimental results demonstrate accurate and stable wrench estimation with a mean squared error (MSE) of 0.1531 on static validation data and out-of-domain generalization under dynamic motion. Furthermore, full-system integration on a 12 kg tensegrity robot confirms the sensor's ability to reliably identify ground contacts. The system substantially improves the practicality of tactile feedback for tensegrity robots, offering a low-cost, reproducible, and physically interpretable pathway toward contact-aware proprioception and state estimation. Open source files are available at \href{https://github.com/Jonathan-Twz/tensegrity-gelfoot}{github.com/Jonathan-Twz/tensegrity-gelfoot}
core_contributions: 提出了一种集成弹性外壳、3D打印TPU接口和嵌入式相机的端盖传感器设计。
引入了一种新颖的gyroid填充粘合技术，无需粘合剂形成耐用的弹性体-TPU接口。
开发了一个触觉到力/力矩的神经网络，将剪切矢量场映射到六维力和力矩。
实验验证了静态和动态下的准确力/力矩估计，并在12kg张拉整体机器人上验证了地面接触识别。
开源了设计和代码。

papers.title: A Model-Based Decoupling Strategy for Proprioception and Contact Sensing in an Architected Soft Manipulator
papers.abstract: Soft continuum robots require embedded sensing for proprioception and contact detection, yet integrating sensors into sparse, highly deformable architected structures remains challenging. We present a model-based strategy that decouples proprioceptive and contact signals from a common set of fluidic pressure sensors embedded in a soft architected segment. Each segment of the Innervated Trimmed Helicoid (ITH) contains six air channels routed in a localized zigzag pattern along the circumference. With only three principal kinematic degrees of freedom (axial compression, bending in x, bending in y), the six pressure readings form an overdetermined system. A piecewise constant curvature model maps pressures to shape, and Huber regression identifies outlier channels whose residuals indicate external contact. On a single ITH segment, this approach achieves proprioceptive shape estimation with a relative bending error of 0.11 +/- 0.02 and a contact detection rate of 97% across 178 trials. We integrate eight ITH segments into Air-Helix, a tendon-driven soft continuum manipulator, and present exploratory whole-arm demonstrations that include tactile teaching by demonstration, admittance-controlled force regulation, and tactile object reconstruction. The results suggest that localized fluidic innervation combined with model-based redundancy resolution is a practical path toward concurrent proprioception and contact sensing in architected soft robots.
core_contributions: 提出了一种基于模型的策略，将本体感觉和接触信号从一组流体压力传感器中解耦。
使用分段常数曲率模型和Huber回归实现形状估计和接触检测。
在单个ITH段上验证了形状估计和接触检测性能。
将八个ITH段集成为肌腱驱动的软体连续机械臂Air-Helix，并展示了触觉示教、力调节和物体重建等应用。
papers.abstract_zh: 软体连续机器人需要嵌入式感知用于本体感觉和接触检测，但在稀疏、高度可变形结构化结构中集成传感器仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种基于模型的策略，将本体感觉和接触信号从嵌入在软体结构化段中的一组流体压力传感器中解耦。每个Innervated Trimmed Helicoid (ITH)段包含六个空气通道，沿圆周局部锯齿形布线。只有三个主要运动学自由度（轴向压缩、x弯曲、y弯曲），六个压力读数形成超定系统。分段常数曲率模型将压力映射到形状，Huber回归识别异常通道，其残差指示外部接触。在单个ITH段上，该方法实现了本体感觉形状估计，相对弯曲误差为0.11±0.02，接触检测率为97%（178次试验）。我们将八个ITH段集成到Air-Helix中，这是一个肌腱驱动的软体连续机械臂，并展示了探索性全臂演示，包括触觉示教、导纳控制力调节和触觉物体重建。结果表明，局部流体神经支配结合基于模型的冗余解析是实现结构化软体机器人中同时本体感觉和接触感知的实用途径。
