papers.title: Beyond Implicit Force: Evaluating Explicit Force-Torque Proxies in Action Chunking with Transformers
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires policies to infer interaction state from signals that are often weakly observable through vision and kinematics alone. Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) has shown strong performance in fine-grained manipulation, but many deployments collect demonstrations through leader-follower teleoperation, where tracking error between commanded leader motion and executed follower motion implicitly encodes contact, resistance, and constraint violation. This paper examines whether ACT's apparent force-awareness depends on this hidden interaction cue. We introduce an observation-centric ACT variant that predicts future follower joint states instead of leader commands, thereby removing the teleoperation-induced discrepancy signal while preserving the rest of the learning pipeline. We then evaluate whether simple joint-torque proxies, derived from onboard motor current or joint effort, can recover contact-aware behavior without external force/torque sensors. Across four real-world tasks spanning surface following, insertion, stiffness discrimination, and force-based stopping, removing the implicit cue leads to severe failures in force-critical phases. In contrast, torque-augmented policies recover robust contact behavior and improve the base ACT policy. These results demonstrate that, on real hardware, the implicit teleoperation cue is a recoverable source of force-awareness, where torque signals are available, a simple proxy matches, surpasses, or further enhances it.
core_contributions: 引入了一个以观察为中心的ACT变体，通过预测跟随者关节状态来消除遥操作差异信号，从而隔离隐式力线索的影响。
评估了简单关节扭矩代理（来自机载电机电流或关节力）在无外部力传感器情况下恢复接触感知行为的能力。
在四个真实世界任务中证明了隐式线索对力关键阶段的重要性，以及扭矩代理能够匹配或超越隐式线索的性能。
papers.abstract_zh: 接触丰富的操作需要策略从信号中推断交互状态，这些信号通常通过视觉和运动学难以直接观察。基于Transformer的动作分块（ACT）在精细操作中表现出色，但许多部署通过主从遥操作收集演示，其中命令的领导者运动和执行的跟随者运动之间的跟踪误差隐式编码了接触、阻力和约束违反。本文研究了ACT的明显力感知是否依赖于这种隐藏的交互线索。我们引入了一个以观察为中心的ACT变体，它预测未来的跟随者关节状态而不是领导者命令，从而消除了遥操作引起的差异信号，同时保留了其余的学习流程。然后，我们评估了简单的关节扭矩代理（来自机载电机电流或关节力）是否可以在没有外部力/扭矩传感器的情况下恢复接触感知行为。在四个真实世界任务（表面跟随、插入、刚度辨别和基于力的停止）中，消除隐式线索导致力关键阶段的严重失败。相比之下，扭矩增强策略恢复了稳健的接触行为并改进了基础ACT策略。这些结果表明，在真实硬件上，隐式遥操作线索是可恢复的力感知来源，在扭矩信号可用的情况下，简单的代理匹配、超越或进一步增强它。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文研究了Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) 在接触丰富操作中隐式力感知线索的作用，并评估了简单关节扭矩代理作为替代方案的可行性。
papers.research_problem: ACT在接触丰富的操作中是否依赖于遥操作中隐式的力线索？简单的关节扭矩代理能否替代这种隐式线索以恢复接触感知行为？

papers.title: KineFuse: Kinematic-Aware Haptic Fusion for In-Hand Occluded-Object Pose Tracking
papers.abstract: Dexterous in-hand manipulation requires continuous 6D pose tracking, yet the manipulating fingers inevitably occlude the object from the camera. We study how to structure the sparse haptic signals already available on multi-fingered hands, including proprioception, proximal force/torque, and binary contact, to complement a pretrained visual pose tracker under occlusion. We propose a kinematic-aware finger-level encoder and systematically compare it against four alternative designs through three levels of evaluation: per-frame refinement, sequential open-loop tracking, and closed-loop manipulation. Our experiments reveal that (i) per-frame evaluation cannot distinguish encoder quality, while sequential tracking amplifies architectural differences by up to 15 times; (ii) the structured encoder learns task-specific cross-modal gating, using vision exclusively for translation and dedicating one attention head to haptics for rotation, without explicit supervision; and (iii) compact finger-level tokenization with 4 tokens outperforms both flat fusion and joint-level representations, which suppress vision through norm dominance. We validate that improved tracking yields higher success in a downstream reorientation task and provide qualitative real-world demonstrations. Our project page is available at https://cold-young.github.io/kine-fuse/.
core_contributions: 提出了运动学感知的手指级编码器（kinematic-aware finger-level encoder）
系统地比较了四种替代设计，并通过三个层次评估（逐帧细化、序列开环跟踪、闭环操作）
揭示了逐帧评估无法区分编码器质量，序列跟踪放大架构差异高达15倍
发现结构化编码器学习任务特定的跨模态门控，视觉专用于平移，触觉专用于旋转
证明紧凑的手指级令牌化（4个令牌）优于扁平融合和关节级表示
验证改进的跟踪在下游重定向任务中成功率更高，并提供真实世界演示
papers.abstract_zh: 灵巧手内操作需要连续的6D姿态跟踪，然而操作手指不可避免地会遮挡相机中的物体。我们研究如何利用多指手上已有的稀疏触觉信号，包括本体感觉、近端力/扭矩和二进制接触，来补充预训练的视觉姿态跟踪器在遮挡下的表现。我们提出了一种运动学感知的手指级编码器，并通过三个层次的评估（逐帧细化、序列开环跟踪和闭环操作）系统地将其与四种替代设计进行比较。我们的实验揭示：(i) 逐帧评估无法区分编码器质量，而序列跟踪将架构差异放大高达15倍；(ii) 结构化编码器学习任务特定的跨模态门控，在无显式监督的情况下，专门使用视觉进行平移，并分配一个注意力头给触觉用于旋转；(iii) 紧凑的手指级令牌化（4个令牌）优于扁平融合和关节级表示，后者通过范数主导抑制视觉。我们验证了改进的跟踪在下游重定向任务中带来更高的成功率，并提供了定性的真实世界演示。我们的项目页面可在 https://cold-young.github.io/kine-fuse/ 获取。

papers.key_results: (i) 逐帧评估无法区分编码器质量，序列跟踪将架构差异放大高达15倍；(ii) 结构化编码器学习任务特定的跨模态门控，视觉专门用于平移，一个注意力头专门用于触觉旋转；(iii) 紧凑的手指级令牌化（4个令牌）优于扁平融合和关节级表示。改进的跟踪提高了下游重定向任务的成功率。

papers.title: VTAP Gripper: Synergizing Fingertip Sensing and a Visuo-Tactile Active Palm for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation
papers.abstract: This paper presents a tactile-reactive gripper that integrates a Visuo-Tactile Active Palm (VTAP) and compliant, reconfigurable fingers equipped with tactile array sensors. The design exploits structured finger-palm synergy and multi-modal perception to achieve both robust grasping and fine manipulation. The actuated bi-modal palm seamlessly combines long-range visual localization with contact-rich tactile feedback, substantially extending the system's manipulation capability. To bridge the embodiment gap between human hand motion and the heterogeneous three-finger structure, we further propose a staged, gesture-conditioned retargeting framework for dexterous teleoperation. Extensive experiments validate the system across a range of challenging tasks: reactive grasping of YCB and fragile objects, in-hand syringe reorientation and plunger actuation, singulation of clustered objects down to 3 mm in diameter, and vision-tactile peg-in-hole insertion. Results demonstrate that high manipulation performance can be achieved through coordinated finger-palm interaction and multi-modal sensing, without resorting to high degrees of freedom anthropomorphic designs. The VTAP gripper and its retargeting framework offer a practical reference architecture for dexterous gripper design, manipulation, and contact-rich data collection in support of learning-based approaches. Project webpage: https://yuhochau.github.io/vtap/.
core_contributions: 设计了集成视觉触觉主动手掌（VTAP）和触觉阵列传感器的柔性可重构手指的抓取器。
提出了手指-手掌协同和多模态感知策略，实现稳健抓取和精细操作。
提出了分阶段的、手势条件化的重定向框架，用于灵巧遥操作。
在多种挑战性任务上验证了系统性能，包括YCB物体抓取、手内操作、小物体分离和销孔插入。
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种触觉反应抓取器，它集成了视觉触觉主动手掌（VTAP）和配备触觉阵列传感器的柔性可重构手指。该设计利用结构化的手指-手掌协同和多模态感知，实现了稳健的抓取和精细操作。主动双模态手掌无缝结合了远程视觉定位和接触丰富的触觉反馈，显著扩展了系统的操作能力。为了弥合人手运动与异质三指结构之间的具身差距，我们进一步提出了一个分阶段的、手势条件化的重定向框架，用于灵巧遥操作。大量实验验证了该系统在一系列挑战性任务上的表现：YCB和易碎物体的反应抓取、手内注射器重新定向和柱塞驱动、聚类物体分离（直径小至3毫米），以及视觉触觉销孔插入。结果表明，通过协调的手指-手掌交互和多模态感知可以实现高操作性能，而无需高自由度拟人设计。VTAP抓取器及其重定向框架为灵巧抓取器设计、操作和接触丰富数据收集提供了实用参考架构，支持基于学习的方法。项目网页：https://yuhochau.github.io/vtap/。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出了一种集成视觉触觉主动手掌和触觉手指的抓取器，通过手指-手掌协同和多模态感知实现灵巧操作，并提出了手势条件化重定向框架用于遥操作。
papers.research_problem: 如何通过手指-手掌协同和多模态感知实现灵巧的抓取和操作，以及如何弥合人手运动与机器人手之间的具身差距。
papers.method_summary: VTAP抓取器包括一个主动双模态手掌，结合视觉定位和触觉反馈，以及三个配备触觉阵列传感器的柔性手指。通过结构化手指-手掌协同实现操作。重定向框架采用分阶段手势条件化方法，将人手运动映射到三指结构。

papers.key_results: 通过协调的手指-手掌交互和多模态感知实现了高操作性能，无需高自由度拟人设计。系统成功完成了多种挑战性任务，包括抓取、手内操作、小物体分离和精密插入。

papers.title: Never Too Late for Force: Accelerating VLA Post-Training with Reactive Force Injection
papers.abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide strong language-conditioned manipulation knowledge, but they remain largely vision-driven and can struggle once manipulation enters contact states where the scene is occluded, depth is ambiguous, or small force errors push execution off the offline demonstration distribution. We present LIFT (Late Reactive Injection of Force for VLA Post-Training), a force-aware post-training framework that adds contact reactivity to a pretrained VLA policy while preserving its general manipulation knowledge. LIFT grafts a reactive action expert beside the original action expert, initializes it from pretrained action weights, and injects recent 6D end-effector force through causal force memory and zero-initialized cross attention, enabling actions to be refreshed during execution. To address the policy-dependent distribution shift of contact feedback, LIFT further couples reactive force injection with an online DAgger loop that trains on a mixture of offline task-alignment data and human-corrected online rollouts. Across towel folding, book insertion, and Hanoi ring placement, LIFT learns faster and reaches higher performance than vision-only post-training, while ablations show that reactive force memory and online corrective data are both important for robust contact-rich manipulation. Our code and data will be publicly available.
core_contributions: 提出LIFT框架，在预训练VLA策略中嫁接反应性动作专家并注入力信息。
采用因果力记忆和零初始化交叉注意力实现反应性力注入。
结合在线DAgger循环处理接触反馈的策略依赖分布偏移。
在毛巾折叠、书籍插入和汉诺塔环放置任务上验证了方法的有效性。
papers.abstract_zh: 预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略提供了强大的语言条件操作知识，但它们仍然主要是视觉驱动的，一旦操作进入接触状态，场景被遮挡、深度模糊或小的力误差导致执行偏离离线演示分布，它们就会遇到困难。我们提出了LIFT（Late Reactive Injection of Force for VLA Post-Training），一个力感知的后训练框架，为预训练的VLA策略增加接触反应性，同时保留其通用操作知识。LIFT在原始动作专家旁边嫁接一个反应性动作专家，从预训练的动作权重初始化，并通过因果力记忆和零初始化的交叉注意力注入最近的6D末端执行器力，使得动作在执行过程中能够刷新。为了解决接触反馈的策略依赖分布偏移，LIFT进一步将反应性力注入与在线DAgger循环相结合，该循环在离线任务对齐数据和人工纠正的在线rollouts的混合上进行训练。在毛巾折叠、书籍插入和汉诺塔环放置任务中，LIFT比纯视觉后训练学习更快，达到更高性能，而消融实验表明反应力记忆和在线纠正数据对于鲁棒的接触丰富操作都很重要。我们的代码和数据将公开。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出LIFT框架，通过嫁接反应性动作专家、因果力记忆和在线DAgger循环，为预训练VLA策略注入接触反应性，在接触丰富任务上实现更快学习和更高性能。
papers.research_problem: 预训练的VLA策略在接触操作中因视觉遮挡、深度模糊和力误差而表现不佳，需要增强其接触反应能力同时保留通用操作知识。
papers.method_summary: LIFT在原始动作专家旁嫁接一个反应性动作专家，从预训练权重初始化，通过因果力记忆和零初始化交叉注意力注入最近的6D末端执行器力，使动作在执行过程中刷新。同时，结合在线DAgger循环，在离线任务对齐数据和人工纠正的在线rollouts混合上训练，以解决分布偏移。
papers.experimental_setup: 在毛巾折叠、书籍插入和汉诺塔环放置三个接触丰富操作任务上进行评估；具体硬件和数据集细节无法从摘要确认。
papers.key_results: LIFT比纯视觉后训练学习更快，达到更高性能；消融实验表明反应力记忆和在线纠正数据对鲁棒接触操作都很重要。
papers.why_it_matters: 这项工作解决了VLA策略在接触操作中的关键不足，通过注入力反馈显著提升了鲁棒性和性能，对于机器人接触丰富操作任务具有重要价值。

papers.title: Kepler-Encoder-v0.1: Towards a Multimodal Embedding Model for Robots
papers.abstract: A robot must understand the state of its own body, but a camera sees only part of it. Force and contact leave almost no trace in a single frame, and raw vision features read force at $R^2$ at or below $0.10$ on every robot we test. We present Kepler-Encoder-v0.1, a robot-first multimodal encoder that treats robot state as a modality and fuses vision, proprioception, and force/torque into a single shared latent with a learned-query cross-attention layer, trained self-supervised by masked cross-modal prediction under the LeJEPA/SIGReg objective. At evaluation only vision enters, which poses a sharp question. Does fusing state into training make the vision-only latent carry anything the pixels do not already contain? On the RH20T corpus the answer is yes, precisely where the camera is weakest. On held-out scenes, the vision-only latent recovers end-effector state, and force in particular, significantly above both raw frozen-ViT features and a compute-matched vision-only control on every sensored robot, though absolute force recovery at a single timestep is modest; on motor state, which the camera largely sees, it is statistically tied with the strongest vision baselines, and it is the only feature whose latent geometry tracks state. A single embodiment-agnostic encoder covers four robots, and a data-matched control shows this breadth reflects embodiment diversity rather than data volume. The frozen latent is directly useful. Its own cross-modal prediction error is a training-free invalid-state monitor (AUROC $0.90$ on out-of-range states, $0.69$ on scene-swapped states), and a diffusion decoder (PixNerd) reconstructs the camera frame from the latent, confirming the spatial compression preserves world-state. This report validates the single-timestep case; native-rate temporal fusion is the next step.
core_contributions: 提出Kepler-Encoder-v0.1，一个机器人优先的多模态编码器，将机器人状态（本体感觉、力/扭矩）作为模态与视觉融合。
使用LeJEPA/SIGReg自监督掩码跨模态预测目标进行训练，无需标注数据。
在评估时仅使用视觉输入，但潜在表示在力恢复等任务上显著优于纯视觉基线，且是唯一潜在几何跟踪状态的表示。
单一编码器覆盖四个不同机器人，体现具体机器人多样性而非数据量。
冻结的潜在表示可直接用作无需训练的无效状态监控器（AUROC 0.90/0.69），并可通过扩散解码器重建图像，确认空间压缩保留世界状态。
papers.abstract_zh: 机器人必须理解自身身体的状态，但摄像头只能看到其中一部分。力和接触在单帧中几乎没有留下痕迹，并且在我们测试的每个机器人上，原始视觉特征对力的预测R^2低于0.10。我们提出了Kepler-Encoder-v0.1，一个机器人优先的多模态编码器，它将机器人状态视为一种模态，并通过学习的查询交叉注意力层将视觉、本体感觉和力/扭矩融合到一个共享的潜在空间中，使用LeJEPA/SIGReg目标进行自监督掩码跨模态预测训练。在评估时，只有视觉输入，这提出了一个尖锐的问题：将状态融合到训练中是否使得仅视觉的潜在表示包含了像素本身没有的信息？在RH20T语料库上，答案是肯定的，正好在摄像头最弱的地方。在保留的场景上，仅视觉的潜在表示恢复了末端执行器状态，特别是力，显著高于原始冻结的ViT特征和计算匹配的仅视觉控制，尽管单时间步的绝对力恢复是适度的；在电机状态（摄像头基本能看到）上，它与最强的视觉基线统计上持平，并且它是唯一潜在几何跟踪状态的表示。一个单一的与具体机器人无关的编码器覆盖了四个机器人，数据匹配的控制显示这种广度反映了具体机器人的多样性而非数据量。冻结的潜在表示直接有用：它自己的跨模态预测误差是一个无需训练的状态无效监控器（对超出范围的状态AUROC为0.90，对场景交换的状态为0.69），一个扩散解码器（PixNerd）从潜在表示重建相机帧，确认空间压缩保留了世界状态。本报告验证了单时间步情况；原生速率时间融合是下一步。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出Kepler-Encoder-v0.1，一个机器人优先的多模态编码器，通过自监督掩码跨模态预测训练融合视觉、本体感觉和力/扭矩，使得仅视觉的潜在表示在摄像头弱项（如力预测）上显著优于纯视觉基线。
papers.research_problem: 机器人如何理解自身身体状态，特别是摄像头无法直接观测的力和接触？原始视觉特征对力预测效果差（R^2低于0.10）。
papers.method_summary: Kepler-Encoder-v0.1使用学习的查询交叉注意力层将视觉、本体感觉和力/扭矩融合到共享潜在空间，通过自监督掩码跨模态预测（LeJEPA/SIGReg）训练。训练时随机掩码某些模态，预测被掩码的模态。评估时只输入视觉，潜在表示通过跨模态预测误差等用于下游任务。
papers.experimental_setup: 在RH20T语料库上进行实验，涉及四个机器人。比较基线包括原始冻结ViT特征和计算匹配的仅视觉控制。评估任务包括末端执行器状态恢复（特别是力）、电机状态恢复，以及无效状态监控（AUROC）。使用PixNerd扩散解码器从潜在表示重建图像。具体训练参数和数据集划分未在摘要中详述。
papers.key_results: 在力恢复上，仅视觉潜在表示显著高于原始冻结ViT特征和计算匹配的仅视觉控制，但单时间步绝对力恢复适度；在电机状态上与最强视觉基线统计持平；是唯一潜在几何跟踪状态的表示。无效状态监控AUROC达到0.90（超出范围状态）和0.69（场景交换状态）。图像重建确认潜在表示保留了世界状态。

papers.title: One-Shot Multimodal Learning from Demonstration with Force-Constrained Elastic Maps
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation tasks often require simultaneous reasoning over motion and contact forces, yet most Learning from Demonstration (LfD) methods model only spatial trajectories and neglect force interactions with the environment. This limitation reduces robustness and can lead to unsafe or inconsistent task reproduction in force-constrained settings. We propose a novel one-shot multimodal LfD framework for the segmentation, encoding, and reproduction of force-inclusive demonstrations. First, we introduce a multimodal probabilistic segmentation method that adaptively weighs spatial and force modalities over time, enabling the automatic extraction of force-aware motion primitives. Second, we extend the elastic maps representation to incorporate external force constraints during skill encoding and formulate a convex optimization procedure for learning force-consistent trajectory models. The resulting skills reproduce both motion and contact characteristics from a single demonstration while promoting safer execution by accounting for demonstrated force profiles. We validate our approach on five real-world manipulation tasks across two distinct force-sensing configurations: wrist force sensing on a UR5e with a Robotiq 2f-85 gripper and finger force sensing on a Kinova Gen3 with an Openhand Model O gripper. Experimental results demonstrate robust multimodal segmentation, accurate force-aware reproduction, and cross-platform generality.
core_contributions: 提出一种多模态概率分割方法，自适应加权空间和力模态，自动提取力感知运动基元。
扩展弹性图表示以纳入外力约束，并制定凸优化过程学习力一致轨迹模型。

papers.title: TouchWorld: A Predictive and Reactive Tactile Foundation Model for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation in everyday environments requires both anticipation and reaction: a robot must predict how contact should evolve while rapidly correcting local errors caused by slip, misalignment, unstable grasping, or force mismatch. Vision and language provide semantic and geometric guidance, but they cannot reliably reveal hidden contact states such as force, slip, and contact stability. Although tactile sensing exposes these physical cues, most existing policies treat touch as a low-frequency observation stream within a monolithic action model, coupling slow task reasoning, action generation, and fast contact feedback in a single loop. We introduce TouchWorld, a predictive-and-reactive tactile foundation model for dexterous manipulation. TouchWorld uses a hierarchical policy that separates vision-language subtask planning, tactile world-model prediction, visuo-tactile goal-conditioned action generation, and high-frequency tactile residual refinement. A High-Level Planning Layer produces executable subtasks and predicts tactile subgoals; a Visuo-Tactile Goal-Conditioned Policy generates nominal action chunks; and a Tactile-Conditioned Refinement Policy performs online residual correction using recent tactile and proprioceptive feedback. By using touch as both a predictive contact reference and a fast feedback signal, TouchWorld preserves the semantic generalization of vision-language-action policies while improving local contact adaptation. Across six long-horizon and contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks, TouchWorld achieves 65.0% success in the clean setting and 53.7% success under human perturbations, outperforming the strongest baseline by 15.7 and 18.5 percentage points, respectively.
core_contributions: 提出了TouchWorld，一个预测和反应的触觉基础模型，用于灵巧操作。
设计了分层策略，分离视觉-语言子任务规划、触觉世界模型预测、视觉-触觉目标条件动作生成和高频触觉残差细化。
通过将触觉同时用作预测接触参考和快速反馈信号，保留了语义泛化能力并改进了局部接触适应。
在六个长时域和接触丰富的灵巧操作任务上，TouchWorld在干净和扰动设置下均显著优于最强基线。
papers.abstract_zh: 灵巧操作在日常环境中需要预测和反应：机器人必须预测接触如何演变，同时快速纠正由滑动、错位、抓取不稳定或力不匹配引起的局部错误。视觉和语言提供语义和几何指导，但它们无法可靠地揭示隐藏的接触状态，如力、滑动和接触稳定性。尽管触觉感知暴露了这些物理线索，但大多数现有策略将触觉视为低频观测流，嵌入在单一动作模型中，将慢速任务推理、动作生成和快速接触反馈耦合在单个循环中。我们提出TouchWorld，一个用于灵巧操作的预测和反应触觉基础模型。TouchWorld使用分层策略，将视觉-语言子任务规划、触觉世界模型预测、视觉-触觉目标条件动作生成和高频触觉残差细化分离。高层规划层产生可执行的子任务并预测触觉子目标；视觉-触觉目标条件策略生成名义动作块；触觉条件细化策略使用最近的触觉和本体感受反馈进行在线残差修正。通过将触觉同时用作预测接触参考和快速反馈信号，TouchWorld保留了视觉-语言-动作策略的语义泛化能力，同时改进了局部接触适应。在六个长时域和接触丰富的灵巧操作任务中，TouchWorld在干净设置下达到65.0%的成功率，在人为扰动下达到53.7%的成功率，分别比最强基线高出15.7和18.5个百分点。
papers.summary_one_sentence: TouchWorld是一个预测和反应的触觉基础模型，通过分层策略分离视觉-语言规划、触觉预测、动作生成和触觉残差修正，在灵巧操作任务上显著优于基线。

papers.title: Deform360: A Massive Multi-view Visuotactile Dataset for Deformable World Models
papers.abstract: Predicting object dynamics (i.e., world modeling) is a fundamental challenge for robotic manipulation, and modeling deformable objects presents a particularly difficult case due to their high-dimensional state spaces and complex material properties. While current world models approach this through two distinct paradigms: learning the dynamics over the 2D pixel space or more explicit 3D geometric space. A systematic understanding of their relative strengths and limitations remains elusive due to the lack of diverse, large-scale real-world data. To address this, we present Deform360, a large-scale visuotactile dataset featuring 198 daily-life objects, 1,980 interaction sequences, and over 215 hours of observations from 41 surround-view cameras and bimanual tactile grippers to capture both global motion and contact-induced local deformations. Leveraging a novel markerless visuotactile 3D tracking pipeline to extract dense geometry and motion, we systematically evaluate current state-of-the-art world models, comparing 2D video models against 3D particle models. Finally, we provide a preliminary demonstration indicating the real-world applicability of our dataset by performing robot planning tasks on deformable objects. Our analysis reveals key insights into the trade-offs between structural priors and scalability, providing a solid benchmark for future research in generalizable deformable object-centric world modeling. Project website: https://deform360.lhy.xyz
core_contributions: 提出了Deform360，一个大规模多视图视觉触觉数据集，包含198个日常物体、1980个交互序列和超过215小时的观察数据。
开发了一种新颖的无标记视觉触觉3D跟踪管道，用于提取密集几何和运动。
系统评估了当前最先进的世界模型，比较了2D视频模型和3D粒子模型，并揭示了结构先验与可扩展性之间的权衡。
提供了初步的机器人规划任务演示，展示了数据集在真实世界中的适用性。
papers.abstract_zh: 预测物体动力学（即世界建模）是机器人操作的一个基本挑战，而建模可变形物体由于其高维状态空间和复杂的材料特性，是一个特别困难的情况。当前的世界模型通过两种不同的范式来处理这个问题：在2D像素空间上学习动力学，或者在更明确的3D几何空间上学习。由于缺乏多样化的大规模真实世界数据，对它们相对优势和局限性的系统理解仍然难以实现。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Deform360，一个大规模视觉触觉数据集，包含198个日常物体，1,980个交互序列，以及来自41个环绕视图摄像头和双手触觉夹爪的超过215小时的观察，以捕捉全局运动和接触引起的局部变形。利用一种新颖的无标记视觉触觉3D跟踪管道来提取密集几何和运动，我们系统地评估了当前最先进的世界模型，比较了2D视频模型和3D粒子模型。最后，我们提供了一个初步演示，通过在可变形物体上执行机器人规划任务，展示了我们数据集的真实世界适用性。我们的分析揭示了结构先验和可扩展性之间的权衡的关键见解，为未来在可泛化的以可变形物体为中心的世界建模研究提供了坚实的基准。项目网站：https://deform360.lhy.xyz

papers.title: High-Fidelity One-Step Generative Visuomotor Policy via Recursive Correction, Frequency Consistency, and Contrastive Flow Matching
papers.abstract: Generative models such as diffusion and flow matching have advanced robotic visuomotor policies by modeling multimodal action distributions, but their multi-step sampling or ODE solving introduces inference latency. Existing one-step acceleration methods often compress the whole generation process into a single large update, leading to spatial deviation, frequency distortion, and mode averaging. This paper proposes a high-fidelity one-step generative visuomotor policy framework that addresses these issues with three complementary mechanisms. Recursive Consistent Action Flow (RCAF) uses recursive correction to compensate for spatial truncation errors and align one-step predictions with refined flow trajectories. Dual-Timestep Frequency Consistency (DTFC) preserves high-frequency manipulation details through adaptive spectral consistency across flow timesteps. Contrastive Flow Matching (CFM) separates entangled action flows with a margin-based repulsive objective, reducing ambiguous actions in multimodal manipulation. Experiments on RoboTwin, RoboTwin 2.0, Adroit, DexArt, and real-world robot platforms show that the proposed method achieves competitive or superior performance compared with strong 10-step generative policy baselines while requiring only one forward pass (1 NFE), enabling low-latency visuomotor control.
core_contributions: 提出递归一致动作流（RCAF）机制，通过递归校正补偿空间截断误差，使一步预测与精细流轨迹对齐。
提出双时间步频率一致性（DTFC）机制，利用自适应频谱一致性保留高频操作细节。
提出对比流匹配（CFM）机制，通过基于边界的排斥目标分离纠缠的动作流，减少多模态操作中的模糊动作。
在多个仿真环境（RoboTwin、RoboTwin 2.0、Adroit、DexArt）和真实机器人平台上验证了所提框架的有效性，仅需1 NFE即可达到或超越10步生成策略基线的性能。
papers.abstract_zh: 生成模型如扩散和流匹配通过建模多模态动作分布推进了机器人视觉运动策略，但它们的多步采样或ODE求解引入了推理延迟。现有的一步加速方法通常将整个生成过程压缩为单个大更新，导致空间偏差、频率失真和模式平均。本文提出了一种高保真一步生成视觉运动策略框架，通过三种互补机制解决这些问题。递归一致动作流（RCAF）使用递归校正来补偿空间截断误差，并将一步预测与精细流轨迹对齐。双时间步频率一致性（DTFC）通过跨流时间步的自适应频谱一致性保留高频操作细节。对比流匹配（CFM）通过基于边界的排斥目标分离纠缠的动作流，减少多模态操作中的模糊动作。在RoboTwin、RoboTwin 2.0、Adroit、DexArt和真实机器人平台上的实验表明，所提出的方法在仅需一次前向传播（1 NFE）的情况下，与强大的10步生成策略基线相比，实现了竞争性或更优的性能，实现了低延迟视觉运动控制。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文提出一种高保真一步生成视觉运动策略框架，通过递归校正、频率一致性和对比流匹配三种机制，在仅需一次前向传播的情况下达到与多步生成策略相当或更优的性能，显著降低推理延迟。
papers.research_problem: 现有生成模型（扩散、流匹配）的多步采样或ODE求解导致推理延迟，而现有一步加速方法存在空间偏差、频率失真和模式平均问题。
papers.method_summary: 提出一个高保真一步生成视觉运动策略框架，包含三个互补机制：递归一致动作流（RCAF）用于递归校正空间截断误差，双时间步频率一致性（DTFC）用于保持高频细节，对比流匹配（CFM）用于减少多模态动作模糊。三者协同工作，将整个生成过程压缩为单步前向传播，同时保持生成质量。

papers.title: Imagining the Sense of Touch: Touch-Informed Manipulation via Imagined Tactile Representations
papers.abstract: Tactile sensing can substantially improve contact-rich robotic manipulation, yet its practical deployment remains limited by the fragility, calibration requirements, and maintenance burden of tactile hardware. This raises a fundamental question: can robots benefit from tactile knowledge without requiring tactile sensors at deployment? We present TacImag, a tactile imagination framework that predicts tactile observations from vision and proprioception and uses the generated signals to guide manipulation policies. Trained from paired visuotactile demonstrations, TacImag enables touch-informed manipulation using only visual observations at test time. We evaluate TacImag on six simulated and four real-world manipulation tasks. Across simulation and real-world experiments, imagined tactile observations consistently improve manipulation performance without requiring tactile hardware. In real-world experiments, imagined force fields improve contact-sensitive tasks by 44.4% on average, whereas imagined tactile images improve texture-sensitive tasks by 23.3%, revealing that the effectiveness of tactile imagination depends strongly on the relationship between tactile representation and task requirements. Our results further suggest that tactile imagination does not simply recover missing tactile measurements. Instead, it acts as a form of contact-aware supervision that transforms subtle visual interaction cues into representations that are easier for manipulation policies to exploit.
core_contributions: 提出了TacImag，一个从视觉和本体感觉预测触觉观测的触觉想象框架，使机器人无需触觉硬件即可实现触觉知情操作。
在六个模拟和四个真实世界操作任务上验证了想象触觉观测能一致提高操作性能。
揭示了触觉想象的有效性强烈依赖于触觉表示与任务需求之间的关系，力场适合接触敏感任务，触觉图像适合纹理敏感任务。
表明触觉想象并非简单恢复缺失触觉测量，而是作为接触感知监督形式，将视觉交互线索转化为策略易用的表示。

papers.title: VLA-Corrector: Lightweight Detect-and-Correct Inference for Adaptive Action Horizon
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models have recently achieved strong progress in embodied intelligence. To reduce policy-call frequency while preserving temporal coherence, most generative policies adopt an action chunk mechanism, executing multiple future actions in an open-loop manner under a fixed action horizon. However, this "predict-then-blindly-execute" paradigm sacrifices closed-loop reactivity: in contact-rich physical interactions, even small local perturbations can rapidly amplify within the open-loop blind spot, leading to compounding errors and ultimately task failure. To address this limitation, we propose VLA-Corrector, a lightweight corrective inference framework for action-chunked VLA policies. Without modifying the backbone policy weights, VLA-Corrector introduces a lightweight Latent-space Vision Monitor (LVM) that continuously compares predicted and actual visual feature evolution, enabling online detection of visual dynamics deviations. Once persistent deviation is detected, the system triggers a truncation event, discards the remaining stale actions, and invokes corrective replanning via Online Gradient Guidance (OGG). The detect-and-correct mechanism of VLA-Corrector naturally induces an event-triggered adaptive action horizon: it preserves long-horizon execution when the current chunk remains reliable, and invokes short-horizon corrective replanning when execution begins to drift. In doing so, VLA-Corrector mitigates the trade-off imposed by static horizons between execution robustness and policy-call frequency. It can be integrated into different VLA models without further retraining the VLA backbone, interrupting compounding errors while preserving much of the efficiency benefit of action chunking and substantially improving robustness in long-horizon, contact-rich robotic manipulation tasks.
core_contributions: 提出VLA-Corrector，一个轻量级的纠正推理框架，用于动作分块VLA策略。
引入Latent-space Vision Monitor (LVM)用于在线检测视觉动态偏差。
引入Online Gradient Guidance (OGG)用于纠正重规划。
实现事件触发的自适应动作视界，平衡执行鲁棒性和策略调用频率。
无需修改骨干网络权重或重新训练，可集成到不同VLA模型。
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基础模型最近在具身智能方面取得了显著进展。为了减少策略调用频率同时保持时间连贯性，大多数生成式策略采用动作分块机制，在固定动作视界下以开环方式执行多个未来动作。然而，这种“预测然后盲目执行”的范式牺牲了闭环反应性：在接触丰富的物理交互中，即使很小的局部扰动也会在开环盲区内迅速放大，导致复合错误并最终任务失败。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了VLA-Corrector，一个用于动作分块VLA策略的轻量级纠正推理框架。在不修改骨干策略权重的情况下，VLA-Corrector引入了一个轻量级的潜在空间视觉监控器（LVM），持续比较预测和实际视觉特征演化，实现视觉动态偏差的在线检测。一旦检测到持续偏差，系统触发截断事件，丢弃剩余的过时动作，并通过在线梯度引导（OGG）调用纠正重规划。VLA-Corrector的检测-纠正机制自然产生了事件触发的自适应动作视界：当当前分块仍然可靠时，它保持长视界执行；当执行开始漂移时，它调用短视界纠正重规划。这样，VLA-Corrector缓解了静态视界在执行鲁棒性和策略调用频率之间的权衡。它可以集成到不同的VLA模型中，无需进一步重新训练VLA骨干，中断复合错误同时保留动作分块的大部分效率优势，并在长视界、接触丰富的机器人操作任务中显著提高鲁棒性。
papers.summary_one_sentence: VLA-Corrector通过轻量级的检测-纠正机制实现自适应动作视界，提高了动作分块VLA策略在接触丰富任务中的鲁棒性。

papers.title: UniTacVLA: Unified Tactile Understanding and Prediction in Vision Language Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong performance in many robotic manipulation tasks, yet remain limited in contact-rich dexterous manipulation. To overcome this limitation, recent vision-tactile-language-action (VTLA) methods incorporate tactile sensing into VLA models to provide direct contact information. However, they typically treat tactile signals as passive auxiliary inputs, making it difficult to model tactile semantics and future physical interactions. To this end, we propose a unified tactile learning framework for contact-rich manipulation that models tactile signals as dynamic interaction cues for both contact understanding and prediction. Specifically, we construct a unified tactile latent space and jointly model current tactile states and future contact changes through tactile chain-of-thought reasoning and coarse-to-fine future tactile prediction, thereby forming a state-aware and dynamics-aware tactile prior. Based on this prior, we introduce a tactile-action mixed controller that combines real-time and predicted tactile feedback to refine low-frequency action chunks with high-frequency corrections. Real-world experiments on four categories of contact-rich tasks, including adjustment, insertion, wiping, and assembly, under both clean and externally perturbed settings, show that our method improves success rate, manipulation accuracy, and contact robustness over existing methods, demonstrating its effectiveness in dexterous physical interaction.
core_contributions: 构建统一的触觉潜在空间，联合建模当前触觉状态和未来接触变化
提出触觉链式推理和粗到细的未来触觉预测方法，形成状态感知和动力学感知的触觉先验
引入触觉-动作混合控制器，结合实时和预测触觉反馈，用高频修正优化低频动作块
在四种接触丰富任务（调整、插入、擦拭、组装）的真实世界实验中验证了方法的有效性
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在许多机器人操作任务中取得了强劲性能，但在接触丰富的灵巧操作中仍然受限。为了克服这一限制，最近的视觉-触觉-语言-动作（VTLA）方法将触觉感知融入VLA模型以提供直接接触信息。然而，它们通常将触觉信号视为被动辅助输入，难以建模触觉语义和未来物理交互。为此，我们提出一个用于接触丰富操作的统一触觉学习框架，将触觉信号建模为动态交互线索，用于接触理解和预测。具体来说，我们构建了一个统一的触觉潜在空间，并通过触觉链式推理和粗到细的未来触觉预测，联合建模当前触觉状态和未来接触变化，从而形成状态感知和动力学感知的触觉先验。基于该先验，我们引入了一个触觉-动作混合控制器，结合实时和预测的触觉反馈，用高频修正来优化低频动作块。在四类接触丰富任务（包括调整、插入、擦拭和组装）上的真实世界实验，在干净和外部扰动设置下，表明我们的方法在成功率、操作精度和接触鲁棒性上优于现有方法，展示了其在灵巧物理交互中的有效性。

papers.title: Support-Constrained RL Enables Real-World Policy Improvement without Real-World Experience
papers.abstract: Robots trained on real world data tend to be imprecise, slow, and brittle to perturbations. Improving these policies with reinforcement learning (RL) is an appealing alternative, but this process often requires expensive training in the real world. Performing policy improvement in simulation instead provides a far cheaper alternative, but unconstrained RL in simulation can exploit contact and dynamics mismatches, resulting in unsafe behaviors that do not transfer to hardware. Common forms of regularization can furthermore limit improvement by overconstraining to an imperfect behavior prior. In this work, we propose Support-Constrained Off-Domain REinforcement (SCORE), a real-to-sim-to-real framework that constrains RL in simulation to the support of a generative policy pretrained on real data. We instantiate this constraint through flow steering, restricting SCORE to actions the base policy can already produce, which ensures transferable behaviors while maximizing policy improvement. Improving a policy with SCORE requires minimal effort: it learns from sparse rewards, avoids distillation, and leaves the base policy untouched. Across eight real-world dexterous multi-fingered robotic manipulation tasks, SCORE improves average success rate from 37.8% to 89.9%, compared to 59.5% for the best baseline, and reaches success in 36.8% fewer steps than the base policy. Ultimately, through extensive experiments and ablations, we show that simulation can substantially improve real-world manipulation policies when policy optimization is appropriately constrained, introducing a new paradigm for real-to-sim-to-real policy improvement. Videos and code are available at https://weirdlabuw.github.io/score/.
core_contributions: 提出SCORE框架，一种real-to-sim-to-real策略改进方法，通过支持约束实现安全且可迁移的策略优化。
通过流引导（flow steering）将模拟中的RL约束到基础策略的动作支持，确保改进后的行为可迁移到真实硬件。
在8个真实世界灵巧多指机器人操作任务上，平均成功率从37.8%提升到89.9%，优于最佳基线（59.5%），且成功步骤减少36.8%。
引入了一种新范式，表明适当约束的模拟可以显著改进真实世界策略，无需真实世界RL训练或策略蒸馏。
papers.abstract_zh: 在真实世界数据上训练的机器人往往不精确、缓慢且对扰动脆弱。使用强化学习（RL）改进这些策略是一个有吸引力的替代方案，但这个过程通常需要在真实世界中进行昂贵的训练。在模拟中进行策略改进则提供了一个更便宜的替代方案，但模拟中无约束的RL可能利用接触和动力学不匹配，导致不安全的行为且无法迁移到硬件。常见的正则化形式可能通过过度约束到不完美的行为先验而限制改进。在这项工作中，我们提出了支持约束的域外强化学习（SCORE），一个真实到模拟到真实的框架，将模拟中的RL约束到基于真实数据预训练的生成策略的支持上。我们通过流引导（flow steering）实例化这个约束，将SCORE限制为基础策略已经能够产生的动作，这确保了可迁移的行为同时最大化策略改进。使用SCORE改进策略需要最小的努力：它从稀疏奖励中学习，避免蒸馏，并且不修改基础策略。在八个真实世界的灵巧多指机器人操作任务中，SCORE将平均成功率从37.8%提高到89.9%，而最佳基线为59.5%，并且比基础策略少用36.8%的步骤达到成功。最终，通过广泛的实验和消融，我们表明当策略优化被适当约束时，模拟可以显著改进真实世界的操作策略，引入了一种新的真实到模拟到真实策略改进范式。视频和代码可在https://weirdlabuw.github.io/score/获取。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出SCORE框架，通过将模拟中的强化学习约束到真实数据预训练策略的动作支持上，实现了无需真实世界经验的策略改进，在灵巧操作任务上显著提升成功率。
papers.research_problem: 如何在不进行昂贵真实世界训练的情况下，利用模拟改进真实世界机器人策略，同时避免模拟中的不安全行为并确保迁移性？
papers.method_summary: SCORE是一个real-to-sim-to-real框架，它使用流引导（flow steering）将模拟中的策略优化约束到基于真实数据预训练的生成策略的动作支持上，从而在最大化改进的同时确保行为可迁移到真实硬件。该方法从稀疏奖励学习，避免蒸馏，且不修改基础策略。
papers.experimental_setup: 在8个真实世界的灵巧多指机器人操作任务上进行评估，与多种基线比较（包括基础策略和最佳基线，最佳基线成功率为59.5%），但具体环境、基线名称等细节未在摘要中提供。

papers.title: HT-Bench: Benchmarking and Learning Dexterous Full-Hand Tactile Representations with Egocentric Vision
papers.abstract: Establishing a universal benchmark for tactile representation learning in robotic manipulation remains challenging due to the diversity of tactile sensor designs, data formats, and robot embodiments. Rather than seeking to establish such, we explore a scalable and promising direction for future development: egocentric vision paired with full-hand tactile data. To this end, we introduce \textbf{HT-Bench}, a large-scale multi-task benchmark for dexterous full-hand tactile sensing, comprising 10M RGB frames and 7.8M tactile frames collected across 226 tasks. HT-Bench evaluates tactile representations from three key perspectives: whether they encode meaningful contact geometry, whether they can align tactile observations with visual information, and whether they generalize to unseen tasks. To assess these capabilities, HT-Bench includes four tasks: fine-grained tactile similarity retrieval, masked tactile inpainting, vision-to-tactile synthesis, and multimodal tactile frame prediction. We further propose \textbf{HandTouch}, a vector-quantized vision--tactile encoder that learns tactile representations through progressive spatial, cross-modal, and temporal training. Across HT-Bench, HandTouch consistently outperforms representative tactile encoder baselines, improving Recall@5 on fine-grained tactile similarity retrieval from 74.65\% to 85.23\%, reducing RMSE on masked tactile inpainting from 0.022 to 0.010, and increasing OOD cIoU on vision-to-tactile synthesis from 0.628 to 0.705. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of HandTouch and suggest that large-scale egocentric full-hand tactile data provides a scalable basis for evaluating and advancing tactile representation learning in dexterous manipulation.

提出了HandTouch，一个向量量化的视觉-触觉编码器，通过渐进的空间、跨模态和时间训练学习触觉表示。

papers.abstract_zh: 在机器人操作中，由于触觉传感器设计、数据格式和机器人形态的多样性，建立触觉表示学习的通用基准仍然具有挑战性。我们并未试图建立这样一个通用基准，而是探索了一个可扩展且有前景的未来发展方向：自我中心视觉与全手触觉数据相结合。为此，我们引入了HT-Bench，一个用于灵巧全手触觉感知的大规模多任务基准，包含226个任务中收集的1000万RGB帧和780万触觉帧。HT-Bench从三个关键角度评估触觉表示：它们是否编码有意义的接触几何形状，它们是否能够将触觉观察与视觉信息对齐，以及它们是否能够泛化到未见过的任务。为了评估这些能力，HT-Bench包括四个任务：细粒度触觉相似性检索、掩码触觉修复、视觉到触觉合成以及多模态触觉帧预测。我们进一步提出了HandTouch，一个向量量化的视觉-触觉编码器，通过渐进的空间、跨模态和时间训练来学习触觉表示。在HT-Bench上，HandTouch始终优于代表性的触觉编码器基线，将细粒度触觉相似性检索的Recall@5从74.65%提高到85.23%，将掩码触觉修复的RMSE从0.022降低到0.010，并将视觉到触觉合成的OOD cIoU从0.628提高到0.705。这些结果证明了HandTouch的有效性，并表明大规模自我中心全手触觉数据为评估和推进灵巧操作中的触觉表示学习提供了可扩展的基础。

papers.title: ContactWorld: What Matters in Vision-Tactile World Models for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires world models to reason over complex contact dynamics from multimodal sensory observations. However, it remains unclear which representation properties fundamentally support stable long-horizon planning in contact-rich settings. In this paper, we present ContactWorld, a benchmark and systematic empirical study of vision-tactile world models spanning 12 contact-rich manipulation tasks, including insertion, disassembly, screwing, and exploratory interaction. Across extensive experiments, we find that representations that are both spatially structured and temporally continuous consistently achieve the strongest planning performance. In particular, point-cloud observations improve average planning success rates from 20.7% with wrist-view observations and 22.0% with front-view observations to 32.1%. We further find that the effectiveness of tactile sensing depends critically on cross-modal representation compatibility rather than modality scaling alone. Combining point-cloud observations with tactile force-field representations, which preserve richer spatial structure and interaction dynamics, further improves performance to 36.1%, yielding the strongest overall planning performance across all evaluated tasks. Moreover, tactile sensing becomes increasingly important under long-horizon planning objectives, where compounding prediction errors and contact uncertainty accumulate over time. Together, these findings highlight the importance of representation structure, multimodal compatibility, and long-horizon robustness in vision-tactile world models for contact-rich robotic manipulation.
core_contributions: 提出了ContactWorld基准，包含12个接触丰富操作任务（插入、拆卸、拧螺丝、探索性交互）。
系统实证研究了视觉和触觉表示对规划性能的影响，比较了腕部视图、前视图、点云和触觉力场表示。
发现空间结构化和时间连续的表示（如点云）显著提高规划成功率（从约20%提高到32.1%）。
发现触觉传感的有效性依赖于跨模态表示兼容性，而非模态数量，结合点云和触觉力场表示达到最佳性能（36.1%）。
揭示了触觉在长视界规划中越来越重要，有助于应对累积的预测误差和接触不确定性。
papers.abstract_zh: 接触丰富的操作需要世界模型从多模态感官观察中推理复杂的接触动力学。然而，目前尚不清楚哪些表示属性从根本上支持接触丰富环境中的稳定长视界规划。在本文中，我们提出了ContactWorld，一个涵盖12个接触丰富操作任务（包括插入、拆卸、拧螺丝和探索性交互）的视觉-触觉世界模型基准和系统实证研究。通过大量实验，我们发现同时具有空间结构化和时间连续性的表示 consistently 达到最强的规划性能。特别地，点云观察将平均规划成功率从腕部视图的20.7%和前视图的22.0%提高到32.1%。我们进一步发现，触觉传感的有效性关键取决于跨模态表示兼容性，而不是仅仅模态缩放。将点云观察与触觉力场表示（保留了更丰富的空间结构和交互动力学）相结合，进一步将性能提高到36.1%，在所有评估任务中实现了最强的整体规划性能。此外，在长视界规划目标下，触觉传感变得越来越重要，因为预测误差和接触不确定性随时间累积。这些发现共同强调了表示结构、多模态兼容性和长视界鲁棒性在接触丰富机器人操作的视觉-触觉世界模型中的重要性。

papers.title: TacCoRL: Integrating Tactile Feedback into VLA via Simulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide strong visual, language, and action priors for robot manipulation, but visual observations alone often miss the local contact state required for contact-rich tasks. We present TacCoRL, a scalable framework that injects Tactile feedback into VLA policies and improves them through sim-real Co-training and simulation-based reinforcement learning (RL), without requiring large-scale tactile pretraining or extensive real-world contact exploration. The key idea is not only adding touch as an input, but learning how contact readings should modulate action responses in near-failure states that are rare in demonstrations and risky to collect on hardware. We use a real-aligned simulator as a closed-loop training environment for contact interaction. Mixed simulated and real trajectories first warm-start tactile-conditioned actions in the pretrained policy. Reinforcement learning with verifiable task rewards then optimizes the policy using simulated contact rollouts. It reinforces tactile-conditioned actions that lead to task completion, while a supervised objective on real trajectories keeps the refined policy anchored to deployment visual, tactile, and action distributions. The resulting policy transfers directly to the real robot without privileged simulation state or online real-world RL. Across four bimanual contact-rich tasks, the final visuo-tactile policy achieves an average success rate of 72.5%, compared to baseline of 50.0%. Result videos and more details are available at https://tac-corl.github.io/
core_contributions: 提出TacCoRL框架，将触觉反馈集成到VLA策略中。
通过模拟-真实协同训练和基于模拟的强化学习优化策略，无需大规模触觉预训练或大量真实探索。
学习触觉读数在接近失败状态下调节动作响应。
使用真实对齐的模拟器作为闭环训练环境。
在四个双手接触丰富任务上实现72.5%的平均成功率，相比基线50.0%。
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为机器人操作提供了强大的视觉、语言和动作先验，但仅凭视觉观察往往缺失接触丰富任务所需的局部接触状态。我们提出TacCoRL，一个可扩展的框架，将触觉反馈注入VLA策略，并通过模拟-真实协同训练和基于模拟的强化学习（RL）进行改进，无需大规模触觉预训练或大量真实接触探索。关键思想不仅是添加触觉作为输入，而是学习接触读数如何在接近失败状态下调节动作响应，这些状态在演示中罕见且在硬件上收集有风险。我们使用真实对齐的模拟器作为接触交互的闭环训练环境。混合模拟和真实轨迹首先在预训练策略中热启动触觉条件动作。然后，具有可验证任务奖励的强化学习使用模拟接触滚动优化策略。它强化导致任务完成的触觉条件动作，同时真实轨迹上的监督目标使优化后的策略锚定到部署的视觉、触觉和动作分布。最终策略直接迁移到真实机器人，无需特权模拟状态或在线真实世界RL。在四个双手接触丰富任务上，最终的视觉-触觉策略平均成功率达到72.5%，而基线为50.0%。结果视频和更多细节见https://tac-corl.github.io/

papers.title: UniIntervene: Agentic Intervention for Efficient Real-World Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (HiL-RL) has emerged as an effective paradigm for real-world robotic manipulation, enabling online policy improvement with human guidance. However, current HiL-RL frameworks remain intervention-intensive, relying on frequent human corrections to redirect the policy out of unproductive exploration, which incurs high labor cost and limits real-world scalability. To address this, we propose UniIntervene, an agentic intervention model that detects unproductive exploration and autonomously recovers the policy toward high-value states, taking over the bulk of interventions from human operators. Specifically, UniIntervene first performs future-conditioned action-value estimation, predicting the latent consequence of the current action and evaluating its induced value, which provides a more stable progress signal. Building on this, a temporal value-risk critic aggregates recent value dynamics and triggers intervention when the estimated value exhibits sustained stagnation or degradation. When intervention is required, UniIntervene retrieves a high-value recovery target from a memory of past intervention episodes and produces executable corrective actions through a goal-conditioned recovery policy. In this way, UniIntervene turns intervention from passive human correction into a value-aware recovery process for efficient real-world RL. Extensive experiments on diverse real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that UniIntervene improves the average success rate by 8.6% while reducing human interventions by 57% relative to state-of-the-art HiL-RL baselines.
core_contributions: 提出UniIntervene模型，将干预从被动的人类纠正转变为价值感知的自主恢复过程。
设计未来条件动作价值估计，通过预测动作的潜在后果提供更稳定的进展信号。
引入时间价值风险批评者，聚合价值动态并在价值持续停滞或退化时触发干预。
通过目标条件恢复策略从干预记忆检索高价值目标并生成可执行的纠正动作。
在多种真实世界操作任务上验证，平均成功率提升8.6%，人类干预减少57%。
papers.abstract_zh: 人类在环强化学习（HiL-RL）已成为真实世界机器人操作的有效范式，能够通过人类指导实现在线策略改进。然而，当前的HiL-RL框架仍然需要大量干预，依赖频繁的人类纠正来引导策略脱离无益的探索，这导致高劳动成本并限制了真实世界的可扩展性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出UniIntervene，一个代理干预模型，它检测无益的探索并自动将策略恢复到高价值状态，从人类操作员那里接管大部分干预。具体来说，UniIntervene首先执行未来条件动作价值估计，预测当前动作的潜在后果并评估其诱导价值，这提供了更稳定的进展信号。在此基础上，一个时间价值风险批评者聚合最近的价值动态，并在估计价值表现出持续停滞或退化时触发干预。当需要干预时，UniIntervene从过去干预事件的内存中检索一个高价值恢复目标，并通过目标条件恢复策略产生可执行的纠正动作。通过这种方式，UniIntervene将干预从被动的人类纠正转变为价值感知的恢复过程，以实现高效的现实世界RL。在多种真实世界操作任务上的广泛实验表明，相对于最先进的HiL-RL基线，UniIntervene将平均成功率提高了8.6%，同时将人类干预减少了57%。
papers.summary_one_sentence: UniIntervene通过价值感知的自主干预机制，在真实世界机器人操作中显著减少人类干预并提高成功率。

papers.title: Blind Dexterous Grasping via Real2Sim2Real Tactile Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Blind grasping with a dexterous hand is a crucial manipulation capability. Nevertheless, learning such tactile-only policies for real robots remains challenging due to the tactile sim-to-real gap and the limited expressiveness of sparse tactile signals. To bridge this gap, we propose a framework for tactile-only blind grasping that is deployable on a physical multi-fingered robotic hand. Our approach combines three key components. First, we introduce a Real2Sim tactile calibration pipeline that constructs a contact-calibrated digital-twin simulator capable of reproducing real tactile signals. Second, we improve the expressiveness of sparse tactile observations using a layout-aware tactile encoder, which incorporates sensor-geometry priors through self-supervised pretraining. Third, to improve generalization to unseen objects, we train object-specific reinforcement-learning experts in the calibrated simulator and aggregate their successful grasp trajectories into a tactile-conditioned Diffusion Policy. We evaluate our method on a physical LEAP Hand equipped with distributed tactile sensing across 10 seen and 10 unseen objects. The deployed policy achieves a 27\% real-world grasp success rate across all 20 objects, without real-world grasping demonstrations or visual input. Simulation ablations show that layout-aware tactile pretraining improves grasping performance, while sensing-level evaluations confirm that Real2Sim calibration increases the consistency of tactile contact events between simulation and hardware. Together, these results suggest that contact-event calibration, geometry-aware tactile representation learning, and diffusion-based policy aggregation provide an effective path toward tactile-only blind grasping on real dexterous robotic hands. Project page:Dex-Blind-Grasp.github.io.

提出了触觉条件扩散策略，通过聚合特定物体强化学习专家的成功轨迹提高对未见物体的泛化能力。

papers.title: TacForeSight: Force-Guided Tactile World Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires robots to continuously perceive and regulate evolving physical interactions under dynamic contact transitions or complex surface geometries. Recent imitation learning methods improve contact-aware control by incorporating tactile or force feedback, but they rarely model the asymmetric spatiotemporal roles of global force and local tactile sensing. To address this, we propose TacForeSight, a lightweight force-conditioned tactile foresight framework for real-time manipulation. The core component is TacForceWM, a tactile world model that predicts short-horizon tactile latent dynamics from dual-finger tactile observations conditioned on high-frequency wrist force and torque signals. Another key component, the Predictive Tactile-Conditioned Policy, leverages the predicted latents as anticipatory contact priors, models the current-to-future tactile evolution via cross-attention, and adaptively fuses visuo-tactile features through a tactile-guided gating module. By forecasting purely within a compact latent space, TacForeSight enables proactive contact reasoning with efficient real-time inference suitable for high-frequency manipulation control. Real-robot experiments on five representative tasks and three in-process perturbation settings show that TacForeSight consistently outperforms existing baselines, particularly under dynamic contact disturbances. All models and datasets will be made publicly available on the project website at https://tacforesight.github.io/ProjectPage.
core_contributions: 提出了TacForeSight框架，包含TacForceWM触觉世界模型和预测性触觉条件策略两个核心组件。

预测性触觉条件策略利用预测潜在变量作为预期接触先验，通过交叉注意力建模触觉演变，并通过触觉引导门控融合视觉-触觉特征。
在五个代表性任务和三个过程中扰动设置上验证了TacForeSight的有效性，特别是在动态接触干扰下表现优异。

papers.title: IMPACT: Learning Internal-Model Predictive Control for Forceful Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Real-world robotic manipulation tasks often involve forceful interactions with the environment, such as using tools of varying weights, transporting objects with different masses, and performing contact-rich tasks like table wiping. Previous learning-based approaches typically employ imitation learning policies that output target end-effector poses tracked by low-level impedance controllers. In these systems, forceful interactions are either implicitly realized through steady-state tracking errors or explicitly commanded using wrist force/torque or tactile sensors. However, implicit approaches generalize poorly across object weights, while explicit approaches require specialized hardware and increase system complexity. In this work, we propose IMPACT, a framework that decouples these forceful tasks into task-planning and internal-model-based predictive control. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves higher success rates and improved generalization to unseen object weights, as well as better safety and energy efficiency.
core_contributions: 提出IMPACT框架，将强力任务解耦为任务规划和基于内部模型的预测控制
在仿真和真实实验中验证了更高的成功率、泛化性、安全性和能效
papers.abstract_zh: 现实世界中的机器人操作任务通常涉及与环境的强力交互，例如使用不同重量的工具、运输不同质量的物体以及执行如擦桌子等接触丰富的任务。先前的基于学习方法通常采用输出目标末端执行器位姿的模仿学习策略，并由低级阻抗控制器跟踪。在这些系统中，强力交互要么通过稳态跟踪误差隐式实现，要么使用腕部力/扭矩或触觉传感器显式命令。然而，隐式方法在不同物体重量下泛化能力差，而显式方法需要专用硬件并增加系统复杂性。在这项工作中，我们提出了IMPACT，一个将这些强力任务解耦为任务规划和基于内部模型的预测控制的框架。大量的仿真和真实世界实验表明，所提出的框架实现了更高的成功率和更好的对未见物体重量的泛化能力，以及更好的安全性和能效。

papers.title: Dream-Tac: A Unified Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: World action models inherit the predictive capability of world models, enabling action generation to be guided by anticipated future observations. However, they rely primarily on vision and often fail in contact-rich manipulation, where critical cues arise from physical interaction. In this paper, we propose Dream-Tac, a unified Tactile-World Action Model that jointly models actions, future visual observations, and tactile dynamics. Specifically, Dream-Tac introduces (i) contact-gated visuotactile fusion to selectively integrate tactile signals and (ii) a contact-aware attention bias to better regulate cross-modal interactions during manipulation. To support real-time deployment, we further design a dual-level acceleration strategy, reformulating the contact-aware bias to preserve the fused attention path during training and introducing cache-based diffusion acceleration at inference, achieving up to 2.9$\times$ faster training and 1.8$\times$ faster inference. Across six contact-rich manipulation tasks, Dream-Tac improves action accuracy by 31.7\% on average, demonstrating the effectiveness of unified visuotactile world modeling.Code is available at https://github.com/LYFCLOUDFAN/Dream-Tac.
core_contributions: 提出了Dream-Tac，一个统一的触觉-世界动作模型，联合建模动作、未来视觉观察和触觉动态。

引入了接触感知注意力偏置，以更好地调节跨模态交互。
设计了双级加速策略，实现2.9倍训练加速和1.8倍推理加速。
在六个接触丰富的操作任务上平均提高动作准确性31.7%。

papers.title: VoLo: A Physical Orchestrator for Open-Vocabulary Long-Horizon Manipulation
papers.abstract: Open-vocabulary long-horizon manipulation requires robots to reason over flexible instructions and complex multi-object scenes while adaptively planning, executing, monitoring, and recovering from failures. We address these demands with a closed agent loop in which a VLM orchestrates heterogeneous robot capabilities as interruptible tools. Unlike in virtual AI agents, the timing of decisions, actions and tool calls is important in a physical world that does not pause for reasoning. We refer to this setting as Physical Orchestration, and propose VoLoAgent, a VLM that plans, monitors, and recovers by treating a VLA/WAM as an interruptible tool it steers mid-rollout alongside vision models and action primitives. To evaluate these long-horizon capabilities, we introduce RoboVoLo, a high-fidelity benchmark for open-vocabulary long-horizon manipulation across common sense, memory/state tracking, complex references, and world knowledge, with both task-level success and failure-mode diagnostics. Experiments show VoLoAgent substantially outperforms single VLA/VLM or tool-based systems, with validation on real-robot experiments. Project page: https://chicychen.github.io/VoLo/
core_contributions: 提出物理编排（Physical Orchestration）概念，将VLM作为异构机器人能力的编排器。
提出VoLoAgent，一个VLM，通过将VLA/WAM作为可中断工具进行规划、监控和恢复。
引入RoboVoLo，一个高保真基准测试，用于评估开放词汇长时域操作，涵盖多种能力并提供诊断。
实验证明VoLoAgent显著优于单个VLA/VLM或基于工具的系统，并在真实机器人上验证。
papers.abstract_zh: 开放词汇长时域操作要求机器人能够推理灵活指令和复杂多物体场景，同时自适应地规划、执行、监控和从失败中恢复。我们通过一个闭环智能体循环来满足这些需求，其中VLM将异构机器人能力编排为可中断工具。与虚拟AI智能体不同，在物理世界中，决策、动作和工具调用的时机很重要，因为物理世界不会暂停等待推理。我们将这种设置称为物理编排，并提出VoLoAgent，一个VLM，它通过将VLA/WAM视为可中断工具，在滚动执行过程中与视觉模型和动作原语一起引导，从而进行规划、监控和恢复。为了评估这些长时域能力，我们引入了RoboVoLo，一个高保真基准测试，用于开放词汇长时域操作，涵盖常识、记忆/状态跟踪、复杂引用和世界知识，并提供任务级成功和失败模式诊断。实验表明，VoLoAgent显著优于单个VLA/VLM或基于工具的系统，并在真实机器人实验中得到验证。项目页面：https://chicychen.github.io/VoLo/

papers.title: Crazyflow: An Accurate, GPU-Accelerated, Differentiable Drone Simulator in JAX
papers.abstract: High-quality, large-scale synthetic data from simulations is becoming a cornerstone for pushing the capabilities of robot algorithms. While aerial robotics simulators have evolved to support specialized needs such as fidelity, differentiability, and swarms independently, a unified platform that can synthesize data across all these domains is missing. In this work, we propose Crazyflow, a simulator designed to push the limits of aerial-robotics algorithm development, from model-based to data-driven methods, gradient-based to sampling-based approaches, and single-agent to multi-agent systems. Compared to existing state-of-the-art drone simulators, it achieves speeds more than an order of magnitude faster for a single drone and can simulate thousands of swarms of 4000 drones each. Real-world experiments show Crazyflow supports both analytical-gradient-based policy learning, achieving sub-centimeter trajectory tracking accuracy without domain randomization, and sampling-based obstacle avoidance at speeds exceeding half a billion steps per second. Breaking the traditional train-then-deploy paradigm, we show that its unprecedented speed even enables in-flight reinforcement learning; we demonstrate this by throwing a physical drone into the air and training a recovery policy from scratch in 0.38 seconds, successfully stabilizing the drone. Crazyflow supports multiple levels of simulation abstraction, is directly compatible with all open-source Crazyflie models, and enables rapid reconfiguration across custom drone platforms and applications by providing a light-weight system identification pipeline. By pushing accuracy, speed, and differentiability simultaneously, Crazyflow serves as an open-source resource for synthetic data generation, with emerging capabilities for large-scale parallelization for online, in-execution learning and optimization, opening the door to novel algorithm development.
core_contributions: 提出了Crazyflow，一个在JAX中实现的GPU加速、可微分的无人机模拟器。
比现有最先进的无人机模拟器快一个数量级以上，并可模拟数千个包含4000架无人机的集群。
支持基于分析梯度的策略学习，实现亚厘米级轨迹跟踪精度，无需领域随机化。
支持采样避障，速度超过每秒5亿步。
实现了飞行中强化学习，在0.38秒内从头训练恢复策略并成功稳定无人机。
支持多种模拟抽象级别，兼容所有开源Crazyflie模型，并提供轻量级系统识别管道。
papers.abstract_zh: 来自模拟的高质量、大规模合成数据正成为推动机器人算法能力的基石。虽然空中机器人模拟器已经发展到独立支持保真度、可微分性和集群等专门需求，但缺少一个能够跨所有这些领域合成数据的统一平台。在这项工作中，我们提出了Crazyflow，一个旨在推动空中机器人算法开发极限的模拟器，涵盖从基于模型到数据驱动的方法、从基于梯度到基于采样的方法、以及从单智能体到多智能体系统。与现有最先进的无人机模拟器相比，它在单架无人机上实现了超过一个数量级的速度提升，并且可以模拟数千个包含4000架无人机的集群。真实世界实验表明，Crazyflow既支持基于分析梯度的策略学习，无需领域随机化即可实现亚厘米级轨迹跟踪精度，也支持采样避障，速度超过每秒5亿步。打破传统的训练-部署范式，我们展示了其前所未有的速度甚至能够实现飞行中的强化学习；我们通过将一架物理无人机抛向空中并在0.38秒内从头训练一个恢复策略来演示这一点，成功稳定了无人机。Crazyflow支持多种模拟抽象级别，直接兼容所有开源Crazyflie模型，并通过提供轻量级系统识别管道，支持跨自定义无人机平台和应用的快速重新配置。通过同时推动精度、速度和可微分性，Crazyflow作为合成数据生成的开源资源，具有大规模并行化用于在线、执行中学习和优化的新兴能力，为新型算法开发打开了大门。

papers.title: Any-ttach: Quick End-effector Swapping Enables Manipulation Dexterity with Simplicity
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation dexterity is often pursued by building increasingly complex high-DoF multifingered hands. While many robotic hands are designed to replicate human morphology, the functional role of human hands suggests a different perspective: much of their complexity may exist to enable tool use and tool making. This observation motivates Any-ttach, a tool-centric manipulation framework that treats quick end-effector swapping as a mechanism for dexterity with simplicity. Any-ttach combines a low-cost automatic swapping mechanism for an open-close robot interface, a handheld device for collecting human demonstrations, and a task planning framework that composes learned, parameterized, and planned tool-use skills. The system supports diverse tools and end-effector modules, including daily tools, articulated tools such as scissors, Fin Ray fingers, and a low-cost anthropomorphic hand, through the same shared interface. Our experiments show that Any-ttach improves tool-swapping reliability, increases demonstration efficiency, reduces tool-pose variability, and supports diverse tool-use skills. In two long-horizon tasks, making a sandwich and preparing a cucumber, Any-ttach executes six tool-use subskills through end-effector switching and execution monitoring. These results suggest that robots can expand manipulation capability not only through more complex end-effectors, but also through rapidly exchangeable tools and end-effector modules. More details and videos are available at https://any-ttach.github.io/.
core_contributions: 提出了Any-ttach框架，将快速末端执行器交换作为实现操作灵巧性的机制。
开发了低成本自动交换机制和手持演示设备，支持多种工具和末端执行器模块。
设计了任务规划框架，组合学习、参数化和规划的工具使用技能。
实验验证了框架在交换可靠性、演示效率、位姿变化减少和技能多样性方面的优势。
在两个长期操作任务中展示了六个工具使用子技能的协调执行。
papers.abstract_zh: 机器人操作灵巧性通常通过构建越来越复杂的高自由度多指手来实现。虽然许多机器人手被设计为复制人类形态，但人类手的功能角色提出了不同的视角：其复杂性很大程度上可能在于支持工具使用和工具制造。这一观察启发了Any-ttach，一个以工具为中心的操作框架，将快速末端执行器交换视为一种简单实现灵巧性的机制。Any-ttach结合了用于开合机器人接口的低成本自动交换机制、用于收集人类演示的手持设备，以及一个组合学习、参数化和规划的工具使用技能的任务规划框架。该系统通过相同的共享接口支持多种工具和末端执行器模块，包括日常工具、如剪刀等关节工具、Fin Ray手指和低成本拟人手。我们的实验表明，Any-ttach提高了工具交换的可靠性，增加了演示效率，减少了工具位姿变化，并支持多样化的工具使用技能。在两个长期任务（制作三明治和准备黄瓜）中，Any-ttach通过末端执行器切换和执行监控执行了六个工具使用子技能。这些结果表明，机器人不仅可以通过更复杂的末端执行器，还可以通过快速可交换的工具和末端执行器模块来扩展操作能力。更多细节和视频请访问https://any-ttach.github.io/。

papers.title: Tactile-Proprioceptive Sensor Fusion for Contact Wrench Estimation in Whole-Body Physical Human-Robot Interaction
papers.abstract: Direct physical guidance is a natural means of teaching and interacting with robots, and robotic skins make a key contribution by enabling sensitive contact sensing and localization. This paper presents a tactile-proprioceptive sensor fusion framework for natural physical human-robot interaction. Tactile cues from pneumatic skin pads serve as contact indicators that bypass the ambiguity between frictional residues and applied external forces, enabling highly sensitive contact detection without explicit friction identification. We fuse these cues with motor-current-based proprioception to reconstruct multi-axis contact forces on the robot surface. To maintain accuracy during motion, we employ a temporal convolutional network (TCN) to mitigate friction hysteresis during stick-slip transitions, reducing uncertainty at contact onset and yielding smooth, responsive guidance. We validate the approach on a skin-integrated robot arm: (i) multi-axis forces are reconstructed in stationary contacts, and (ii) simultaneous force estimation and kinesthetic teaching are demonstrated. Results indicate improved sensitivity and responsiveness across diverse contact conditions compared with tactile-only and proprioceptive-only baselines, supporting tactile-proprioceptive fusion as a reliable pathway to safe, intuitive physical human-robot interaction.
core_contributions: 提出了触觉-本体感觉传感器融合框架，用于自然物理人机交互中的接触力估计。
使用气动皮肤垫作为接触指示器，绕过摩擦歧义，实现高灵敏度接触检测。
采用时间卷积网络（TCN）减轻摩擦滞后，提高运动中的力估计精度和响应性。
在皮肤集成机器人臂上验证了多轴力重建和同时力估计与动觉教学的有效性。
papers.abstract_zh: 直接物理引导是教授和与机器人交互的自然方式，机器人皮肤通过实现敏感的接触传感和定位做出了关键贡献。本文提出了一种用于自然物理人机交互的触觉-本体感觉传感器融合框架。来自气动皮肤垫的触觉线索作为接触指示器，绕过了摩擦残差和施加的外部力之间的歧义，实现了无需明确摩擦识别的高灵敏度接触检测。我们将这些线索与基于电机电流的本体感觉融合，以重建机器人表面上的多轴接触力。为了在运动过程中保持精度，我们采用时间卷积网络（TCN）来减轻粘滑过渡期间的摩擦滞后，减少接触开始时的不确定性，并产生平滑、响应的引导。我们在皮肤集成的机器人臂上验证了该方法：（i）在静态接触中重建多轴力，（ii）演示了同时力估计和动觉教学。结果表明，与仅触觉和仅本体感觉基线相比，在各种接触条件下灵敏度和响应性都有所提高，支持触觉-本体感觉融合作为安全、直观的物理人机交互的可靠途径。

papers.title: ForceFlow: Learning to Feel and Act via Contact-Driven Flow Matching
papers.abstract: ForceFlow is a force-aware reactive framework based on flow matching for contact-rich manipulation. It addresses the tendency of high-dimensional visual features to overshadow sparse force signals through temporal force history and joint prediction, aiming for multimodal generalization in contact-stage policy design.

papers.title: To Do or Not to Do: Ensuring the Safety of Visuomotor Policies Learned from Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Task success has historically been the primary measure of policy performance in imitation learning (IL) research. This characteristics strictly limits the ubiquitous applications of IL algorithms in field robotics where safety assurance, in addition to task-success, is of paramount importance. It is often desirable for an IL-powered robot in the field not to roll out a policy, and hence score a poor performance, if the safety is not guaranteed. Although this trade-off between safety and performance is well investigated in classical control literature, policy safety is a heavily underexplored domain in IL research. There is no universal definition of safety in IL. To make things worst, many existing theoretical works on safety is notoriously difficult to extend to IL-powered robots in the field. This paper offers important insights on the safety and performance of IL policies. We propose execution guarantee, a policy-agnostic safety measure that guarantees the maximum task success for a visuomotor IL policy, despite minor run-time changes, from within a specific region in the state space. We leverage recent advances in view synthesis to identify such regions in the state space for an IL policy and explore a fundamental result on set invariance - namely, Nagumo's sub-tangentiality condition - to prove and operationalize execution guarantee from inside that region. Experiments with a Franka robot, both in simulation and real world, demonstrate how the proposed safety analysis allows various IL policies to achieve maximum task success with guarantee. We also demonstrate some interesting results on how a recovery policy - a by-product of the proposed safety analysis - can help to increase the policy performance and thereby mitigating the safety-performance tradeoff in IL.
core_contributions: 提出执行保证（execution guarantee），一种策略无关的安全度量，保证视觉运动IL策略在特定状态空间区域内的最大任务成功。
利用视图合成技术识别IL策略状态空间中的安全区域。
应用Nagumo的次切条件证明和操作化执行保证。
通过Franka机器人仿真和真实世界实验验证了所提安全分析的有效性。
展示了恢复策略作为副产品，能够提高策略性能并缓解安全-性能权衡。
papers.abstract_zh: 任务成功历来是模仿学习（IL）研究中策略性能的主要衡量标准。这一特性严格限制了IL算法在现场机器人中的广泛应用，因为在这些应用中，除了任务成功之外，安全保证也至关重要。通常，如果安全性无法保证，现场中的IL驱动机器人最好不执行策略，从而获得较差的性能。尽管安全与性能之间的权衡在经典控制文献中已有充分研究，但策略安全性在IL研究中仍是一个严重未被探索的领域。IL中没有通用的安全定义。更糟糕的是，许多现有的安全理论工作难以扩展到现场中的IL驱动机器人。本文提供了关于IL策略安全性和性能的重要见解。我们提出了执行保证（execution guarantee），一种策略无关的安全度量，它保证视觉运动IL策略在状态空间中特定区域内，尽管运行时发生微小变化，也能获得最大任务成功。我们利用视图合成的最新进展来识别IL策略状态空间中的此类区域，并探索集合不变性的一个基本结果——即Nagumo的次切条件——来证明和操作化从该区域内部的执行保证。使用Franka机器人的实验，包括仿真和真实世界，展示了所提出的安全分析如何允许各种IL策略在保证下实现最大任务成功。我们还展示了一些有趣的结果，说明恢复策略（所提出安全分析的副产品）如何帮助提高策略性能，从而缓解IL中的安全-性能权衡。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文提出了一种称为执行保证的安全度量，利用视图合成和Nagumo的次切条件来保证视觉运动模仿学习策略在特定状态空间区域内的最大任务成功，并通过Franka机器人实验验证了其有效性。
papers.research_problem: 模仿学习中的策略安全性缺乏通用定义和可操作的安全度量，现有安全理论难以应用于实际机器人，导致安全与性能之间的权衡未被充分解决。
papers.method_summary: 本文提出执行保证作为安全度量，通过视图合成识别状态空间中的安全区域，并利用Nagumo的次切条件来证明在该区域内策略的执行保证，从而确保最大任务成功。

papers.key_results: 实验表明，所提出的安全分析允许各种IL策略在保证下实现最大任务成功；恢复策略有助于提高策略性能并缓解安全-性能权衡。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文填补了模仿学习领域安全性研究的空白，提出了可操作的安全度量，使机器人能够在保证安全的前提下执行任务，并展示了缓解安全-性能权衡的可能性，对于推动IL在现场机器人中的应用具有重要意义。

papers.title: Wrench-Aware Admittance Control for Unknown-Payload Manipulation
papers.abstract: Unknown payloads can strongly affect compliant robotic manipulation, especially when the payload center of mass is not aligned with the tool center point. In this case, the payload generates an offset wrench at the robot wrist. During motion, this wrench is not only related to payload weight, but also to payload inertia. If it is not modeled, the compliant controller can interpret it as an external interaction wrench, which causes unintended compliant motion, larger tracking error, and reduced transport accuracy. This paper presents a wrench-aware admittance control framework for unknown-payload pick-and-place using a UR5e robot. The method uses force-torque measurements in two different roles. First, a three-axis translational excitation term is used to reduce payload-induced force effects during transport without making the robot excessively stiff. Second, after grasping, the controller first estimates payload mass for transport compensation and then estimates the payload CoM offset relative to the TCP using wrist force-torque measurements collected during the subsequent translational motion. This helps improve object placement and stacking behavior. Experimental results show improved transport and placement performance compared with uncorrected placement while preserving compliant motion.
core_contributions: 提出了一种力觉感知的导纳控制框架，用于未知负载的抓取和放置。

通过力-扭矩测量估计负载质量和质心偏移，以改善运输和放置性能。
实验验证了该方法在运输和放置性能上的提升。
papers.abstract_zh: 未知负载会严重影响柔顺机器人操作，特别是当负载质心与工具中心点不对齐时。在这种情况下，负载会在机器人手腕处产生偏移力/力矩。在运动过程中，该力/力矩不仅与负载重量有关，还与负载惯性有关。如果不建模，柔顺控制器会将其解释为外部交互力/力矩，从而导致意外的柔顺运动、更大的跟踪误差和降低的运输精度。本文提出了一种力觉感知的导纳控制框架，用于使用UR5e机器人进行未知负载的抓取和放置。该方法在两种角色中使用力-扭矩测量。首先，使用三轴平移激励项来减少运输过程中负载引起的力效应，而不会使机器人过于僵硬。其次，在抓取后，控制器首先估计负载质量以进行运输补偿，然后使用在后续平移运动期间收集的手腕力-扭矩测量来估计负载相对于TCP的质心偏移。这有助于改善物体放置和堆叠行为。实验结果表明，与未校正的放置相比，运输和放置性能得到改善，同时保持了柔顺运动。

papers.title: AI-Enabled Image-Based Hybrid Vision/Force Control of Tendon-Driven Aerial Continuum Manipulators
papers.abstract: This paper presents an AI-enabled cascaded hybrid vision/force control framework for tendon-driven aerial continuum manipulators based on constant-strain modeling in $SE(3)$ as a coupled system. The proposed controller is designed to enable autonomous, physical interaction with a static environment while stabilizing the image feature error. The developed strategy combines the cascaded fast fixed-time sliding mode control and a radial basis function neural network to cope with the uncertainties in the image acquired by the eye-in-hand monocular camera and the measurements from the force sensing apparatus. This ensures rapid, online learning of the vision- and force-related uncertainties without requiring offline training. Furthermore, the features are extracted via a state-of-the-art graph neural network architecture employed by a visual servoing framework using line features, rather than relying on heuristic geometric line extractors, to concurrently contribute to tracking the desired normal interaction force during contact and regulating the image feature error. A comparative study benchmarks the proposed controller against established rigid-arm aerial manipulation methods, evaluating robustness across diverse scenarios and feature extraction strategies. The simulation and experimental results showcase the effectiveness of the proposed methodology under various initial conditions and demonstrate robust performance in executing manipulation tasks.

papers.title: A Physical Agentic Loop for Language-Guided Grasping with Execution-State Monitoring
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation systems that follow language instructions often execute grasp primitives in a largely single-shot manner: a model proposes an action, the robot executes it, and failures such as empty grasps, slips, stalls, timeouts, or semantically wrong grasps are not surfaced to the decision layer in a structured way. Inspired by agentic loops in digital tool-using agents, we reformulate language-guided grasping as a bounded embodied agent operating over grounded execution states, where physical actions expose an explicit tool-state stream. We introduce a physical agentic loop that wraps an unmodified learned manipulation primitive (grasp-and-lift) with (i) an event-based interface and (ii) an execution monitoring layer, Watchdog, which converts noisy gripper telemetry into discrete outcome labels using contact-aware fusion and temporal stabilization. These outcome events, optionally combined with post-grasp semantic verification, are consumed by a deterministic bounded policy that finalizes, retries, or escalates to the user for clarification, guaranteeing finite termination. We validate the resulting loop on a mobile manipulator with an eye-in-hand D405 camera, keeping the underlying grasp model unchanged and evaluating representative scenarios involving visual ambiguity, distractors, and induced execution failures. Results show that explicit execution-state monitoring and bounded recovery enable more robust and interpretable behavior than open-loop execution, while adding minimal architectural overhead. For the source code and demo refer to our project page: https://wenzewwz123.github.io/Agentic-Loop/
core_contributions: 引入了一个物理代理循环，包括基于事件的接口和执行监控层Watchdog

papers.abstract_zh: 遵循语言指令的机器人操作系统通常以单次方式执行抓取原语：模型提出动作，机器人执行，而空抓、滑落、停顿、超时或语义错误抓取等失败没有以结构化方式反馈到决策层。受数字工具使用代理中代理循环的启发，我们将语言引导的抓取重新表述为一个有界的具体代理，它操作于基础执行状态，其中物理动作暴露一个明确的工具状态流。我们引入了一个物理代理循环，它包装了一个未修改的学习操作原语（抓取和提升），包括（i）一个基于事件的接口和（ii）一个执行监控层Watchdog，它使用接触感知融合和时间稳定化将噪声夹爪遥测转换为离散结果标签。这些结果事件，可选地与抓取后语义验证结合，由一个确定性有界策略消费，该策略最终化、重试或升级到用户进行澄清，保证有限终止。我们在一个带有眼在手D405相机的移动机械手上验证了所提出的循环，保持底层抓取模型不变，并评估了涉及视觉模糊、干扰物和诱导执行失败的代表性场景。结果表明，显式执行状态监控和有界恢复比开环执行更鲁棒和可解释，同时增加了最小的架构开销。源代码和演示请参考我们的项目页面：https://wenzewwz123.github.io/Agentic-Loop/

papers.title: Learning When to See and When to Feel: Adaptive Vision-Torque Fusion for Contact-Aware Manipulation
papers.abstract: This work compares force/torque-vision integration strategies within diffusion-based manipulation policies and proposes an adaptive strategy that ignores force/torque during non-contact phases while leveraging vision and torque during contact. The paper reports a 14% success-rate improvement over its strongest baseline.

papers.title: Bayesian Active Object Recognition and 6D Pose Estimation from Multimodal Contact Sensing
papers.abstract: We present an active tactile exploration framework for joint object recognition and 6D pose estimation. The proposed method integrates wrist force/torque sensing, GelSight tactile sensing, and free-space constraints within a Bayesian inference framework that maintains a belief over object class and pose during active tactile exploration. By combining contact and non-contact evidence, the framework reduces ambiguity and improves robustness in the joint class-pose estimation problem. To enable efficient inference in the large hypothesis space, we employ a customized particle filter that progressively samples particles based on new observations. The inferred belief is further used to guide active exploration by selecting informative next touches under reachability constraints. For effective data collection, a motion planning and control framework is developed to plan and execute feasible paths for tactile exploration, handle unexpected contacts and GelSight-surface alignment with tactile servoing. We evaluate the framework in simulation and on a Franka Panda robot using 11 YCB objects. Results show that incorporating tactile and free-space information substantially improves recognition and pose estimation accuracy and stability, while reducing the number of action cycles compared with force/torque-only baselines. Code, dataset, and supplementary material will be made available online.

papers.title: Force Policy: Learning Hybrid Force-Position Control Policy under Interaction Frame for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation demands human-like integration of perception and force feedback: vision should guide task progress, while high-frequency interaction control must stabilize contact under uncertainty. Existing learning-based policies often entangle these roles in a monolithic network, trading off global generalization against stable local refinement, while control-centric approaches typically assume a known task structure or learn only controller parameters rather than the structure itself. In this paper, we formalize a physically grounded interaction frame, an instantaneous local basis that decouples force regulation from motion execution, and propose a method to recover it from demonstrations. Based on this, we address both issues by proposing Force Policy, a global-local vision-force policy in which a global policy guides free-space actions using vision, and upon contact, a high-frequency local policy with force feedback estimates the interaction frame and executes hybrid force-position control for stable interaction. Real-world experiments across diverse contact-rich tasks show consistent gains over strong baselines, with more robust contact establishment, more accurate force regulation, and reliable generalization to novel objects with varied geometries and physical properties, ultimately improving both contact stability and execution quality. Project page: https://force-policy.github.io/
core_contributions: 形式化了物理基础的交互框架，将力调节与运动执行解耦。
提出从演示中恢复交互框架的方法。
提出Force Policy全局-局部视觉-力策略架构。
在多种接触丰富的真实世界任务上验证了方法的有效性，展示了更鲁棒的接触建立、更准确的力调节和泛化能力。
papers.abstract_zh: 接触丰富的操作需要类似人类的感知和力反馈整合：视觉应引导任务进展，而高频交互控制必须在不确定性下稳定接触。现有的基于学习的策略通常将这些角色纠缠在一个单一网络中，在全局泛化和稳定局部优化之间权衡，而控制中心的方法通常假设已知的任务结构或仅学习控制器参数而非结构本身。在本文中，我们形式化了一个物理基础的交互框架，一个瞬时局部基，将力调节与运动执行解耦，并提出了一种从演示中恢复该框架的方法。基于此，我们通过提出Force Policy来解决这两个问题，这是一种全局-局部视觉-力策略，其中全局策略使用视觉引导自由空间动作，而在接触时，一个带有力反馈的高频局部策略估计交互框架并执行混合力-位置控制以实现稳定交互。在多种接触丰富的真实世界任务上的实验显示，与强基线相比一致提升，具有更鲁棒的接触建立、更准确的力调节，以及对具有不同几何和物理特性的新物体的可靠泛化，最终提高了接触稳定性和执行质量。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出Force Policy，一种结合视觉全局策略和力反馈局部策略的混合力-位置控制方法，通过从演示中恢复交互框架实现接触丰富操作的稳定与泛化。

papers.title: TaF-VLA: Tactile-Force Alignment in Vision-Language-Action Models for Force-aware Manipulation
papers.abstract: TaF-VLA argues that force-aware manipulation requires aligning high-dimensional tactile observations with physical interaction forces rather than treating tactile inputs as auxiliary visual textures. The work introduces an automated tactile-force data acquisition device and collects synchronized visuotactile observations, six-axis force/torque measurements and force maps.

papers.title: Diagnose, Correct, and Learn from Manipulation Failures via Visual Symbols
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently achieved remarkable progress in robotic manipulation, yet they remain limited in failure diagnosis and learning from failures. Additionally, existing failure datasets are mostly generated programmatically in simulation, which limits their generalization to the real world. In light of these, we introduce ViFailback, a framework designed to diagnose robotic manipulation failures and provide both textual and visual correction guidance. Our framework utilizes explicit visual symbols to enhance annotation efficiency. We further release the ViFailback dataset, a large-scale collection of 58,126 Visual Question Answering (VQA) pairs along with their corresponding 5,202 real-world manipulation trajectories. Based on the dataset, we establish ViFailback-Bench, a benchmark of 11 fine-grained VQA tasks designed to assess the failure diagnosis and correction abilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), featuring ViFailback-Bench Lite for closed-ended and ViFailback-Bench Hard for open-ended evaluation. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework, we built the ViFailback-8B VLM, which not only achieves significant overall performance improvement on ViFailback-Bench but also generates visual symbols for corrective action guidance. Finally, by integrating ViFailback-8B with a VLA model, we conduct real-world robotic experiments demonstrating its ability to assist the VLA model in recovering from failures. Project Website: https://x1nyuzhou.github.io/vifailback.github.io/
core_contributions: 提出了ViFailback框架，用于诊断机器人操作故障并提供文本和视觉纠正指导。
利用显式视觉符号提高注释效率，并发布了包含58,126个VQA对和5,202个真实世界操作轨迹的ViFailback数据集。
建立了ViFailback-Bench基准，包含11个细粒度VQA任务，用于评估VLM的故障诊断和纠正能力。
构建了ViFailback-8B VLM，在基准上取得显著性能提升，并能生成视觉符号用于纠正动作指导。
通过真实世界机器人实验，展示了ViFailback-8B帮助VLA模型从故障中恢复的能力。
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型最近在机器人操作中取得了显著进展，但在故障诊断和从故障中学习方面仍然有限。此外，现有的故障数据集大多在仿真中通过程序生成，这限制了它们对真实世界的泛化能力。鉴于此，我们引入了ViFailback，一个旨在诊断机器人操作故障并提供文本和视觉纠正指导的框架。我们的框架利用显式视觉符号来提高注释效率。我们进一步发布了ViFailback数据集，这是一个大规模集合，包含58,126个视觉问答（VQA）对及其对应的5,202个真实世界操作轨迹。基于该数据集，我们建立了ViFailback-Bench，一个包含11个细粒度VQA任务的基准，旨在评估视觉语言模型（VLM）的故障诊断和纠正能力，其中ViFailback-Bench Lite用于封闭式评估，ViFailback-Bench Hard用于开放式评估。为了展示我们框架的有效性，我们构建了ViFailback-8B VLM，它不仅显著提升了ViFailback-Bench上的整体性能，还能生成用于纠正动作指导的视觉符号。最后，通过将ViFailback-8B与VLA模型集成，我们进行了真实世界的机器人实验，展示了其帮助VLA模型从故障中恢复的能力。项目网站：https://x1nyuzhou.github.io/vifailback.github.io/

papers.title: Self-Supervised Multisensory Pretraining for Contact-Rich Robot Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Effective contact-rich manipulation requires robots to synergistically leverage vision, force, and proprioception. However, Reinforcement Learning agents struggle to learn in such multisensory settings, especially amidst sensory noise and dynamic changes. We propose MultiSensory Dynamic Pretraining (MSDP), a novel framework for learning expressive multisensory representations tailored for task-oriented policy learning. MSDP is based on masked autoencoding and trains a transformer-based encoder by reconstructing multisensory observations from only a subset of sensor embeddings, leading to cross-modal prediction and sensor fusion. For downstream policy learning, we introduce a novel asymmetric architecture, where a cross-attention mechanism allows the critic to extract dynamic, task-specific features from the frozen embeddings, while the actor receives a stable pooled representation to guide its actions. Our method demonstrates accelerated learning and robust performance under diverse perturbations, including sensor noise, and changes in object dynamics. Evaluations in multiple challenging, contact-rich robot manipulation tasks in simulation and the real world showcase the effectiveness of MSDP. Our approach exhibits strong robustness to perturbations and achieves high success rates on the real robot with as few as 6,000 online interactions, offering a simple yet powerful solution for complex multisensory robotic control. Website: https://msdp-pearl.github.io/
core_contributions: 提出了MSDP框架，基于掩码自编码和transformer编码器进行跨模态预测和传感器融合，学习表达性的多感官表示。
引入了非对称架构，评论家使用交叉注意力从冻结嵌入中提取动态任务特定特征，演员使用稳定的池化表示。
在模拟和真实世界的多个接触丰富操作任务中验证了方法的有效性，展示了加速学习和鲁棒性能。
在真实机器人上仅用6000次在线交互实现了高成功率，显著提高了样本效率。
papers.abstract_zh: 有效的接触丰富操作要求机器人协同利用视觉、力和本体感觉。然而，强化学习智能体在这种多感官设置中学习困难，尤其是在感官噪声和动态变化中。我们提出了多感官动态预训练（MSDP），一个新颖的框架，用于学习表达性的多感官表示，专门为任务导向的策略学习定制。MSDP基于掩码自编码，通过仅从传感器嵌入的子集重建多感官观测来训练基于transformer的编码器，从而实现跨模态预测和传感器融合。对于下游策略学习，我们引入了一种新颖的非对称架构，其中交叉注意力机制允许评论家从冻结的嵌入中提取动态的任务特定特征，而演员则接收稳定的池化表示来指导其动作。我们的方法在多种扰动下（包括传感器噪声和物体动力学变化）展示了加速学习和鲁棒性能。在模拟和真实世界的多个具有挑战性的接触丰富机器人操作任务中的评估展示了MSDP的有效性。我们的方法对扰动表现出强鲁棒性，并在真实机器人上仅用6000次在线交互就实现了高成功率，为复杂的多感官机器人控制提供了一个简单而强大的解决方案。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出了一种基于掩码自编码的多感官动态预训练框架MSDP，通过跨模态预测和传感器融合学习表达性表示，并采用非对称架构加速下游策略学习，在接触丰富操作任务中实现了鲁棒和高效的性能。

papers.key_results: 方法在多种扰动下表现出加速学习和鲁棒性能，在真实机器人上仅用6000次在线交互就实现了高成功率。

papers.title: Tactile-Conditioned Diffusion Policy for Force-Aware Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: FARM integrates high-dimensional tactile data to infer tactile-conditioned force signals and uses a matching force-based action space.
