papers.title: Multimodal Anomaly Detection with a Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract: With a growing number of robots being deployed across diverse applications, robust multimodal anomaly detection becomes increasingly important. In robotic manipulation, failures typically arise from (1) robot-driven anomalies due to an insufficient task model or hardware limitations, and (2) environment-driven anomalies caused by dynamic environmental changes or external interferences. Conventional anomaly detection methods focus either on the first by low-level statistical modeling of proprioceptive signals or the second by deep learning-based visual environment observation, each with different computational and training data requirements. To effectively capture anomalies from both sources, we propose a mixture-of-experts framework that integrates the complementary detection mechanisms with a visual-language model for environment monitoring and a Gaussian-mixture regression-based detector for tracking deviations in interaction forces and robot motions. We introduce a confidence-based fusion mechanism that dynamically selects the most reliable detector for each situation. We evaluate our approach on both household and industrial tasks using two robotic systems, demonstrating a 60% reduction in detection delay while improving frame-wise anomaly detection performance compared to individual detectors.
core_contributions: 提出了一个混合专家框架，整合了视觉语言模型和基于高斯混合回归的检测器，分别用于环境监测和交互力/运动偏差跟踪。
引入了一种基于置信度的融合机制，动态选择每个情况下最可靠的检测器。
在两个机器人系统上对家庭和工业任务进行了评估，检测延迟减少60%，帧级异常检测性能提升。
papers.abstract_zh: 随着越来越多的机器人在各种应用中被部署，鲁棒的多模态异常检测变得越来越重要。在机器人操作中，故障通常源于（1）由于任务模型不足或硬件限制导致的机器人驱动异常，以及（2）由动态环境变化或外部干扰引起的环境驱动异常。传统的异常检测方法要么通过本体感知信号的低级统计建模来关注前者，要么通过基于深度学习的视觉环境观察来关注后者，每种方法都有不同的计算和训练数据需求。为了有效捕获来自两种来源的异常，我们提出了一个混合专家框架，该框架集成了互补的检测机制：一个用于环境监测的视觉语言模型和一个基于高斯混合回归的检测器，用于跟踪交互力和机器人运动中的偏差。我们引入了一种基于置信度的融合机制，该机制动态选择每个情况下最可靠的检测器。我们在两个机器人系统上对家庭和工业任务进行了评估，结果表明，与单个检测器相比，检测延迟减少了60%，同时帧级异常检测性能得到了提升。

papers.title: Adaptive Visuo-Tactile Fusion with Predictive Force Attention for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: This work proposes a force-guided attention fusion module that adaptively adjusts the weights of visual and tactile features without human labeling. A self-supervised future force prediction task reinforces the tactile modality and encourages stage-appropriate fusion. The paper reports an average success rate of 93% across three fine-grained contact-rich tasks in real-world experiments.

papers.title: RoboCulture: A Robotics Platform for Automated Biological Experimentation
papers.abstract: Automating biological experimentation remains challenging due to the need for millimeter-scale precision, long and multi-step experiments, and the dynamic nature of living systems. Current liquid handlers only partially automate workflows, requiring human intervention for plate loading, tip replacement, and calibration. Industrial solutions offer more automation but are costly and lack the flexibility needed in research settings. Meanwhile, research in autonomous robotics has yet to bridge the gap for long-duration, failure-sensitive biological experiments. We introduce RoboCulture, a cost-effective and flexible platform that uses a general-purpose robotic manipulator to automate key biological tasks. RoboCulture performs liquid handling, interacts with lab equipment, and leverages computer vision for real-time decisions using optical density-based growth monitoring. We demonstrate a fully autonomous 15-hour yeast culture experiment where RoboCulture uses vision and force feedback and a modular behavior tree framework to robustly execute, monitor, and manage experiments. Video demonstrations of RoboCulture can be found at https://ac-rad.github.io/roboculture.

papers.title: Hierarchical Task Decomposition for Execution Monitoring and Error Recovery: Understanding the Rationale Behind Task Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Multi-step manipulation tasks where robots interact with their environment and must apply process forces based on the perceived situation remain challenging to learn and prone to execution errors. Accurately simulating these tasks is also difficult. Hence, it is crucial for robust task performance to learn how to coordinate end-effector pose and applied force, monitor execution, and react to deviations. To address these challenges, we propose a learning approach that directly infers both low- and high-level task representations from user demonstrations on the real system. We developed an unsupervised task segmentation algorithm that combines intention recognition and feature clustering to infer the skills of a task. We leverage the inferred characteristic features of each skill in a novel unsupervised anomaly detection approach to identify deviations from the intended task execution. Together, these components form a comprehensive framework capable of incrementally learning task decisions and new behaviors as new situations arise. Compared to state-of-the-art learning techniques, our approach significantly reduces the required amount of training data and computational complexity while efficiently learning complex in-contact behaviors and recovery strategies. Our proposed task segmentation and anomaly detection approaches outperform state-of-the-art methods on force-based tasks evaluated on two different robotic systems.

papers.abstract_zh: 多步操作任务中，机器人需要根据感知情况施加过程力，这些任务仍然难以学习且容易发生执行错误。准确模拟这些任务也很困难。因此，对于鲁棒的任务执行，学习如何协调末端执行器姿态和施加力、监控执行并对偏差做出反应至关重要。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种学习方法，直接从真实系统上的用户演示中推断低级和高级任务表示。我们开发了一种无监督任务分割算法，结合意图识别和特征聚类来推断任务的技能。我们利用每个技能的推断特征，在一种新颖的无监督异常检测方法中识别与预期任务执行的偏差。这些组件共同形成了一个全面的框架，能够在新情况出现时增量学习任务决策和新行为。与最先进的学习技术相比，我们的方法显著减少了所需的训练数据量和计算复杂度，同时高效地学习复杂的接触行为和恢复策略。我们提出的任务分割和异常检测方法在两个不同的机器人系统上评估的基于力的任务中优于最先进的方法。

papers.title: FoAR: Force-Aware Reactive Policy for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich tasks present significant challenges for robotic manipulation policies due to complex contact dynamics. FoAR combines high-frequency force/torque sensing with visual inputs and uses a future contact predictor to adjust force/torque usage between non-contact and contact phases. Its reactive controller enables contact-rich tasks through simple position control and is evaluated under unexpected dynamic disturbances.
papers.abstract_zh: 接触丰富任务需要策略处理复杂的接触动力学。FoAR将高频力/力矩信号与视觉输入结合，并通过未来接触预测器在非接触阶段和接触阶段之间动态调整力觉使用。

papers.title: Soft Finger Grasp Force and Contact State Estimation from Tactile Sensors
papers.abstract: Soft robotic fingers can improve adaptability in grasping and manipulation, compensating for geometric variation in object or environmental contact, but today lack force capacity and fine dexterity. Integrated tactile sensors can provide grasp and task information which can improve dexterity,but should ideally not require object-specific training. The total force vector exerted by a finger provides general information to the internal grasp forces (e.g. for grasp stability) and, when summed over fingers, an estimate of the external force acting on the grasped object (e.g. for task-level control). In this study, we investigate the efficacy of estimating finger force from integrated soft sensors and use it to estimate contact states. We use a neural network for force regression, collecting labelled data with a force/torque sensor and a range of test objects. Subsequently, we apply this model in a plug-in task scenario and demonstrate its validity in estimating contact states.
core_contributions: 研究了从集成软传感器估计手指力的有效性
使用神经网络进行力回归，无需特定对象训练（使用多种测试对象）
在插件任务场景中验证了接触状态估计的有效性
papers.abstract_zh: 软体机器人手指可以提高抓取和操作中的适应性，补偿物体或环境接触中的几何变化，但目前缺乏力容量和精细灵巧性。集成触觉传感器可以提供抓取和任务信息，从而提高灵巧性，但理想情况下不应需要特定于对象的训练。手指施加的总力向量提供了内部抓取力的一般信息（例如，用于抓取稳定性），并且当对所有手指求和时，可以估计作用在被抓物体上的外力（例如，用于任务级控制）。在这项研究中，我们研究了从集成软传感器估计手指力的有效性，并将其用于估计接触状态。我们使用神经网络进行力回归，使用力/扭矩传感器和一系列测试对象收集标记数据。随后，我们将该模型应用于插件任务场景，并证明了其在估计接触状态方面的有效性。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文研究了利用软体手指中的集成触觉传感器估计抓取力和接触状态的方法，通过神经网络进行力回归，并在插件任务中验证了其有效性。

papers.method_summary: 使用神经网络从软触觉传感器数据回归手指力向量，然后将力估计用于接触状态估计；在插件任务中应用模型。

papers.title: Task Success Prediction for Open-Vocabulary Manipulation Based on Multi-Level Aligned Representations
papers.abstract: In this study, we consider the problem of predicting task success for open-vocabulary manipulation by a manipulator, based on instruction sentences and egocentric images before and after manipulation. Conventional approaches, including multimodal large language models (MLLMs), often fail to appropriately understand detailed characteristics of objects and/or subtle changes in the position of objects. We propose Contrastive $λ$-Repformer, which predicts task success for table-top manipulation tasks by aligning images with instruction sentences. Our method integrates the following three key types of features into a multi-level aligned representation: features that preserve local image information; features aligned with natural language; and features structured through natural language. This allows the model to focus on important changes by looking at the differences in the representation between two images. We evaluate Contrastive $λ$-Repformer on a dataset based on a large-scale standard dataset, the RT-1 dataset, and on a physical robot platform. The results show that our approach outperformed existing approaches including MLLMs. Our best model achieved an improvement of 8.66 points in accuracy compared to the representative MLLM-based model.
core_contributions: 提出Contrastive λ-Repformer模型用于任务成功预测
引入多级对齐表示，整合局部图像信息、自然语言对齐和结构化特征
通过对比两个图像表示差异来关注重要变化
在RT-1数据集和物理机器人平台上验证有效性，优于现有方法
papers.abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们考虑了基于指令句子和操作前后的自我中心图像，预测机械臂进行开放词汇操作的任务成功问题。传统方法，包括多模态大语言模型（MLLMs），通常无法正确理解物体的详细特征和/或物体位置的细微变化。我们提出了Contrastive λ-Repformer，通过将图像与指令句子对齐来预测桌面操作任务的成功。我们的方法将以下三种关键特征整合到多级对齐表示中：保留局部图像信息的特征；与自然语言对齐的特征；通过自然语言结构化的特征。这使得模型能够通过查看两个图像表示之间的差异来关注重要变化。我们在基于大规模标准数据集RT-1的数据集和物理机器人平台上评估了Contrastive λ-Repformer。结果表明，我们的方法优于包括MLLMs在内的现有方法。我们的最佳模型相比代表性MLLM模型在准确率上提高了8.66个百分点。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出Contrastive λ-Repformer，通过多级对齐表示预测开放词汇操作任务的成功，在RT-1数据集和物理机器人上优于现有方法。

papers.title: A Self-Correcting Vision-Language-Action Model for Fast and Slow System Manipulation
papers.abstract: SC-VLA integrates a fast system for direct action prediction and a slow system for reflecting on failed actions. It uses parameter-efficient fine-tuning for pose prediction and a chain-of-thought training strategy for failure correction within a VLA policy.

papers.title: Multimodal Detection and Identification of Robot Manipulation Failures
papers.abstract: An autonomous service robot should be able to interact with its environment safely and robustly without requiring human assistance. Unstructured environments are challenging for robots since the exact prediction of outcomes is not always possible. Even when the robot behaviors are well-designed, the unpredictable nature of physical robot-object interaction may prevent success in object manipulation. Therefore, execution of a manipulation action may result in an undesirable outcome involving accidents or damages to the objects or environment. Situation awareness becomes important in such cases to enable the robot to (i) maintain the integrity of both itself and the environment, (ii) recover from failed tasks in the short term, and (iii) learn to avoid failures in the long term. For this purpose, robot executions should be continuously monitored, and failures should be detected and classified appropriately. In this work, we focus on detecting and classifying both manipulation and post-manipulation phase failures using the same exteroception setup. We cover a diverse set of failure types for primary tabletop manipulation actions. In order to detect these failures, we propose FINO-Net [1], a deep multimodal sensor fusion based classifier network. Proposed network accurately detects and classifies failures from raw sensory data without any prior knowledge. In this work, we use our extended FAILURE dataset [1] with 99 new multimodal manipulation recordings and annotate them with their corresponding failure types. FINO-Net achieves 0.87 failure detection and 0.80 failure classification F1 scores. Experimental results show that proposed architecture is also appropriate for real-time use.
core_contributions: 提出FINO-Net，一种深度多模态传感器融合分类器网络，从原始传感器数据检测和分类操作失败，无需先验知识。
扩展FAILURE数据集，增加99个新的多模态操作记录并标注失败类型。
在失败检测和分类任务上分别达到0.87和0.80的F1分数。
证明所提架构适用于实时使用。
papers.abstract_zh: 自主服务机器人应能在无需人类帮助的情况下安全鲁棒地与环境交互。非结构化环境对机器人具有挑战性，因为结果的确切预测并不总是可能。即使机器人行为设计良好，物理机器人-物体交互的不可预测性也可能阻碍物体操作的成功。因此，操作动作的执行可能导致不良后果，涉及事故或对物体或环境的损坏。在这种情况下，情境意识变得重要，以使机器人能够（i）维护自身和环境的完整性，（ii）从失败任务中短期恢复，以及（iii）长期学习避免失败。为此，应持续监控机器人执行，并适当检测和分类失败。在这项工作中，我们专注于使用相同的外感受设置检测和分类操作阶段和操作后阶段的失败。我们涵盖了桌面操作动作的多种失败类型。为了检测这些失败，我们提出了FINO-Net [1]，一种深度多模态传感器融合分类器网络。所提出的网络从原始传感器数据准确检测和分类失败，无需任何先验知识。在这项工作中，我们使用了扩展的FAILURE数据集 [1]，包含99个新的多模态操作记录，并标注了相应的失败类型。FINO-Net实现了0.87的失败检测和0.80的失败分类F1分数。实验结果表明，所提出的架构也适用于实时使用。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出FINO-Net多模态传感器融合网络用于机器人操作失败检测与分类，在扩展数据集上达到高F1分数，并适用于实时使用。

papers.title: Rotating Objects via In-Hand Pivoting using Vision, Force and Touch
papers.abstract: We propose a robotic manipulation system that can pivot objects on a surface using vision, wrist force and tactile sensing. We aim to control the rotation of an object around the grip point of a parallel gripper by allowing rotational slip, while maintaining a desired wrist force profile. Our approach runs an end-effector position controller and a gripper width controller concurrently in a closed loop. The position controller maintains a desired force using vision and wrist force. The gripper controller uses tactile sensing to keep the grip firm enough to prevent translational slip, but loose enough to induce rotational slip. Our sensor-based control approach relies on matching a desired force profile derived from object dimensions and weight and vision-based monitoring of the object pose. The gripper controller uses tactile sensors to detect and prevent translational slip by tightening the grip when needed. Experimental results where the robot was tasked with rotating cuboid objects 90 degrees show that the multi-modal pivoting approach was able to rotate the objects without causing lift or slip, and was more energy-efficient compared to using a single sensor modality and to pick-and-place. While our work demonstrated the benefit of multi-modal sensing for the pivoting task, further work is needed to generalize our approach to any given object.
core_contributions: 提出了一种结合视觉、腕部力和触觉传感的多模态枢轴旋转控制方法
设计了同时运行的端执行器位置控制器和夹持器宽度控制器，分别用于力维持和滑动控制
实验验证了多模态方法在旋转90度任务中比单模态和拾取放置更节能且无抬起滑动
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种机器人操作系统，利用视觉、腕部力和触觉传感在桌面上枢轴旋转物体。我们的目标是控制物体绕平行夹持器夹持点的旋转，允许旋转滑动，同时维持期望的腕部力曲线。我们的方法同时运行端执行器位置控制器和夹持器宽度控制器，形成闭环。位置控制器使用视觉和腕部力维持期望力。夹持器控制器使用触觉传感保持夹持足够紧以防止平移滑动，但足够松以引起旋转滑动。我们的基于传感器的控制方法依赖于匹配从物体尺寸和重量推导的期望力曲线，以及基于视觉的物体姿态监测。夹持器控制器使用触觉传感器检测并防止平移滑动，必要时收紧夹持。实验结果表明，当机器人被要求将长方体物体旋转90度时，多模态枢轴旋转方法能够旋转物体而不引起抬起或滑动，并且比使用单传感器模态和拾取放置更节能。虽然我们的工作展示了多模态传感在枢轴旋转任务中的优势，但需要进一步工作以将我们的方法推广到任意物体。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出了一种利用视觉、腕部力和触觉传感的机器人操作系统，通过并行控制位置和夹持器宽度，实现物体在桌面上的枢轴旋转，并防止平移滑动。
papers.research_problem: 如何利用多模态传感实现机器人在手内枢轴旋转物体，同时避免平移滑动并维持期望的腕部力？
papers.method_summary: 方法包括并行运行的位置控制器和夹持器宽度控制器。位置控制器使用视觉和腕部力反馈维持期望力曲线，该曲线基于物体尺寸和重量推导；夹持器控制器使用触觉传感检测平移滑动并调整夹持力，以允许旋转滑动同时防止平移滑动。物体姿态通过视觉监测。
papers.experimental_setup: 机器人被要求将长方体物体旋转90度。实验比较了多模态方法与单传感器模态方法和拾取放置方法。具体机器人平台和传感器细节未在摘要中说明。
papers.key_results: 多模态枢轴旋转方法成功将物体旋转90度，没有引起抬起或平移滑动，并且比单模态方法和拾取放置方法更节能。
papers.limitations: 需要进一步工作以将方法推广到任意物体，目前仅在长方体物体上验证。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作展示了多模态传感在枢轴旋转任务中的优势，提高了能量效率并避免了滑动，对机器人精细操作有重要意义。
papers.relevance_reason: 明确涉及视觉–力/力矩或接触反馈；研究对象是机器人操作或接触任务；包含接触、滑移、状态或成功判断信号
papers.reproduction_value: Medium: 方法框架和控制器设计描述清晰，但缺少具体参数（如力曲线、夹持力阈值）和实验平台细节，复现需要进一步实现细节。

papers.title: Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Action Diffusion
papers.abstract: Diffusion Policy represents a visuomotor policy as a conditional denoising diffusion process. It benchmarks across 12 tasks from four robot manipulation benchmarks and reports an average improvement of 46.9% over prior methods. The diffusion formulation handles multimodal action distributions and high-dimensional action spaces.
papers.abstract_zh: Diffusion Policy将视觉运动策略表示为条件去噪扩散过程，在多个机器人操作基准上验证了其对多峰动作分布和高维动作空间的适应性。
papers.venue: The International Journal of Robotics Research (2024) / arXiv
papers.summary_one_sentence: 奠定了以条件动作扩散生成机器人操作轨迹的通用基线。
papers.research_problem: 传统行为克隆难以表达多峰动作分布和高维连续动作，导致复杂操作策略不稳定。
core_contributions: 将策略建模为条件扩散过程
支持多峰高维动作分布
在多个机器人操作基准上系统评估
papers.method_summary: 视觉和状态条件输入经过时序网络，扩散采样器逐步去噪得到动作序列。
papers.experimental_setup: 论文摘要报告12个任务、4个机器人操作基准；代码和项目页公开。
papers.key_results: 摘要报告相对已有方法平均提升46.9%；具体比较需以发表版本表格为准。
papers.limitations: 基础版本没有原生六维F/T或失败恢复机制，适合作为生成策略底座而不是完整融合方案。

papers.title: Probabilistic Contact State Estimation for Legged Robots using Inertial Information
papers.abstract: Legged robot navigation in unstructured and slippery terrains depends heavily on the ability to accurately identify the quality of contact between the robot's feet and the ground. Contact state estimation is regarded as a challenging problem and is typically addressed by exploiting force measurements, joint encoders and/or robot kinematics and dynamics. In contrast to most state of the art approaches, the current work introduces a novel probabilistic method for estimating the contact state based solely on proprioceptive sensing, as it is readily available by Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) mounted on the robot's end effectors. Capitalizing on the uncertainty of IMU measurements, our method estimates the probability of stable contact. This is accomplished by approximating the multimodal probability density function over a batch of data points for each axis of the IMU with Kernel Density Estimation. The proposed method has been extensively assessed against both real and simulated scenarios on bipedal and quadrupedal robotic platforms such as ATLAS, TALOS and Unitree's GO1.
core_contributions: 提出了一种仅基于IMU的本体感觉进行接触状态估计的概率方法
利用核密度估计近似IMU数据的多模态概率密度函数，从而估计稳定接触的概率
papers.abstract_zh: 腿式机器人在非结构化且湿滑的地形中导航，很大程度上依赖于准确识别机器人脚与地面之间的接触质量的能力。接触状态估计被认为是一个具有挑战性的问题，通常通过利用力测量、关节编码器和/或机器人运动学与动力学来解决。与大多数现有方法不同，当前工作引入了一种新颖的概率方法，仅基于本体感觉传感（即机器人末端执行器上安装的惯性测量单元（IMU）提供的信息）来估计接触状态。利用IMU测量的不确定性，我们的方法估计稳定接触的概率。这是通过对每个IMU轴的一批数据点使用核密度估计来近似多模态概率密度函数来实现的。该方法已在双足和四足机器人平台（如ATLAS、TALOS和Unitree的GO1）上通过真实和模拟场景进行了广泛评估。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文提出了一种仅利用IMU数据的概率接触状态估计方法，通过核密度估计处理不确定性，在多种腿式机器人上验证。

papers.method_summary: 对每个IMU轴的一批数据点使用核密度估计近似多模态概率密度函数，基于此估计稳定接触的概率。

papers.title: RT-1: Robotics Transformer for Real-World Control at Scale
papers.abstract: RT-1 studies scalable general robotic control through open-ended task-agnostic training and a high-capacity Robotics Transformer. It investigates how diverse real-world robotic data can support generalization across tasks and objects.
papers.abstract_zh: RT-1研究如何利用大规模、多样、任务无关的真实机器人数据训练通用控制Transformer。

papers.title: Robust Contact State Estimation in Humanoid Walking Gaits
papers.abstract: In this article, we propose a deep learning framework that provides a unified approach to the problem of leg contact detection in humanoid robot walking gaits. Our formulation accomplishes to accurately and robustly estimate the contact state probability for each leg (i.e., stable or slip/no contact). The proposed framework employs solely proprioceptive sensing and although it relies on simulated ground-truth contact data for the classification process, we demonstrate that it generalizes across varying friction surfaces and different legged robotic platforms and, at the same time, is readily transferred from simulation to practice. The framework is quantitatively and qualitatively assessed in simulation via the use of ground-truth contact data and is contrasted against state of-the-art methods with an ATLAS, a NAO, and a TALOS humanoid robot. Furthermore, its efficacy is demonstrated in base estimation with a real TALOS humanoid. To reinforce further research endeavors, our implementation is offered as an open-source ROS/Python package, coined Legged Contact Detection (LCD).
core_contributions: 提出了一个统一的深度学习框架用于腿部接触检测，仅使用本体感觉传感器。
该框架能够泛化到不同摩擦表面和不同腿式机器人平台（ATLAS、NAO、TALOS）。
实现了从模拟到真实机器人的直接迁移（sim-to-real）。
提供了开源的ROS/Python实现包（LCD），促进进一步研究。
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一个深度学习框架，为人形机器人行走步态中的腿部接触检测问题提供了统一的方法。我们的公式能够准确且鲁棒地估计每条腿的接触状态概率（即稳定或滑动/无接触）。所提出的框架仅使用本体感觉，并且尽管它依赖于模拟的地面真实接触数据进行分类过程，但我们证明它能够泛化到不同的摩擦表面和不同的腿式机器人平台，同时能够从模拟直接转移到实践。该框架在模拟中通过使用地面真实接触数据进行了定量和定性评估，并与ATLAS、NAO和TALOS人形机器人的最先进方法进行了对比。此外，其有效性在真实TALOS人形机器人的基础估计中得到了展示。为了促进进一步的研究工作，我们的实现以开源ROS/Python包的形式提供，命名为Legged Contact Detection (LCD)。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出一个基于深度学习的统一框架，仅利用本体感觉实现人形机器人行走中腿部接触状态的鲁棒估计，并成功从模拟迁移到真实机器人。
papers.research_problem: 人形机器人行走步态中的腿部接触状态检测问题，需要准确估计每条腿是稳定接触还是滑动/无接触。
papers.method_summary: 该框架使用深度学习模型，以本体感觉数据为输入，输出每条腿的接触状态概率。训练数据来自模拟环境中的地面真实接触标签，但模型能够泛化到真实场景和不同机器人平台。
papers.experimental_setup: 在模拟环境中使用地面真实接触数据进行定量和定性评估，与ATLAS、NAO和TALOS人形机器人的最先进方法进行对比。此外，在真实TALOS人形机器人上进行了基础估计实验，验证其有效性。
papers.key_results: 无法从摘要确认具体数值结果，但摘要表明该方法能够准确且鲁棒地估计接触状态，并成功泛化到不同表面和平台，且从模拟迁移到真实机器人。
papers.limitations: 无法从摘要确认（摘要未明确提及局限性）。
papers.why_it_matters: 人形机器人的稳定行走依赖于准确的接触状态估计。该工作提供了一个统一、鲁棒且仅依赖本体感觉的解决方案，能够跨平台泛化并实现sim-to-real迁移，且开源代码有助于实际应用和后续研究。
